chamber.pioneers.formation.missing_power: A Stabilizer Power Port is required at the center of each side face (missing at %1$s).
chamber.pioneers.formation.missing_stabi: A Stabilizer is required right behind each Stabilizer Power Port (missing at %1$s).
chamber.pioneers.formation.misplaced_sta: The chamber must contain exactly 4 Stabilizers, one behind each Stabilizer Power Port, and nothing else.
chamber.pioneers.formation.misplaced_pow: Stabilizer Power Ports can only be placed at the center of a side face (%1$s).
description.pioneers.stellar_core: Space Stabilizer core: placed at the exact center of the globe, it is consumed on ignition to light a captive star burning lava into solar plasma.
rocket.pioneers.not_fueled: Not enough fuel: %1$s / %2$s mB of liquid hydrogen
description.pioneers.launch_pad_core: Heart of the launch complex. Place a rocket and install its modules (3 to 7 by tier): crew cabin for a crewed flight, probes, or cargo bays for logistics routes to another receiving complex.
rocket.pioneers.needs_pad: A rocket can only be placed on a complete Launch Pad
rocket.pioneers.capsule.hint: Retrieve the rocket: the capsule will disappear
rocket.pioneers.map.title: Navigation map

rocket.pioneers.map.hint_focus: Wheel: zoom · Click: select · Enter: lift off · Right-click / Esc: back
rocket.pioneers.map.view_only: Viewing only - board a rocket in orbit to travel
description.pioneers.data_antenna: 3-block-tall antenna. Tune it to a destination: it receives probe data from orbit and sends it through MKI logistic cables from the sockets on its cabinet (sides and bottom). Uses energy.
description.pioneers.research_table: Research lab. It receives data through the MKI logistic cable (16 tanks of 100,000 MB) and automatically pulls whatever the current unit is missing from the network’s data banks. The network’s computing power speeds it up (and becomes required later).
description.pioneers.rocket_blueprint: Put it in the Rocket Integration Hall to build the tier %1$s rocket (not consumed).
auto_pad.pioneers.status.tier_too_low: Rocket too weak for this destination
antenna.pioneers.mixed: Still sending data from the previous destination
description.pioneers.greenhouse_controll: Multiblock greenhouse (4 sizes, Shift + right-click empty-handed: blueprint): round base of industrial casings with this controller on its edge, hydroponic substrate trays in the floor in rows, a charging pad in the middle, an industrial glass dome held by frames. The tier (weakest part) speeds up growth. Seeds, harvest and energy go through greenhouse ports set in the base.
description.pioneers.space_seeds: Grows in a space greenhouse built on: %1$s
greenhouse.pioneers.wrong_planet: These plants don't grow on this world
description.pioneers.rocket_blueprint_ca: Place it in the Module Assembly Table to build cargo bays (items, fluids, gas, data). Not consumed.
cargo.pioneers.receiver_hint: Welcomes rockets, then sends them home
research.pioneers.tree.title: Technology Tree
research.pioneers.tree.idle: No active research: pick one in the tree
research.pioneers.tree.hint: Wheel: zoom · Drag: pan · Double-click: research · Shift+click: queue · Tabs: chapters
research.pioneers.discovered: Discovery! %1$s: new worlds appear on the map
research.pioneers.lab.open_tree.tooltip: Choose the research shared by every lab
research.pioneers.lab.print_cost: Reprint a blueprint: %1$s of orbital data
research.pioneers.lab.no_research: Open the technology tree to start research
research.pioneers.node.telemetry.desc: The first probes stammer. Standardized telemetry protocols squeeze far more out of every signal.
research.pioneers.node.launch_reliabilit: Every explosion is a lesson. Failed flights are dissected to harden structures and ignition sequences.
research.pioneers.node.lunar_relays.desc: A relay network on the near side of the Moon amplifies and cleans every transmission.
research.pioneers.node.lunar_relays.effe: Transmission losses halved, antenna throughput doubled
research.pioneers.node.radio_astronomy.d: Antennas turn toward the void. The sky whispers back: time to send probes out there.
research.pioneers.node.cargo_logistics.d: Standardized cargo bays, computed trajectories: space becomes a trade route.
research.pioneers.node.cargo_logistics.e: Prints the logistics module blueprint (cargo bays)
research.pioneers.node.blueprint_t2.desc: Extra stages and high-pressure engines: the rocket that opens the road to Mars.
research.pioneers.node.space_agronomy.de: Alien plants can be tamed: tuned light spectrum, nutrients and smarter robots.
research.pioneers.node.space_agronomy.ef: Greenhouse growth +50%, the turtle's battery lasts twice as long
Orbiters map the red planet and its two moons. Mars finally appears on the map.
Reveals Mars, Phobos and Deimos; unlocks Martian probes
research.pioneers.node.ion_propulsion.de: A stream of accelerated ions pushes cargo ships while cruising. Slow to start, relentless afterward.
Quantum algorithms compress raw streams before they are even transmitted.
research.pioneers.node.cryo_tanks.desc: Multi-layer insulation stores liquid hydrogen with no boil-off at all.
research.pioneers.node.cryo_tanks.effect: -25% hydrogen for automatic launches and cargo flights
research.pioneers.node.inner_system.desc: Probes dive toward the Sun: Venus under its acid clouds, Mercury in its furnace.
research.pioneers.node.inner_system.effe: Reveals Venus and Mercury; unlocks Venusian and Mercurian probes
research.pioneers.node.belt_survey.desc: Thousands of asteroids cataloged from Mercury's orbit, and four dwarf worlds within rocket range.
research.pioneers.node.belt_survey.effec: Reveals the asteroid belt: Ceres, Vesta, Pallas and Hygiea
research.pioneers.node.blueprint_t3.desc: Heat shields and closed-cycle engines, built to cross the acid clouds of Venus.
research.pioneers.node.quantum_labs.desc: Labs learn to parallelize their computations on built-in quantum processors.
research.pioneers.node.deep_telescope.de: A giant mirror beyond Neptune stares into the Kuiper belt: a frozen world marked with a heart, and its twin moon.
research.pioneers.node.deep_telescope.ef: Reveals Pluto and Charon; unlocks Plutonian probes
research.pioneers.node.singularity_theor: Data from the whole solar system converges: spacetime around a black hole holds no more secrets.
+25% output from singularity and stellar chambers
description.pioneers.rocket_tier_4: %1$s mB of liquid hydrogen, 4 module slots. Reaches Mercury. Place it on a launch complex; a crew cabin module is needed for a crewed flight.
description.pioneers.rocket_tier_5: %1$s mB of liquid hydrogen, 5 module slots. Reaches the asteroid belt. Place it on a launch complex; a crew cabin module is needed for a crewed flight.
description.pioneers.rocket_tier_6: %1$s mB of liquid hydrogen, 5 module slots. Reaches the moons of Jupiter. Place it on a launch complex; a crew cabin module is needed for a crewed flight.
description.pioneers.rocket_tier_7: %1$s mB of liquid hydrogen, 6 module slots. Reaches Titan and Enceladus. Place it on a launch complex; a crew cabin module is needed for a crewed flight.
description.pioneers.rocket_tier_8: %1$s mB of liquid hydrogen, 6 module slots. Reaches Miranda and Titania. Place it on a launch complex; a crew cabin module is needed for a crewed flight.
description.pioneers.rocket_tier_9: %1$s mB of liquid hydrogen, 7 module slots. Reaches Triton. Place it on a launch complex; a crew cabin module is needed for a crewed flight.
description.pioneers.rocket_tier_10: %1$s mB of liquid hydrogen, 7 module slots. Reaches Pluto and Charon. Place it on a launch complex; a crew cabin module is needed for a crewed flight.
research.pioneers.node.thermal_shielding: Ceramic tiles tested in the atmosphere of Venus now protect every launcher.
research.pioneers.node.blueprint_t4.desc: A fully heat-shielded launcher with two large boosters, built for Mercury's inferno.
research.pioneers.node.heliophysics.desc: Mercurian probes measure the solar wind: time to graze the Sun itself.
research.pioneers.node.photonic_sails.de: Large reflective sails push cargo ships with the pressure of light.
research.pioneers.node.blueprint_t5.desc: An industrial three-booster launcher, tough enough for the belt and solar orbits.
research.pioneers.node.blueprint_t5.effe: Prints the tier 5 rocket blueprint (asteroid belt, solar probes)
research.pioneers.node.photonic_computin: Optical circuits fed by sunlight replace the labs' electronics.
research.pioneers.node.jovian_system.des: Solar data reveals the giant: Jupiter and its Galilean moons, Io, Europa, Ganymede and Callisto.
research.pioneers.node.jovian_system.eff: Reveals Jupiter and its moons; unlocks Jovian probes
research.pioneers.node.blueprint_t6.desc: Six boosters and radiation collars to cross Jupiter's belts.
research.pioneers.node.blueprint_t6.effe: Prints the tier 6 rocket blueprint (Jupiter's moons)
research.pioneers.node.saturn_system.des: Beyond the rings: Titan and its orange haze, Enceladus and its ice geysers.
research.pioneers.node.saturn_system.eff: Reveals Saturn, Titan and Enceladus; unlocks Saturnian probes
research.pioneers.node.radiation_hardeni: Electronics tested by Jupiter withstand anything: probes transmit at full strength.
research.pioneers.node.blueprint_t7.desc: A heavy launcher with a gold-foil upper stage and four boosters, bound for Saturn.
research.pioneers.node.blueprint_t7.effe: Prints the tier 7 rocket blueprint (Titan, Enceladus)
research.pioneers.node.uranus_system.des: The giant lying on its side and its moons: shattered Miranda, great Titania.
research.pioneers.node.uranus_system.eff: Reveals Uranus, Miranda and Titania; unlocks Uranian probes
research.pioneers.node.aerocapture.desc: Braking in Titan's atmosphere instead of with the engines: colossal fuel savings.
research.pioneers.node.blueprint_t8.desc: Nuclear thermal propulsion: a reactor, side tanks and large radiators.
research.pioneers.node.blueprint_t8.effe: Prints the tier 8 rocket blueprint (moons of Uranus)
research.pioneers.node.neptune_system.de: The deep blue of Neptune and Triton, a captured moon with nitrogen geysers.
research.pioneers.node.neptune_system.ef: Reveals Neptune and Triton; unlocks Neptunian probes
research.pioneers.node.deep_space_relays: A relay chain out to Uranus: distant signals arrive intact.
Transmission losses halved and antenna throughput doubled (stacks)
research.pioneers.node.blueprint_t9.desc: Fusion propulsion: eight boosters and a glowing confinement torus.
research.pioneers.node.fusion_drives.des: Fusion reactors now push cargo ships too: interplanetary routes get shorter.
research.pioneers.node.blueprint_t10.des: A colossal ship: four giant boosters, rings and radiators, out to the edge of the solar system.
research.pioneers.node.blueprint_t10.eff: Prints the tier 10 rocket blueprint (Pluto, Charon)
command.pioneers.unknown_body: Unknown body, or body without a surface
research.pioneers.lab.no_data: No data yet: connect an antenna with an MKI logistic cable
launch_pad.pioneers.requires: Probe: T%1$s rocket min., %2$s mB of H₂
launch_pad.pioneers.status.pad_too_small: Rocket too big: enlarge the complex
launch_pad.pioneers.status.tier_too_low: Rocket too weak for this destination
rocket.pioneers.pad_too_small: This launch pad is too small for a tier %1$s rocket
mining.pioneers.module.refinery.effect: 30% chance of an extra ore on every drilled unit
mining.pioneers.module.hint: Place in a module slot of the rover garage
description.pioneers.mining_outpost_cont: Rover garage (Moon, Mars, Venus, Mercury; 1 to 4 bays, Shift + right-click empty-handed: blueprint): casing slab, frame posts and beams, sheet-metal cladding and roof, one door and one dock per bay, a radar mast on the roof, this controller on the gable. Each bay holds one rover: they leave as a convoy, dig their road, drill and bring the ore back. The tier speeds up drilling. Energy and ore through mining ports.
mining.pioneers.drill.hint: Each exotic metal forges the head that unlocks the next one
mining.pioneers.status.wrong_body: No deposits here: Moon, Mars, Venus or Mercury
mining.pioneers.status.drill_too_weak: Drill head too weak for these deposits
mining.pioneers.filter.tooltip: Filter: the rover only drills this deposit type
mining.pioneers.rescan.tooltip: Forget known deposits and run the radar again (rover docked)
research.pioneers.node.planetary_prospec: Reading the ground from orbit: radars know where to dig.
research.pioneers.node.autonomous_rovers: Onboard navigation and fine energy management.
research.pioneers.node.exotic_metallurgy: Mercurium reveals what the veins hide.
Byproducts doubled, 25% chance of an extra ore
mining.pioneers.status.path_blocked: Path blocked: the rover only digs planetary rock
mining.pioneers.range.tooltip: Survey and drilling radius around the base (max %1$s blocks, raised by research and the scanner module)
launch_pad.pioneers.gui.not_formed: Needs a launch pad disc and a tower
research.pioneers.node.orbit_moon.desc: Probes in orbit map the Moon from space: terrain, composition, safe landing sites. Without this survey no crewed rocket dares to land there.
research.pioneers.node.surface_moon.desc: On site, record the 4 biomes of the Moon with the surface scanner, then store the cells in a biome analyzer linked to the research lab.
research.pioneers.node.surface_moon.effe: Opens the geology of the Moon
research.pioneers.node.geology_moon.desc: The geological spectrometer analyzes 128 raw ores mined by a rover garage on the Moon (a raw ore block counts as 9).
research.pioneers.node.geology_moon.effe: +25% drilling speed on the Moon; opens biology
research.pioneers.node.biology_moon.desc: The biological sequencer analyzes 512 harvests of the plants of the Moon. You will need a lot: grow them in a greenhouse on site.
research.pioneers.node.biology_moon.effe: +25% greenhouse growth on the Moon; body mastered, opens Mars

research.pioneers.node.biology_titania.d: The biological sequencer analyzes 2048 harvests of the plants of Titania. You will need a lot: grow them in a greenhouse on site.
research.pioneers.node.biology_titania.e: +25% greenhouse growth on Titania; body mastered, opens the Neptune system

research.pioneers.node.asteroids_1.desc: Small asteroids that fell on the Moon give up their first secrets: rock, metal, ice and frozen lava. Crush 32 asteroids of each type.
research.pioneers.node.asteroids_2.desc: Belt bodies tell how the solar system formed. Crush 128 asteroids of each type.
research.pioneers.node.asteroids_3.desc: Thousands of samples, crushed and compared: the chemistry of the outer system takes shape. Crush 384 asteroids of each type.
research.pioneers.node.asteroids_4.desc: The complete collection: every asteroid type, from the most common to the rarest, cataloged to the last grain. Crush 1024 asteroids of each type.
research.pioneers.node.probe_t2.desc: Shielding and a high-gain antenna: the probe survives the trip to the neighboring planets.
research.pioneers.node.probe_t2.effect: Tier 2 probes (Mars and Venus) for sufficiently powerful rockets
research.pioneers.node.probe_t3.desc: Heat shield and radiators: the probe skims the Sun without melting.
research.pioneers.node.probe_t3.effect: Tier 3 probes (Mercury and the Sun) for sufficiently powerful rockets
research.pioneers.node.probe_t4.desc: Plutonium generator and hardened electronics for the radiation belts of the giants.
research.pioneers.node.probe_t4.effect: Tier 4 probes (Jupiter and Saturn) for sufficiently powerful rockets
research.pioneers.node.probe_t5.desc: Ion drive and mass storage: years of travel to the outer edge.
research.pioneers.node.probe_t5.effect: Tier 5 probes (Uranus, Neptune and Pluto) for sufficiently powerful rockets
research.pioneers.tree.how.surface: On %1$s, hold the surface scanner (right-click) in 3 different biomes.
research.pioneers.tree.how.geology: Put raw ores from %1$s (mined by a rover garage) into a geological spectrometer.
research.pioneers.tree.how.biology: Put harvested plants from %1$s into a biological sequencer. Grow them in a greenhouse on site.
research.pioneers.tree.how.asteroids: Collect the small asteroids lying on the surface of celestial bodies and crush them in an asteroid crusher: every type is needed.
description.pioneers.asteroid_crusher: Crushes asteroids into composition data, one type per family (rock, metal, ice, volcanic). The data leaves through MKI logistic cables (back by default) to a research lab, which turns it into samples: 1 GB per asteroid.
description.pioneers.geo_spectrometer: Analyzes raw ores into the geology data of their body (lunarium: Moon geology). The data leaves through MKI logistic cables to a research lab: 1 GB per ore, 9 GB per block.
description.pioneers.bio_sequencer: Sequences space plant harvests into the biology data of their body. The data leaves through MKI logistic cables to a research lab: 1 GB per harvest.

research.pioneers.node.space_suit.desc: Surviving vacuum: sealed helmet, oxygen supply and insulation.
research.pioneers.node.space_suit.effect: Unlocks the space suit (Equipment Assembly Table)
research.pioneers.node.life_support.desc: Building sealed bases: pressurize a room, make oxygen, enter through airlocks.
research.pioneers.node.life_support.effe: Unlocks the oxygen diffuser, the gas collector and the airlock door
research.pioneers.node.thermal_suit.desc: Lunar surveys show how to withstand the temperature swings of Mars.
research.pioneers.node.acid_suit.desc: Martian soils reveal coatings able to face the acid clouds of Venus and Jovian radiation.
Assemble a station in orbit around any body. Expensive, but what a view.
Terabytes of surveys are enough to recreate a planet in miniature.
Spin eight miniature planets around a plasma sun, and harvest them.
description.pioneers.module_assembly_tab: Assembles rocket modules: crew cabin, probe, cargo bays and upgrades.
description.pioneers.equipment_assembly_: Assembles space suits (basic, thermal, acid-proof) and life support units, once researched.
item.pioneers.life_support_unit.desc: Component of survival machines, airlocks and orbital stations

description.pioneers.biome_analyzer: Reads up to 9 space biome cells (not consumed) and continuously produces the data of each biome in exchange for energy. Data leaves through the back, sides and bottom into MKI logistic cables.

jei.pioneers.data.info.probe: Probe data: send probes into orbit (%1$s). The receiving antenna picks up what they transmit.
jei.pioneers.data.info.geology: Analysis data: the geological spectrometer extracts it from raw ores of %1$s (1 GB per ore, 9 GB per block).
jei.pioneers.data.info.biology: Analysis data: the biological sequencer extracts it from the crops of %1$s (1 GB per crop).
jei.pioneers.data.info.asteroid: Analysis data: the asteroid crusher extracts it from meteorites of this family (1 GB per meteorite).
jei.pioneers.data.info.biome: Biome data: the biome analyzer produces it continuously from a biome cell, recorded on site with the surface scanner. The research lab spends 10,000 MB of it to validate the biome's exploration.
jei.pioneers.data.info.usage: Data travels through the MKI-or-better logistic cable, is stored in data banks and is consumed by the research lab and the planet synthesizer.
description.pioneers.rocket_tier_11: %1$s mB of liquid hydrogen, 8 module slots. Reaches the gas giants (Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune). Place it on a heavy launch complex; a crew cabin module is needed for a crewed flight.
description.pioneers.rocket_tier_12: %1$s mB of liquid hydrogen, 8 module slots. Reaches Alpha Centauri (Toliman b, Proxima b, Proxima d). Place it on a heavy launch complex; a crew cabin module is needed for a crewed flight.
description.pioneers.rocket_tier_13: %1$s mB of liquid hydrogen, 9 module slots. Reaches TRAPPIST-1 (b, d, e, f). Place it on a heavy launch complex; a crew cabin module is needed for a crewed flight.
suit.pioneers.tier.atmospheric: Tier 4 · high pressure (gas giants, exoplanets); jet flight in the clouds
research.pioneers.node.atmospheric_entry: Giant shields and parachutes: diving into the clouds of a gas giant without being crushed.
research.pioneers.node.blueprint_t11.des: Armored hull and heat shield: the first rocket able to descend into Jupiter.
research.pioneers.node.blueprint_t11.eff: Prints the tier 11 rocket blueprint (gas giants, Sun stations)
Pressurized armor with back thrusters: it withstands gas giant pressures and lets you fly through their clouds.
research.pioneers.node.aerostats.desc: Floating platforms, lifted by helium buoyancy cells, to live above the clouds.
research.pioneers.node.gas_harvesting.de: Drones fly out to suck up the gas pockets drifting through gas giant atmospheres.
research.pioneers.node.gas_harvesting.ef: Unlocks the drone bay and the gas scanner
research.pioneers.node.storm_drones.desc: Lightning-proof plating: drones descend into the storm layer, where metallic hydrogen and diamond rain lie.
A station orbiting a star, covered in collectors, drinking its light.
Unlocks the solar absorber and stations around stars
research.pioneers.node.interstellar_prop: Crossing 4.37 light-years in a few weeks: helium-3 fusion and a warp bubble.

item.pioneers.gas_scanner.not_here: No gas pockets outside a gas giant
item.pioneers.metallic_hydrogen.desc: Torn from the deep pockets of Jupiter and Saturn by armored drones.
item.pioneers.void_singularity_cell.desc: A bottled singularity. Ignites the Universe Simulator.
item.pioneers.aerostat_kit.desc: In a gas giant: deploys a 9×9 floating platform under your feet.
item.pioneers.drone_armor_plating.desc: One per drone, in the bay: opens the storm layer (lightning).
item.pioneers.gas_scanner.desc: Right-click: reveals nearby pockets. On a pocket: marks it for the drones.
item.pioneers.rain_diamond.desc: The diamond rain of Neptune and Uranus. Two diamonds when enriched.
item.pioneers.stardust.desc: What a simulated spiral galaxy leaves behind.
item.pioneers.dark_matter.desc: Invisible, but heavy. Irregular galaxies and quasars.
item.pioneers.neutronium_ingot.desc: The core of a simulated neutron star. Elliptical galaxies.
item.pioneers.quasar_crystal.desc: The light of an active galactic nucleus, crystallized.
description.pioneers.drone_bay: Bay built on an aerostat (1 to 4 pads, Shift + right-click empty-handed: blueprint): casing deck edged with frames, one landing pad and one sheet-metal tank per drone, a glazed cabin holding this controller. Launches one robotic drone per pad toward gas pockets (radar, filters, “Marked” mode). The tier cuts flight costs.
description.pioneers.solar_absorber_casi: Hollow box from 5 x 3 x 5 to 13 x 5 x 13, orbiting a star: casing edges, the whole top face in collectors, a controller in a side wall.
description.pioneers.solar_absorber_coll: On the top face of the absorber: each collector adds power.
description.pioneers.solar_absorber_port: Energy comes out of every port; with the wrench: cold coolant input or hot coolant output.
universe.pioneers.galaxy.spiral.desc: Arms of young stars: stardust (and sometimes dark matter).
universe.pioneers.galaxy.elliptical.desc: Old stars and neutron stars: neutronium.
universe.pioneers.galaxy.irregular.desc: Clusters, gas and dark matter halos.
universe.pioneers.galaxy.quasar.desc: A supermassive black hole and its jets: quasar crystals. Very hungry.

solar_absorber.pioneers.status.no_sky: Collectors in the shade: they need open sky

jei.pioneers.drone_harvest.trip: Per drone trip. Pockets: 4,000 to 12,000 mB of gas, or 4 to 12 crystals.
jei.pioneers.drone_harvest.storm: Storm layer: armored drone required (otherwise struck by lightning). %s%% rich pockets.
jei.pioneers.absorber.coolant: Coolant at full power: %s mB/t of ammonia
jei.pioneers.absorber.flare: Solar flare: output up to ×3. At 1,600 °C without coolant, the shutters close.
jei.pioneers.info.aerostat_kit: Inside a gas giant, right-click: deploys a 9×9 aerostat under your feet (landing pad in the middle). Only in clouds or open air. Every aerostat becomes an arrival point for capsules.
jei.pioneers.info.gas_scanner: Right-click in the air: reveals gas pockets within 96 blocks for 10 seconds and sums them up. Right-click a pocket: marks it for the drones (priority; the only target in "Marked" mode).
jei.pioneers.info.drone_armor_plating: One plating per drone, in the bay's slot: drones descend into the storm layer without being struck by lightning and carry 1,500 mB or 6 crystals.
jei.pioneers.info.metallic_hydrogen: Harvested in the storms of Jupiter and Saturn. T12 and T13 rocket parts, singularity cell; gives 4,000 mB of hydrogen in a gas machine.
jei.pioneers.info.rain_diamond: Harvested in the storms of Uranus and Neptune. The enrichment chamber turns one into 2 diamonds.
jei.pioneers.info.void_singularity_cell: A bottled singularity (gravity compressor). Heart of T13 rockets and ignition of the Universe Simulator (Big Bang).
jei.pioneers.info.stardust: Made by the Universe Simulator (mostly spiral galaxies). Compacts into a block; goes into the quasar lamp.
jei.pioneers.info.dark_matter: Made by the Universe Simulator (irregular galaxies and quasars). Compacts into a block; goes into the neutronium drill head.
jei.pioneers.info.neutronium_ingot: Made by the Universe Simulator (elliptical galaxies and quasars). Neutronium drill head, the fastest for mining rovers.
jei.pioneers.info.quasar_crystal: The rarest product of the Universe Simulator: only quasars yield it. Goes into the quasar lamp.
rocket.pioneers.aborted: Mission aborted: returning to the ground by capsule
map.pioneers.locked: In orbit: pick a destination, or abort the mission (bottom left)
research.pioneers.tree.view_only: View only: start research from a research lab
solar_simulator.pioneers.formation.missi: A ring block is missing around the shell (at %1$s). The structure projector shows where it goes.
lightning_collector.pioneers.incomplete: Incomplete: %1$s to %2$s conductors on top, then a lightning rod (pointing up)
lightning_collector.pioneers.no_sky: The tip must see the sky
robotics.pioneers.kind.drone.desc: The fastest, flies over everything; small cargo bay, slow at work. Hub set to “drones”.
robotics.pioneers.kind.robot.desc: The worker: harvests, fells, mines and digs three times faster. Hub set to “robots”.
robotics.pioneers.kind.rover.desc: Slow, but a colossal cargo bay (54 stacks, 512,000 mB): bulk transport. Hub set to “rovers”.
description.pioneers.robotic_casing: Building block of the Robotic Hub: a 3 × 3 × 3 cube. The eight corners must be casings; the rest can be casings, glass (plain or structural), ports or bay doors; the center stays empty. The kind of units (drones, robots, rovers or turtles) is chosen in its interface.
description.pioneers.robotic_port: Feeds the hub with energy and exposes its buffer (pipes, conveyors). On a face of the hub.
description.pioneers.robotic_bay: Units leave and come back through here; its shutters open on every pass. At least one per hub, on a side (or the middle of the roof for drones).
robotic_hub.pioneers.formation.size: A robotic hub is a 3 × 3 × 3 cube
robotic_hub.pioneers.formation.no_bay: At least one bay door is required
robotic_hub.pioneers.formation.bay_side: Misplaced bay door at %1$s: on a side or at the center of the roof, never underneath
item.pioneers.robotic_bay_module.desc: +5 slots in a robotic hub (3 modules at most: 5 to 20 units).
robotics.pioneers.task.logistics.desc: Moves items, fluids, gases or data between two blocks.
robotics.pioneers.task.farmer.desc: Harvests ripe crops and replants (seeds from the harvest).
robotics.pioneers.task.lumberjack.desc: Fells trees with a laser and replants a sapling (harvest or providers).
robotics.pioneers.task.miner.desc: Extracts ores under the area, down to the bottom of the world.
robotics.pioneers.task.excavator.desc: Digs the whole volume of the area, layer by layer.
robotics.pioneers.task.collector.desc: Picks up items on the ground.
robotics.pioneers.task.breeder.desc: Feeds animals (food from providers) without exceeding 12 per species.
robotics.pioneers.task.hunter.desc: Hunts monsters and surplus herd animals.
robotics.pioneers.marker.provider.desc: A reserve made available: you fill it yourself (by hand, pipes, hoppers), never the network. Units only take from it last, when storage and buffer surplus no longer have the resource. Filter: only these resources may be taken.
robotics.pioneers.marker.unload.desc: An output emptied as fast as possible (machine, collection, filled by pipes or hoppers): as soon as it holds something, a unit takes it to a requester that lacks it, otherwise to the nearest storage.
robotics.pioneers.marker.storage.desc: Long-term warehouse: it receives everything units bring back, and it is where they take from first to deliver. With a filter, it only receives those resources, but comes before unfiltered storage.
robotics.pioneers.marker.requester.desc: Only asks: for each resource in its list, as soon as it has less than the desired level, a unit fetches the difference (storage first, then buffer surplus, then providers). It never gives anything.
robotics.pioneers.marker.place: Place it on any face of the block; its settings open on placement (then right-click, or remotely on the map).
robotics.pioneers.assign.auto.tooltip: The best candidate: kind suited to the task, tier, distance and carrying capacity.
robotics.pioneers.edit.mode.tooltip: One-off: delivers the amount then stops. Recurring: runs continuously, or keeps the target at the desired level.
robotics.pioneers.edit.item.tooltip: Click: pick · Shift + click: whole family
robotics.pioneers.edit.amount.recurring: to keep in the target (0: continuous)
robotics.pioneers.edit.network.tooltip: Take the resource from providers, unload points, buffers or storage (specific resource)
robotics.pioneers.edit.aim.tooltip: The menu closes: aim at a block face and press the orders key
robotics.pioneers.edit.max_units.tooltip: Maximum number of units on this order at once
robotics.pioneers.edit.invalid: Missing target, amount, a specific resource for a “network” source, or the condition's resource
robotics.pioneers.picker.title: Pick a resource
robotics.pioneers.picker.hint: %1$s results · your inventory first · scroll to browse
item.pioneers.zone_planner.desc: Right-click in the air: the 3D planner in free view. Right-click two opposite corners: an area between them. Sneak: clear. While held: shows areas, orders and markers.
robotics.pioneers.planner.first: First corner: %1$s — click the opposite corner
robotics.pioneers.zone.invalid: Area too large (%1$s blocks wide, %2$s high at most)
robotics.pioneers.marker.buffer.desc: A local interface: it keeps the minimum level it requests, units working nearby unload into it (as into storage, whichever is closest), and the network quietly empties everything else into storage. It only gives away that surplus, never its required resources.
robotics.pioneers.marker.desc: Turns a chest or machine into a point of the logistic network: role, access face, resources (items, fluids, gases, energy, data).
robotics.pioneers.chest.desc: %1$s slots, built-in logistic point (storage by default). Shift + right-click with an empty hand: settings.
block.pioneers.robotic_road.desc: Ground units drive 50%% faster on it (rovers: 80%%).
description.pioneers.robotic_relay: Extends the logistic network (24 blocks around) and recharges passing units in a few seconds.
robotics.pioneers.relay.hint: Touching relays form a single network.
robotics.pioneers.point.title: Logistic point
robotics.pioneers.point.name: Name
robotics.pioneers.point.side.auto.toolti: The face the marker is placed on
robotics.pioneers.point.priority.tooltip: Priority points are served (and emptied) first.
robotics.pioneers.point.requests.hint: The level to keep in the block, for each resource. Click an icon: change it.
robotics.pioneers.point.filter.hint: Empty list: anything goes. Click an icon: change it.
robotics.pioneers.point.machine.tooltip: Keeps the machine input full with what it already holds (no list needed).
robotics.pioneers.point.condition.toolti: Only work while the network has less (or more) than this amount of the chosen resource. Click: change.
robotics.pioneers.upgrade.for_hub: For a robotic hub (all of its units)
robotics.pioneers.map.title: Logistic map
robotics.pioneers.map.tool.select.toolti: Click a point, hub, unit, area or transport: its details on the right. Drag: move the map.
robotics.pioneers.map.tool.zone.tooltip: Free view to select a work area (farming, logging, breeding…)
robotics.pioneers.map.tool.transfer.tool: Reserved shuttle between two blocks (machine → machine, fluids, data…). Click the source (a point, or empty ground for the network), then the target. Not needed for provider → requester: the network delivers on its own.
robotics.pioneers.map.hint.select: Click: pick (and set up) a point, hub, unit or area · drag: move the map · wheel: zoom
robotics.pioneers.map.hint.zone: Drag to outline the area, or click: the 3D planner opens
robotics.pioneers.map.hint.transfer_sour: Click the source (or empty ground: network)
robotics.pioneers.map.orders_hint: Area and Dedicated line tools at the top
robotics.pioneers.map.no_network: No network here: place a hub or a relay
robotics.pioneers.alert.no_source: Resource not found on the network
robotics.pioneers.hub.kind.locked: Empty the hub (and recall its units) to change kind
robotics.pioneers.point.entry_side.hint: The face this resource goes in or out through (e.g., redstone through the back, iron through the top)
robotics.pioneers.picker.tags.tooltip: Item families: all logs, all ores, all iron ingots…
robotics.pioneers.zone.herd.tooltip: Animals are always fed; beyond this limit, surplus adults are put down by laser. Shift: ±10.
robotics.pioneers.kind.turtle.desc: Slow, but very energy-efficient, quick at work and roomy. Rest mode: between jobs, it sleeps on its area without using energy instead of going home. Hub set to “turtles”.
robotics.pioneers.kind.rover.machine: Also: mining rover of a rover garage (the tier sets battery, cargo, speed and drilling)
robotics.pioneers.kind.turtle.machine: Also: gardener of the space greenhouse (the tier speeds up planting, harvesting and moving)
robotics.pioneers.kind.drone.machine: Also: harvesting drone of a drone bay (the tier sets speed, suction rate and payload)
research.pioneers.node.robotics.desc: Autonomous machines to work for us, from lunar regolith to the clouds of giants.
research.pioneers.node.robotics.effect: Blueprints for every robotic unit (drones, robots, rovers, turtles), all tiers
robotics.pioneers.planner.view.frame.too: Fits the area in the view
robotics.pioneers.planner.view.top.toolt: Top view, north up (like the map); click again for the perspective view
robotics.pioneers.planner.hint.dragging: Release to confirm · Ctrl + Z to undo
robotics.pioneers.planner.empty: Select the area: drag on the terrain, or click two opposite corners
robotics.pioneers.planner.stat.unknown: Part of the area is too far away to be counted
robotics.pioneers.planner.stat.no_networ: Outside the logistic network: no hub or relay covers the area
robotics.pioneers.zone.hunt.animals.tool: Only surplus animals (beyond the kept herd)
robotics.pioneers.zone.rest.tooltip: Between jobs, turtles sleep on the area instead of returning to the hub, using no energy, and wake up as soon as there is work. Ideal for slow tasks: crops, breeding.
robotics.pioneers.edit.change_hint: click: change · Shift + click: whole family
robotics.pioneers.edit.aim.short: Aim at the block in the world
robotics.pioneers.edit.problem.network_f: From the network, a specific resource (or a tag) is needed
robotics.pioneers.edit.problem.same: The source and target are the same face
robotics.pioneers.planner.view.copy.tool: Copies the area: its task, settings, size and depth below ground
robotics.pioneers.planner.view.paste.too: Places copies of the area: click on the terrain, as many times as you like
robotics.pioneers.planner.switch.dirty: Save or cancel the current area first
robotics.pioneers.planner.paste.hint: Pasting: click on the terrain to place a copy (%s placed) · Ctrl + V to stop
robotics.pioneers.planner.hint.paste: Click: place a copy · right-click: look · Ctrl + V: stop
robotics.pioneers.planner.hint.free_draw: Drag or click two corners to select · WASD, space, Shift: fly · right-click: look · wheel: move forward
robotics.pioneers.planner.hint.free_edit: Pull the handles · WASD, space, Shift: fly · right-click: look · Ctrl + C / Ctrl + V: copy / paste · Enter: save
robotics.pioneers.map.alerts.clear.toolt: Clears the alerts; they do not come back for 30 minutes if the problem persists
robotics.pioneers.task.steps.breeder: fetch food → feed pairs → put down the surplus
robotics.pioneers.alert.no_carrier: Delivery waiting: no free carrier unit
robotics.pioneers.planner.corner_hint: First corner set: click the opposite corner (or drag) · Esc: cancel
robotics.pioneers.planner.tool.select.to: Drag on the terrain, or click two opposite corners; then pull the handles to stretch each face (the yellow handle moves everything, Shift: vertically)
robotics.pioneers.planner.tool.paste.too: Places copies: one click on the terrain per copy
robotics.pioneers.planner.tool.road.tool: Click waypoints: the route follows the path ground units would take (existing roads preferred)
robotics.pioneers.planner.view.preview.t: Shows the result of the build: red for what is removed, ghosts for what is placed
robotics.pioneers.works.empty: Select a volume to clear, draw a road (R) or paste a blueprint (Ctrl + V)
robotics.pioneers.works.paste_hint: Click: pin the paste here (then adjust it) · Shift + click: place directly · X: rotate · Ctrl + V: stop
robotics.pioneers.works.road_next: Road: %s tiles · click: next point · Shift + click: move the end · Enter: confirm
robotics.pioneers.works.hint.select: Selection: drag or two clicks · handles to stretch · Delete: clear · Ctrl + C: copy · H: preview · Enter: launch
robotics.pioneers.works.hint.road: Road: click the start then the end, fine-tune them in the panel · right-click a point: remove it · Enter: confirm
robotics.pioneers.works.hint.paste: Paste: click to pin, arrows and Page Up / Page Down to adjust, Enter to place · Shift + click: place directly · X: rotate
robotics.pioneers.works.select_hint: Drag on the terrain, or click two opposite corners; then stretch the faces with the handles.
robotics.pioneers.works.clear.tooltip: Adds a step: everything in the selection is removed (units bring the blocks back)
robotics.pioneers.works.copy.tooltip: Copies the selection as it will be after the planned steps, to paste it elsewhere
robotics.pioneers.works.road_info: Set the start and the end: the gentlest route is computed (limited slope, minimal earthwork, switchbacks if needed), then shown as ghosts before you confirm. Ground units then follow the road.
robotics.pioneers.works.road_broken: No path between some points: straight line (construction will level it, but check the preview)
robotics.pioneers.works.paste_air.toolti: The pasted volume replaces everything in it (otherwise only the blueprint's blocks are placed)
robotics.pioneers.works.no_steps: No steps yet: clear a selection, draw a road or paste a blueprint.
robotics.pioneers.works.truncated: Very large site: the preview only shows part of it
robotics.pioneers.works.materials: Materials to supply (taken from the network):
robotics.pioneers.works.launch.tooltip: Units first remove everything in the way, top to bottom, then place bottom to top, with materials from the network
robotics.pioneers.works.launch.invalid: Add at least one step (site at most 192 blocks wide and 128 high)
robotics.pioneers.map.tool.works.tooltip: Free view to plan a build: clear, lay roads, copy-paste builds
robotics.pioneers.task.builder.desc: Carries out planned construction: removals, roads, copied builds.
robotics.pioneers.task.steps.builder: remove (top → bottom) → bring materials → place (bottom → top)
robotics.pioneers.unit_screen.title: Unit Details
robotics.pioneers.unit_screen.name: Name
robotics.pioneers.unit_screen.recall.too: Drops its job (another unit takes over) and goes home; its cargo is emptied into the hub.
robotics.pioneers.order.status.waiting.h: The scheduler will assign a unit in a moment.
robotics.pioneers.order.status.no_hub.hi: No hub or relay covers this work: place a robotic relay near the area (or the target).
robotics.pioneers.order.status.no_source: Nothing to take: fill the source, or add a provider / storage holding the resource.
robotics.pioneers.order.status.target_fu: The target accepts nothing more: empty it or check its input face.
robotics.pioneers.order.status.no_suppli: Supplies are missing (food, saplings, materials): put them in a provider chest or a network storage.
robotics.pioneers.order.status.invalid.h: Some information is missing (target, resource, bounds): open the order to complete it.
robotics.pioneers.order.status.condition: The network stock condition is not met: the order will resume on its own.
robotics.pioneers.order.status.nothing_t: No work found in the area (crops not ripe, nothing to collect…): units will head out again as soon as there is some.
robotics.pioneers.order.status.target_ok: The target is already at the desired level: the line resumes when it drops.
The hubs that can take this order are empty (or of another kind): add units to a hub.
robotics.pioneers.order.status.units_bus: They are all out on other jobs: add units, or give this order a high priority.
robotics.pioneers.order.status.units_cha: Docked units are recharging (50%% minimum to leave): they will head out on their own.
robotics.pioneers.order.status.hub_no_en: The hub lacks the energy to launch a unit: connect it to a power source.
robotics.pioneers.order.status.no_hub_ma: The chosen assignment (unit kind or specific hub) matches no hub of the network: pick “Auto”.
robotics.pioneers.order.status.unreachab: Ground units cannot reach this work: a drone hub is needed.
robotics.pioneers.order.status.paused.hi: Resume the order to send units back to it.
robotics.pioneers.point.who: Who carries it? The best-suited free unit of the network (a drone for a small parcel, a rover for a big volume), twice a second. No free unit: the “Delivery waiting” alert shows on the map.
robotics.pioneers.works.paste_pin: Click: pin the paste there, then fine-tune it block by block. Shift + click: place directly.
robotics.pioneers.works.paste_nudge: Arrows: X / Z · Page Up / Page Down: height · X: rotate · Esc: unpin
robotics.pioneers.works.paste_pinned: Paste pinned: adjust (arrows, Page Up / Page Down, panel) then Enter to place · click elsewhere to move it
block.pioneers.logistic_terminal.desc: Order any item from the network: units deliver it to the terminal's reserve. Right-click: order · sneak: the reserve.
robotics.pioneers.terminal.click: Click: 1 · Shift + click: a stack · right-click: 16
robotics.pioneers.terminal.empty: The network holds nothing (storage, buffers, providers)
robotics.pioneers.terminal.hint: Units deliver orders into the terminal's reserve (sneak + right-click, or the button). Nine different items on order at most.
robotics.pioneers.terminal.no_orders: No orders. Click an item on the left.
robotics.pioneers.terminal.open.tooltip: Delivered items wait for you here
robotics.pioneers.works.paste_extras: With %1$s configured logistic points and %2$s work areas (created when construction is done)
robotics.pioneers.zone.replant.farm.tool: Units replant after harvesting and till the damaged tiles of the field (dirt, grass, path)
robotics.pioneers.zone.replant.wood.tool: Units plant a sapling in place of every felled tree
robotics.pioneers.zone.plant.tooltip: Choose what units plant (they take it from the network)
robotics.pioneers.map.passive.tooltip: How many units of each kind may serve the passive network at once: supplying requesters, buffers and terminals, emptying unload points and buffer surplus. 0: this kind only works orders and areas. Lowering the limit lets units already out finish their delivery, then go home.
robotics.pioneers.works.road_blocks: %s blocks to place (surface and fill), shown as ghosts
robotics.pioneers.works.road_fill.toolti: Fills the space under the road down to the first terrain block with the chosen block (otherwise the road runs as a bridge)
robotics.pioneers.works.road_other.toolt: Pick any block from the item list
robotics.pioneers.works.road_slope.toolt: 1/2: the road climbs one block every two tiles at most. The gentler the slope, the longer the road; if the height to gain is too much for the distance, it winds in switchbacks.
robotics.pioneers.works.road_switchback: Too steep for a straight line: at least %s tiles needed, the road will wind
robotics.pioneers.works.tool.road.toolti: Set a start and an end: the gentlest road is computed (switchbacks if the slope is too steep), with optional fill
robotics.pioneers.task.apiarist.desc: Breeds bees (flowers from the network) up to 3 per hive in the area, and harvests full hives: honeycombs or honey bottles.
robotics.pioneers.task.steps.apiarist: fetch flowers and bottles → feed bee pairs → harvest full hives
robotics.pioneers.zone.honey.tooltip: Share of harvests as honeycombs; the rest as honey bottles (empty bottles needed in the network, otherwise combs). Bees never get angry.
robotics.pioneers.map.filters.tooltip: Choose what shows on the map, type by type
robotics.pioneers.zone.name: Name
robotics.pioneers.map.repairs.title: Repairs
robotics.pioneers.map.repairs.tooltip: Stewards put back blocks destroyed by explosions (creepers, meteors…) within network coverage, with materials from the network. Destroyed chests and machines are not put back.
robotics.pioneers.map.alerts.auto: Alerts clear by themselves once the problem is solved (delivery made, space freed, power back).
robotics.pioneers.map.alerts.recurring.t: This alert cleared and then came back soon after: the problem is structural (chronic shortage, storage too small, too few units…).
robotics.pioneers.plans.title: Blueprint library
robotics.pioneers.plans.empty: No blueprints yet. Copy a build (Ctrl + C) then “Save to library”.
robotics.pioneers.plans.pick: Pick a blueprint from the list: you can use it (it becomes the copy to paste), rename, duplicate or delete it.
robotics.pioneers.plans.name: Blueprint name
robotics.pioneers.plans.use.tooltip: The blueprint becomes the copy to paste (Paste tool)
robotics.pioneers.plans.save_current.too: Saves the planner's copy as a new blueprint
robotics.pioneers.plans.save_current.non: No current copy: copy a build first (Ctrl + C)
robotics.pioneers.plans.save_current.sav: The current copy is already a saved blueprint
robotics.pioneers.plans.folder: Open the blueprint folder (to share them: .nbt files)
robotics.pioneers.plans.save.tooltip: Keeps this copy as a blueprint, reusable in all your worlds
robotics.pioneers.plans.update.tooltip: Saves the changes into the original blueprint
robotics.pioneers.plans.eraser.tooltip: Click a ghost block: it leaves the copy · drag: several · Shift + click: every block of that type · Ctrl + Z: undo
robotics.pioneers.plans.eraser_on: Eraser: click or drag over blocks to remove from the copy · Shift + click: that whole type · E: stop
robotics.pioneers.plans.eraser_pin: Pin the paste first (click the terrain) to erase its blocks
robotics.pioneers.plans.trim.tooltip: Removes empty borders: the copy shrinks to its blocks
robotics.pioneers.plans.no_air.tooltip: The paste will no longer clear anything: it only places its blocks
robotics.pioneers.planner.view.plans.too: Blueprint library: save, reuse, rename, share
robotic_hub.pioneers.formation.center: The hub's center must stay empty (%s)
robotic_hub.pioneers.formation.corner: The eight corners must be robotic casings (%s)
robotic_hub.pioneers.formation.invalid: Block not allowed in the wall (%s): casing, port, bay door or glass
robotic_hub.pioneers.formation.taken: This block already belongs to another hub (%s)
description.pioneers.air_compressor: Compresses air using energy: the pressure source for the logistic cable (pressure channel) and air tanks.
block.pioneers.air_compressor.rate: %s L of air per tick for %s FE/t
description.pioneers.electric_heater: Turns energy into heat (1 FE = 1 J): the heat source for the logistic cable (heat channel) and heat buffers.
block.pioneers.electric_heater.rate: Up to %s FE/t turned into heat, up to %s K
item.pioneers.wrench.tooltip: Right-click a cable: cut or restore the targeted side; Shift + right-click: the network diagram
gui.pioneers.machine.eject_tip: Pushes contents out of output sides
description.pioneers.basic_crusher: Raw ore → 3 crushed ores, stone → gravel → sand. Every recipe of the grinding family (millstone, jaw crusher, steam macerator), twice as fast per tier; fine grinding (crushed ore → dust, ingot → dust).
description.pioneers.advanced_crusher: Raw ore → 3 crushed ores, stone → gravel → sand. Every recipe of the grinding family (millstone, jaw crusher, steam macerator), twice as fast per tier; fine grinding (crushed ore → dust, ingot → dust).
description.pioneers.elite_crusher: Raw ore → 3 crushed ores, stone → gravel → sand. Every recipe of the grinding family (millstone, jaw crusher, steam macerator), twice as fast per tier; fine grinding (crushed ore → dust, ingot → dust).
description.pioneers.ultimate_crusher: Raw ore → 3 crushed ores, stone → gravel → sand. Every recipe of the grinding family (millstone, jaw crusher, steam macerator), twice as fast per tier; fine grinding (crushed ore → dust, ingot → dust).
description.pioneers.basic_furnace: Smelts: ores, dusts and food; 1 input, 1 output.
description.pioneers.advanced_furnace: Smelts: ores, dusts and food; 1 input, 1 output.
description.pioneers.elite_furnace: Smelts: ores, dusts and food; 1 input, 1 output.
description.pioneers.ultimate_furnace: Smelts: ores, dusts and food; 1 input, 1 output.
description.pioneers.basic_compressor: Compacts and agglomerates: scrap bales, bonded pellets, green compacts, briquettes, ices and regoliths.
description.pioneers.advanced_compressor: Compacts and agglomerates: scrap bales, bonded pellets, green compacts, briquettes, ices and regoliths.
description.pioneers.elite_compressor: Compacts and agglomerates: scrap bales, bonded pellets, green compacts, briquettes, ices and regoliths.
description.pioneers.ultimate_compressor: Compacts and agglomerates: scrap bales, bonded pellets, green compacts, briquettes, ices and regoliths.
gui.pioneers.chunk_loader.preview: Show the loaded chunks in the world
gui.pioneers.force_field.visibility_tip: The field still protects when hidden
gui.pioneers.machine.side_type_tip: Click: configure the sides for this resource
gui.pioneers.machine.eject_auto_tip: Pushes this resource to neighbors on output sides
gui.pioneers.machine.sides_clear_tip: Closes every side for this resource
tooltip.pioneers.gas_capsule.empty: Empty — right-click a gas tank to draw 1 B
description.pioneers.rocket_tier_1: %1$s mB of liquid hydrogen, 3 module slots. Reaches the Moon. Place it on a launch complex; a crew cabin module is needed for a crewed flight.
description.pioneers.rocket_tier_2: %1$s mB of liquid hydrogen, 3 module slots. Reaches Mars, Phobos and Deimos. Place it on a launch complex; a crew cabin module is needed for a crewed flight.
description.pioneers.rocket_tier_3: %1$s mB of liquid hydrogen, 4 module slots. Reaches Venus. Place it on a launch complex; a crew cabin module is needed for a crewed flight.
mining.pioneers.name: Rover name
launch_pad.pioneers.name: Station name
launch_pad.pioneers.slot.fuel_in: Propellant container (kerolox, hydrolox, liquid hydrogen, fusion propellant)
description.pioneers.space_stabilizer_ca: Space Stabilizer casing: an 11x11x11 globe with a core at its center. The outline of each face must be casing.
description.pioneers.space_stabilizer_gl: Space Stabilizer glass. Connects to itself into large seamless panes.
description.pioneers.space_stabilizer_po: Input (water (placeholder) or lava) or output (product, pushed to neighbors). Sneak + right-click with a wrench to switch.

Required at the center of each of the 6 faces (emitter right behind), plus as many as you like elsewhere in the wall. Each port stores 200M FE; all share one reserve: the field draws from it and ignition takes 1G FE at once.
description.pioneers.space_stabilizer_em: Six emitters, one behind each power port (sides, top and bottom), project the field that holds the star. If the reserve runs dry, the star collapses.
description.pioneers.singularity_core: Space Stabilizer core: placed at the exact center of the globe, it is consumed on ignition to birth a black hole turning water (placeholder) into Void Singularity.
stabilizer.pioneers.rate.tooltip: Rate from %s to %s: fuel, energy and output scale with it
stabilizer.pioneers.scram.tooltip: Emergency stop: the star collapses and must be re-ignited
stabilizer.pioneers.field.tooltip: All power ports share one common reserve
stabilizer.pioneers.error.no_core: No core at the center of the globe (Singularity Core or Stellar Core)
stabilizer.pioneers.error.wall: Incomplete wall: the outline must be casing, the rest casing, glass or ports
stabilizer.pioneers.error.inside: The inside must be empty (except the core and the 6 emitters)
stabilizer.pioneers.error.missing_power_: Missing power port at the center of this face
stabilizer.pioneers.error.missing_emitte: Missing emitter behind the power port
stabilizer.pioneers.title: Space Stabilizer
stabilizer.pioneers.core.spent: Core consumed: right-click the wall with a new core
stabilizer.pioneers.core.loaded: %s placed at the center of the stabilizer
stabilizer.pioneers.core.busy: Shut the star down first (SCRAM) to change cores
description.pioneers.space_simulator_cas: Shell of the Space Simulator: a perfectly round globe 25 blocks across (glass and ports accepted anywhere).
description.pioneers.space_simulator_gla: Glass for the Space Simulator shell.
description.pioneers.space_simulator_por: Input (energy, solar plasma) or output (products, pushed into neighboring inventories). Sneak + right-click with a wrench to switch.
description.pioneers.space_rift_projecto: Keeper of the space-time rift: one at the center of each of the globe's 6 faces, it opens and holds the space bubble.
description.pioneers.supreme_space_coil: The energy ring around the globe's equator, linked to it by four spokes. When running, it vanishes under a torrent of energy.
description.pioneers.space_simulator_con: Goes in the shell, at the bottom center of a side face, front facing out. Choose the mode there: solar system or galaxy.
space_simulator.pioneers.title: Space Simulator
space_simulator.pioneers.status.no_core: Core missing or not matching the mode
space_simulator.pioneers.core.hint: Put a Stellar Core (solar system) or a Void Singularity Cell (galaxy) in the core slot.
space_simulator.pioneers.core.tooltip: Core: Stellar Core or Void Singularity Cell
space_simulator.pioneers.error.wall: Incomplete shell: casing, glass or port
space_simulator.pioneers.error.missing_p: Rift projector missing at the center of this face
space_simulator.pioneers.error.inside: The inside of the globe must be empty
space_simulator.pioneers.error.missing_c: Incomplete ring: supreme space coil missing
space_simulator.pioneers.error.no_contro: No controller: place it in the shell, at the bottom center of a side face
space_simulator.pioneers.error.rib: Casing rib: the equator and both face meridians must be casing
space_simulator.pioneers.mode.tooltip: Mode: solar system (Sol.) or galaxy (Gal.) — no core needed
space_simulator.pioneers.mode.tooltip.co: The core must match: Stellar Core or Void Singularity Cell
space_simulator.pioneers.core.hint.solar: Solar system mode: put a Stellar Core in the core slot.
space_simulator.pioneers.core.hint.galax: Galaxy mode: put a Void Singularity Cell in the core slot.
description.pioneers.space_stabilizer_co: Goes at the bottom center of a side face of the Stabilizer. Checks the structure; put a core in its slot: it places it in the chamber itself.
stabilizer.pioneers.error.missing_contro: Controller missing: bottom center of a side face
stabilizer.pioneers.error.misplaced_cont: Misplaced controller (only one, bottom center of a side face)
stabilizer.pioneers.controller.ready: Structure valid: put a core in the controller's slot
stabilizer.pioneers.controller.use: Put the core in the controller's slot
stabilizer.pioneers.controller.title: Stabilizer controller
stabilizer.pioneers.controller.waiting: Waiting for a core: put it in the slot, it will be placed in the chamber
stabilizer.pioneers.controller.spent: Core spent: a new core in the slot will replace it (star off)
stabilizer.pioneers.controller.slot: Core: placed automatically in the chamber
description.pioneers.solar_absorber_cont: In a side wall of the box (not on an edge), facing outward: checks the structure, holds the energy and coolant. One per absorber.
solar_absorber.pioneers.error.size: A 5 × 3 × 5 to 13 × 5 × 13 box is expected around the controller
solar_absorber.pioneers.error.wall: Incomplete wall: casing or port expected
solar_absorber.pioneers.error.inside: The inside of the box must be empty
solar_absorber.pioneers.error.controller: The controller goes in a side wall, not on an edge, with the inside behind it
solar_absorber.pioneers.error.no_control: No controller: place one in a side wall
block.pioneers.hand_crank.desc: Place it on a shaft end and hold right-click to turn. About 90 W, at the cost of hunger.
block.pioneers.wooden_shaft.desc: Carries rotation in a straight line.
block.pioneers.iron_shaft.desc: Carries rotation in a straight line; four times as strong as wood.
block.pioneers.wooden_cog.desc: Meshes with a neighboring cog (1:1, reversed) or diagonally with a cogwheel.
block.pioneers.wooden_cogwheel.desc: Large cogwheel: a diagonal cog turns twice as fast (1:2).
block.pioneers.iron_cog.desc: Meshes with a neighboring cog (1:1, reversed) or diagonally with a cogwheel.
block.pioneers.iron_cogwheel.desc: Large iron cogwheel (1:2 with a cog).
block.pioneers.gearbox.desc: All six faces turn together: rotation changes direction.
block.pioneers.gearshift.desc: Input on the negative end of the axis, output on the other. Right-click: slider interface, ratio from ×¼ to ×4 (the wrench steps to the next one). Redstone: direct drive.
block.pioneers.clutch.desc: A redstone signal disengages the output. Right-click: speeds and state.
block.pioneers.reverser.desc: A redstone signal reverses the output. Right-click: speeds and state.
block.pioneers.stone_flywheel.desc: Stores rotational energy and smooths out jolts.
block.pioneers.iron_flywheel.desc: Three times the inertia of stone.
block.pioneers.tachometer.desc: Shows the speed, dial turned toward you when placed; comparator: 1 level per 10 rpm.
block.pioneers.dynamometer.desc: Shows the network load, dial turned toward you when placed; comparator: load (15 = overload).
block.pioneers.governor.desc: Brakes above the target speed and emits a redstone signal. Right-click: slider from 5 to 120 rpm (the wrench steps to the next notch).
kinetics.pioneers.info.jammed: Jammed: two contradictory ratios on the same loop
tooltip.pioneers.workshop_tool: Workshop tool: stays in the grid and wears out with each recipe
block.pioneers.windmill_hub.desc: Add sails with right-click (4 or 8), set length with a wrench (3 to 7 blocks). Keep the sail plane clear; higher means more wind.
block.pioneers.water_wheel.desc: 3 blocks across. Flowing water against its paddles turns it; a waterfall on one side is worth 2.5 times more.
block.pioneers.large_water_wheel.desc: 5 blocks across: slower, much more torque.
block.pioneers.horse_mill.desc: Bring a leashed animal and click: it walks in circles (radius 3). A nearby trough feeds it. Sneak + click with an empty hand: unhitch.
block.pioneers.feeding_trough.desc: Wheat or hay for the horse mill's animals.
block.pioneers.weather_vane.desc: Shows the wind here; comparator: 1 level per m/s.
item.pioneers.canvas_sail.desc: Light, Cp 0.15; may tear in thunderstorms.
kinetics.pioneers.windmill.full: Hub full, or sails of another kind
kinetics.pioneers.windmill.blocked: Sails blocked: clear the sail plane
kinetics.pioneers.info.windmill: %s sails of %s blocks, wind %s m/s, up to %s
kinetics.pioneers.spec.windmill: 1 to 20 kW depending on wind, height and sails
kinetics.pioneers.horse_mill.help: Harnessed: %s / %s. Bring a leashed horse, donkey, mule or cow.
kinetics.pioneers.spec.horse_mill: About 790 W per horse, up to 4 animals
kinetics.pioneers.vane.reading: Wind: %s m/s, air %s kg/m³: a 5-block windmill would get %s
block.pioneers.small_pulley.desc: Radius-1 pulley; up to 4 ropes, if everything turns the same way. Vertical axis: warehouse relay, and the STATION of a crate or a counter placed below (up to 8 blocks lower, clear column).
block.pioneers.pulley.desc: Radius-2 pulley: the radius ratio sets the speed; up to 4 ropes, if everything turns the same way.
block.pioneers.large_pulley.desc: Radius-3 pulley: gears down for more torque.
block.pioneers.winch.desc: Water below: a well (1 bucket per trip). A chest at the bottom: a lift (16 items into the chest on top of the winch).
item.pioneers.fiber_rope.desc: Between two pulleys: 800 N·m, 92% efficiency. Click one pulley, then the other; Sneak: crossed strands (reversed).
item.pioneers.tarred_rope.desc: Soaked in creosote: 2,000 N·m, 93% efficiency, wears far less.
block.pioneers.millstone.desc: Driven by a vertical shaft from below. Grinds wheat into flour, as well as bones, flint and ore fragments.
block.pioneers.mechanical_sifter.desc: Sifts gravel, sand and dirt: ore fragments, flakes, flint. Its fiber screen is built into the frame: nothing to add.
block.pioneers.jaw_crusher.desc: Crushes stone into gravel, gravel into sand, ore into chunks. Heavy torque.
block.pioneers.mechanical_saw.desc: Cuts logs into 6 planks (and sawdust). Fast and easy.
block.pioneers.wood_lathe.desc: Turns sticks, pegs and round parts. Very fast.
block.pioneers.bellows.desc: Blows into the furnace or blast furnace in front of it: it smelts twice as fast.
block.pioneers.noria.desc: Placed above water, it lifts 1 source per second into the block above, or into a tank. A wooden fluid buffer placed on top hooks onto it.
block.pioneers.beam_engine.desc: The first steam engine: brick boiler, water and fuel. Up to 20,000 N·m once steam is up (~12 kW).
block.pioneers.hand_sieve.desc: Fit a mesh, pour in gravel or sand, then shake (repeated right-clicks).
block.pioneers.alluvial_gravel.desc: River gravel, also made by crushing tuff. Sifted: copper and tin (malachite, cassiterite), gold flakes, clay.
block.pioneers.black_sand.desc: Heavy beach sand, laden with magnetite and cassiterite.
block.pioneers.charred_log_pile.desc: Smothered wood: break it for charcoal.
block.pioneers.ash_layer.desc: What's left of a poorly covered charcoal pile.
block.pioneers.clay_drain.desc: Under a charcoal pit, it collects the creosote seeping from the wood (empty bucket: right-click).
item.pioneers.plant_fiber.desc: Knife in hand on tall grass, or at the carpenter’s bench (sugar cane, vines, grass, wheat).
item.pioneers.canvas.desc: Woven from fibers: windmill sails, sacks.
item.pioneers.sawdust.desc: Burns fast (5 s). Presses into coarse paper.
advancements.pioneers.mechanics.root.des: Knap a flint knife: it all starts with fiber and wood.
advancements.pioneers.mechanics.plant_fi: Cut plant fibers with a knife.
advancements.pioneers.mechanics.cogs.des: Make a cogwheel: a diagonal cog turns twice as fast.
advancements.pioneers.mechanics.part_bro: Break a part by asking more of it than it can handle.
advancements.pioneers.mechanics.horse_mi: Harness an animal to a horse mill.
advancements.pioneers.mechanics.saw.desc: Cut a log with the mechanical saw.
advancements.pioneers.mechanics.lathe.de: Turn a part on the wood lathe.
Blow into a furnace with forge bellows.
advancements.pioneers.mechanics.sifter.d: Let the shaking sifter work for you.
advancements.pioneers.mechanics.rope_dri: Link two pulleys with a rope or belt.
advancements.pioneers.mechanics.rope_sna: Wear a rope until it snaps.
advancements.pioneers.mechanics.well.des: Wind up a bucket of water.
advancements.pioneers.mechanics.lift.des: Hoist a load with the winch.
advancements.pioneers.mechanics.creosote: Collect creosote from a clay drain.
advancements.pioneers.mechanics.beam_eng: Get steam up in a beam engine.
advancements.pioneers.mechanics.master.d: Wind, water, steam, sieve, winch and charcoal: you have mastered the Mechanical Age.
kinetics.pioneers.spec.machine: Torque %s N·m · works from %s rpm, rated %s rpm (%s)
kinetics.pioneers.spec.pulley: Radius %s · links with rope or belt
kinetics.pioneers.spec.winch: 0.25 m drum · up to 48 blocks of rope
kinetics.pioneers.winch.none: Nothing below the winch: no water, no chest
kinetics.pioneers.winch.well: Well: bottom at %s blocks · %s mB of water
kinetics.pioneers.rope.first: First pulley picked: click the second (same axis, same plane; Sneak: crossed strands).
kinetics.pioneers.rope.axis: Both pulleys must share the same axis.
kinetics.pioneers.rope.plane: Offset too large: at most %s blocks along the axis, and no more than half the spacing.
kinetics.pioneers.rope.blocked: A block is in the rope’s way.
item.pioneers.rope.desc: Up to %s N·m per radius · %s%% efficiency · Sneak: crossed strands
charcoal.pioneers.too_small: Pile too small: at least 3 × 3 × 2 logs (18).
charcoal.pioneers.not_full: Holes in the pile: fill it with logs.
charcoal.pioneers.no_vent: No vent: leave a single opening at the foot of the pile to light it.
charcoal.pioneers.vent_low: The vent must be at the foot of the pile.
charcoal.pioneers.lit: Pile lit: %s logs, about %s min. Keep it covered!
charcoal.pioneers.report: Charring %s%% · %s s left · leaks: %s · expected yield %s%%
item.pioneers.collier_pole.desc: Probe a lit pile: progress, leaks and yield.
item.pioneers.wood_ash.desc: Mild fertilizer (50% chance); mixes into mortar.
block.pioneers.hand_sieve.no_mesh: Fit a mesh first (fiber or copper).
jei.pioneers.mechanical.mesh: Needs at least a tier %s mesh (copper)
block.pioneers.toolmaker_bench.desc: Assembles tools: head, handle and binding. Knaps flint by hand.
block.pioneers.carpenter_bench.desc: Saw, knife, hammer: planks, sticks, beams, woodwork, wooden boats (boats, chest boats, rafts).
block.pioneers.metalworker_bench.desc: Hammer, file and saw: plates, rods, bolts, screws, rings, springs, gears.
block.pioneers.potter_bench.desc: Shapes clay: unfired molds, bricks and crucibles, to fire in the pottery kiln.
block.pioneers.mason_bench.desc: Mortar and hammer: dusts, flour, fire clay.
block.pioneers.coppersmith_bench.desc: Sheets, pipes, fittings and dials: everything steam needs.
gui.pioneers.bench.pick: Pick a part from the list.
block.pioneers.pottery_kiln.desc: The kiln mouth, a full block (Shift + right-click with an empty hand: the blueprint): a 3 × 3 brick base, brick stairs and a brick slab around an empty chamber, a small chimney at the back. Fires unfired ware (molds, bricks, crucibles) and turns calcite into quicklime. Reaches about 900 °C.
block.pioneers.crucible_furnace.desc: Melts metals and makes alloys: pick the alloy in the recipe square and it doses its metals (otherwise everything mixes, and a mix that is no alloy does not pour). 950 °C on a wood fire; a bellows facing it pushes it to 1,600 °C (iron melts). Pours by itself into the casting table placed against it.
block.pioneers.casting_table.desc: Against the crucible furnace, on any side: it hooks up with a pouring channel. Place a mold (by hand or hopper), the furnace pours, the part sets and comes out underneath.
foundry.pioneers.no_table: Place a casting table against the furnace (any side).
foundry.pioneers.no_mold: Put a mold on the casting table.
tooltip.pioneers.mold: Place it on a block (right-click its top): wears out with each part cast on the ground. On the casting table it never wears out.
tooltip.pioneers.crucible: In the crucible furnace; wears out with each pour.
block.pioneers.copper_boiler_shell.desc: Above the firebox: 4,000 mB of water and a 12,000 mB steam reserve.
block.pioneers.steel_boiler_shell.desc: Like copper, but holds a 32,000 mB steam reserve.
block.pioneers.steam_dome.desc: Dry steam outlet (8,000 mB reserve): it pushes steam into the gas cables touching it, or straight into an adjacent machine. At least one is needed.
block.pioneers.chimney.desc: On top of the boiler: the taller, the better the draft (up to 8 blocks).
block.pioneers.firebox.desc: The heart of the boiler (Shift + right-click with an empty hand: the blueprint): 4 fire brick fireboxes behind it, 11 shells (copper or steel) in a cross above, the steam dome at the front, the chimney on top (the taller, the better the draft).
block.pioneers.safety_valve.desc: On the boiler: shuts the firebox down when the water drops below the threshold (20%, wrench: 5 to 50%) and restarts it 5 points higher. No more dry firing.
block.pioneers.pressure_gauge.desc: Shows the steam in reserve (0 to 100%); comparator output.
block.pioneers.water_gauge.desc: On the boiler side: the water level, keep an eye on it (fired dry, it blows up). Comparator output.
block.pioneers.steam_whistle.desc: Redstone signal or click: whistles. Set with a wrench: low-water alarm.
block.pioneers.steam_engine.desc: Steam from the back or below; shaft on the sides; keep the top clear.
steam.pioneers.engine_spec: 12,000 N·m starting torque; 120 rpm free; 0.48 mB/t of steam per rpm
steam.pioneers.valve_set: Valve: opens at %s of the reserve
steam.pioneers.boiler.unformed: Incomplete boiler: needs a firebox, shells above it and a dome.
steam.pioneers.boiler.no_shell: No boiler shell above the firebox.
steam.pioneers.boiler.no_dome: The boiler needs a steam dome.
steam.pioneers.boiler.too_big: Boiler too big (12 parts at most).
steam.pioneers.boiler.dry: Boiler running dry: the metal glows, add water!
steam.pioneers.boiler.burnt: The boiler exploded: it boiled dry.
steam.pioneers.boiler.shock: Thermal shock: cold water on red-hot metal!
block.pioneers.steam_press.desc: The metalworker’s and coppersmith’s benches, no tools to wear: one stroke every 2 s, 40 mB of steam.
block.pioneers.steam_blower.desc: Blows into the furnace or tuyere it faces like 3 bellows, for 17 mB of steam per tick. Redstone: stop.
block.pioneers.steam_drill.desc: The controller, a full block in the middle of the front of the base (Shift + right-click with an empty hand: the blueprint): 7 bases (one of them a port) around the bronze drill string, 4 derricks per level, the mast and the crown. Place it on a tier-1 deposit (redstone among them: it only comes from drills).
block.pioneers.drill_base.desc: The 7 blocks of the drill base, around the drill string.
block.pioneers.drill_port.desc: A base that takes in steam and outputs ore (hopper). Click: opens the interface.
block.pioneers.drill_frame.desc: The drill tower: 4 derricks per level around the drill string, then the mast.
block.pioneers.drill_crown.desc: Tops the tower: the sheaves that hold the drill string.
geology.pioneers.near: Something about %s blocks away, to the %s.
geology.pioneers.hammer_tip: Right-click the ground to probe what lies beneath.
block.pioneers.fire_bricks.desc: Blast furnace masonry; they glow with the heat.
block.pioneers.tuyere.desc: Primitive blast furnace: in the middle of the back of the base, with a bellows or a blower behind it, facing it. Also at the back of the primitive coke oven and of the large automatic foundry (the air goes to the firebox).
block.pioneers.blast_furnace.desc: The tap hole, a full block at the foot of a fire-brick tower (Shift + right-click with an empty hand: the blueprint): a round 5 × 5 base of fire brick fireboxes with a tuyere in the middle of the back, a cross-shaped shaft, a chimney. Above 1,500 °C: steel.
jei.pioneers.blast: Three slots: iron (4 units = 1 ore or ingot, or 4 fragments), carbon (1 coal), flux (quicklime). 4 iron + 1 carbon → 1 steel in 40 s, above 1,500 °C. With quicklime: no loss (otherwise 25%).
advancements.pioneers.bronze.root.title: The Bronze Age
advancements.pioneers.bronze.root.descri: Build a toolmaker’s bench: goodbye wooden tools, hello workshops.
advancements.pioneers.bronze.flint_tools: Assemble a tool at the toolmaker’s bench.
advancements.pioneers.bronze.pottery.des: Shape a piece at the potter’s bench.
advancements.pioneers.bronze.kiln.title: Fired Clay
advancements.pioneers.bronze.kiln.descri: Fire a piece in the pottery kiln.
advancements.pioneers.bronze.cast.title: First Pour
advancements.pioneers.bronze.bronze.desc: Pour bronze: three parts copper, one tin.
advancements.pioneers.bronze.brass.title: Brass
advancements.pioneers.bronze.coppersmith: Make a part at the coppersmith’s bench.
advancements.pioneers.bronze.boiler.desc: Raise 1,000 mB of steam in a boiler.
advancements.pioneers.bronze.safety_valv: Let the low-water cutoff shut down a boiler running short of water.
advancements.pioneers.bronze.boiler_expl: Blow up a boiler. You were warned.
advancements.pioneers.bronze.steam_press: Flatten an ingot into a plate with the steam press.
advancements.pioneers.bronze.prospect.de: Probe the ground with a prospector’s hammer.
advancements.pioneers.bronze.blast_forme: Build a blast furnace, from plinth to crown.
advancements.pioneers.bronze.steel_blowe: Blow into a furnace with a steam blower.
advancements.pioneers.bronze.steel.title: Steel
advancements.pioneers.bronze.master.desc: Bronze, steam, drilling and steel: you have crossed the Bronze Age.
projection.pioneers.tooltip: Shift + right-click, empty hand: shows the structure blueprint
tooltip.pioneers.wrench.pipes: Right-click a cable or conduit: sets the targeted joint (neutral, input, output, cut)
tooltip.pioneers.wrench.settings: Sets boiler cutoffs; Shift + right-click: reading
block.pioneers.steam_compressor.desc: Tier 1 of compacting: coal ball (4 coals), unfired fire bricks (3 fire clay → 4), 9 nuggets into an ingot, sand into sandstone, snow…
block.pioneers.steam_extractor.desc: Tier 1 of extraction: natural rubber (latex), resin glue and rosin (resin), clay, string, sugar, dyes…; ×1.5 on plants, latex and resin.
block.pioneers.steam_macerator.desc: Tier 1 of grinding: also does the millstone and the jaw crusher, twice as fast and ×1.5 on raw materials (raw ore → 3 crushed ores); redstone ore from the drill → 4 redstone dust.
block.pioneers.steam_furnace.desc: Smelts like a furnace, twice as fast and without fuel (no metal: that melts in a crucible).
block.pioneers.steam_wiremill.desc: Tier 1 wire drawing: wire (2 per ingot) and copper coils (6 wires → 1 coil, machine only).
block.pioneers.steam_rolling_mill.desc: Tier 1 of rolling: one plate per ingot, two sheets per plate (steel, copper, tin, brass; steel sheet is machine only).
block.pioneers.steam_saw.desc: Tier 1 of sawing: the mechanical saw twice as fast (log → 9 planks) and the mason’s stone cutting (slabs, stairs, walls).
advancements.pioneers.bronze.steam_macer: Crush raw ore in the steam macerator: three crushed ores.
description.pioneers.industrial_crusher: Raw ore → 3 crushed ores (every recipe of the grinding family); fine grinding (crushed ore → dust). 5 × 4 × 7 structure (frames, sheet metal). Mechanical cladding. Shift + right-click for the blueprint.
description.pioneers.industrial_furnace: Smelts: ores, dusts and food; 1 input, 1 output. 3 × 4 × 3 structure (firebox walls, sheet metal). Thermal cladding. Shift + right-click for the blueprint.
