description.pioneers.basic_cryogenic_uni: Compresses and liquefies gases (LPG, LNG); refrigeration below 250 K (liquid chlorine, butane), heat exchange and vaporization of liquefied gases.
description.pioneers.advanced_cryogenic_: Compresses and liquefies gases (LPG, LNG); refrigeration below 250 K (liquid chlorine, butane), heat exchange and vaporization of liquefied gases.
description.pioneers.elite_cryogenic_uni: Compresses and liquefies gases (LPG, LNG); refrigeration below 250 K (liquid chlorine, butane), heat exchange and vaporization of liquefied gases.
description.pioneers.ultimate_cryogenic_: Compresses and liquefies gases (LPG, LNG); refrigeration below 250 K (liquid chlorine, butane), heat exchange and vaporization of liquefied gases.
description.pioneers.industrial_cryogeni: Compresses and liquefies gases (LPG, LNG); refrigeration below 250 K (liquid chlorine, butane), heat exchange and vaporization of liquefied gases. 5 × 7 × 5 structure (frames, sheet metal). Mechanical cladding. Shift + right-click for the blueprint.
description.pioneers.offshore_platform: Oil and gas under the sea. No fixed shape: a deck of linked parts, risers down to the seabed. 5 × 1 × 5 structure. Mechanical cladding. Shift + right-click for the blueprint.
description.pioneers.distillation_column: Crude distillation (6 fractions), rectification, vacuum distillation and stripping (heavy water, sour gas and water, spirits). Each fraction leaves through the port tier at its height. 5 × 24 × 5 structure (frames, sheet metal). Fluids and chemistry cladding. Shift + right-click for the blueprint.
description.pioneers.semiconductor_fab: Wafers → chips and processors, in a cleanroom. 5 × 5 × 9 structure (cleanroom). Electric cladding. Shift + right-click for the blueprint.
description.pioneers.gas_turbine: Burns combustible gases (natural gas, methane, propane, butane, hydrogen, biogas, syngas, wood gas…) → energy. 5 × 9 × 5 structure (industrial glass, turbine rotors, frames). Mechanical cladding. Shift + right-click for the blueprint.
description.pioneers.storage_tank: Stores one fluid: 64,000 mB per block of volume, x4 per tier. 5 × 13 × 5 structure (frames, sheet metal). Fluids and chemistry cladding. Shift + right-click for the blueprint.
description.pioneers.gas_holder: Stores one gas: 256,000 mB per block of volume, x4 per tier. 5 × 8 × 5 structure (frames, sheet metal). Fluids and chemistry cladding. Shift + right-click for the blueprint.
description.pioneers.tar_sand: Sand soaked with bitumen, around oil pools: the hot water separator extracts bitumen.
description.pioneers.oil_seep: Oil seeping up: a deposit lies right below.
industry.pioneers.error.dry_riser: Dry riser: it must reach down through water to the seabed
chemistry.pioneers.seismic.tip: Right-click: listen to the ground (oil, gas, brine)
advancements.pioneers.chemistry.root.des: Go looking for oil: deserts and oceans.
Listen to the ground with the seismograph.
Run a pumpjack on four operations at once.
Distill crude in the distillation column.
advancements.pioneers.chemistry.fcc.desc: Crack heavy gas oil into gasoline.
advancements.pioneers.chemistry.hydrocra: Desulfurize or hydrocrack in the industrial cracker (hydrocracking).
advancements.pioneers.chemistry.ptfe.des: Make PTFE: advanced cables withstand acids and cold.
advancements.pioneers.chemistry.tier2.de: Plastic frames, rubber gaskets: advanced machines are yours.
advancements.pioneers.chemistry.isotopes: Isolate lithium-6: the road to nuclear opens.
advancements.pioneers.chemistry.heavy_wa: Run isotope exchange (or plain stripping) in the stripper.
advancements.pioneers.chemistry.chip.des: Etch, dope, dice: your first chip.
advancements.pioneers.chemistry.circuits: Place the components of an MKII circuit.
advancements.pioneers.chemistry.master.d: Offshore oil, steam turbine, ammonia, chips and the MKII tier: chemistry is yours.
block.pioneers.assembly_bench.desc: Builds machines, multiblocks and components: set frames, circuits and parts, pick the machine. The wrench is the tool.
description.pioneers.assembly_bench: Builds machines and machine blocks: set frames, circuits and parts, pick the machine. The wrench is the tool. Components go to the advanced components bench, vehicles and logistics parts to the logistics parts bench.
description.pioneers.hydroponic_farm: Mass crops: seeds + nutrient solution (+ CO₂) → harvests; microalgae (algae oil, oxygen). 5 × 6 × 5 structure (industrial glass, hydroponic substrate, frames). Living cladding. Shift + right-click for the blueprint.
description.pioneers.aquafarm: Farmed fish, kelp and algae: feed + water + oxygen. 5 × 6 × 5 structure (frames, sheet metal). Living cladding. Shift + right-click for the blueprint.
advancements.pioneers.agri.root.title: The Living Age
advancements.pioneers.agri.root.descript: Trees, crops, fish and gas: living things become raw materials.
advancements.pioneers.agri.resin.title: Pine Tears
advancements.pioneers.agri.resin.descrip: Collect resin from a resin tap set on a spruce.
advancements.pioneers.agri.latex.title: Tree Milk
advancements.pioneers.agri.latex.descrip: Collect latex from a jungle trunk.
advancements.pioneers.agri.rosin.title: Rosin
advancements.pioneers.agri.rosin.descrip: Bake resin in the pottery kiln.
advancements.pioneers.agri.primitive_pla: Rosin, sawdust and fibers, baked: the insulator of the MKI circuit.
advancements.pioneers.agri.natural_rubbe: Smoke latex in the kiln: it is used for conveyor belts.
advancements.pioneers.agri.crops.title: Seeds
advancements.pioneers.agri.crops.descrip: Find rapeseed, hemp or corn by cutting grass.
advancements.pioneers.agri.hemp.title: Tow
advancements.pioneers.agri.hemp.descript: Pull fiber out of hemp stalks.
advancements.pioneers.agri.starch.title: Starch
advancements.pioneers.agri.starch.descri: Wet-mill corn: starch for ethanol and feed.
advancements.pioneers.agri.chipper.title: Chips
advancements.pioneers.agri.pellets.title: Pellets
advancements.pioneers.agri.pellets.descr: Press chips into pellets: a dense fuel.
advancements.pioneers.agri.digester.desc: Get biogas and digestate out of a digester.
advancements.pioneers.agri.press.title: First Pressing
advancements.pioneers.agri.lubricant.des: Make lubricant from plant oil in the fuel blender.
advancements.pioneers.agri.soap.title: Saponification
advancements.pioneers.agri.soap.descript: Make soap: it goes into flotation reagent.
advancements.pioneers.agri.renewable_die: Hydrotreat an oil: renewable diesel and bio-kerosene.
advancements.pioneers.agri.pyrolysis.des: Heat wood in the pyrolysis oven: biochar, tar, wood vinegar.
advancements.pioneers.agri.biochar.title: Biochar
advancements.pioneers.agri.biochar.descr: Charcoal for soil, fire and activated carbon.
advancements.pioneers.agri.fast_pyrolysi: At the MKII tier, dry biomass gives bio-oil.
advancements.pioneers.agri.recycling.des: Spent plastics and rubber go back in the oven: naphtha, carbon black, fuel oil.
advancements.pioneers.agri.gasifier.desc: Gasify biomass or coal with steam and oxygen.
advancements.pioneers.agri.gas_plant.des: Process raw gas: methane, ethane, LPG, condensate.
advancements.pioneers.agri.biomethane.de: Upgrade the digester’s biogas into methane.
advancements.pioneers.agri.methanation.d: Recombine CO₂ and hydrogen into methane in the chemical reactor (catalysis).
advancements.pioneers.agri.fischer_trops: Turn syngas into diesel, kerosene and waxes.
advancements.pioneers.agri.co2.title: Enriched Air
advancements.pioneers.agri.co2.descripti: A fermenter’s CO₂ doubles the farm’s harvests (with nutrient solution).
advancements.pioneers.agri.plantation.de: Grow trees in a tree plantation.
advancements.pioneers.agri.aquafarm.desc: Raise fish or kelp in an aquaculture farm.
advancements.pioneers.agri.algae.title: Green Soup
advancements.pioneers.agri.algae.descrip: Grow microalgae in the hydroponic farm (microalgae): oil and oxygen.
advancements.pioneers.agri.loop.title: The Loop
advancements.pioneers.agri.loop.descript: Digester, reformer, ammonia, farm: your gas feeds your crops, which make gas again.
advancements.pioneers.agri.master.title: Master of the Living
advancements.pioneers.agri.master.descri: Farms, forest, fish, gas plant and Fischer-Tropsch: the living world is yours.
description.pioneers.wooden_resin_tap: Placed on the side of a living tree, it collects resin (spruce) or latex (jungle) without power. Right-click: harvest.
description.pioneers.bronze_resin_tap: Twice as fast, holds 16 harvests and empties itself into an inventory placed below.
block.pioneers.resin_tap.not_tree: Not a living tree: it needs a trunk of at least 3 logs and its natural leaves
block.pioneers.resin_tap.no_sap: This tree gives neither resin nor latex (spruce: resin; jungle: latex)
description.pioneers.pneumatic_tube: Turquoise glass tube ringed in yellow-orange, wide enough for a cabin: travelers race through it at 25 blocks per second while watching the landscape. Drawn from one station (or a free block, or the end of a tube) to another, it rounds itself, flat, sloped or vertical, and bends a little around an obstacle. One tube per block of length. Aim at it and left-click to dismantle it.
description.pioneers.pneumatic_tube_stat: Hypertube terminal: right-click to pick a destination among the named stations of the network and ride a glass cabin there. A trip costs 60 L of air + 3 L per block, taken here (1 bar at least). You come out in front of the arrival station’s mouth.
screen.pioneers.tube_station.name: This station’s name
screen.pioneers.tube_station.none: No named station linked by hypertubes
item.pioneers.pneumatic_jackhammer.use: %s L per block; digs 3 × 3 (sneaking: a single block)
item.pioneers.impact_wrench.use: %s L per teardown: unbolts the mod's machines in an instant (and also works as a regular wrench)
item.pioneers.air_blower.use: %s L per block cleared (hold right-click): leaves, snow, grass, flowers, cobwebs
item.pioneers.sandblaster.use: %s L and 1 sand per block cleaned (hold right-click): verdigris, wax, moss, cracks
item.pioneers.sandblaster.no_sand: No sand left in your inventory
item.pioneers.diving_tank.use: %s L per second underwater: you breathe from the tank while it is in your inventory
tooltip.pioneers.air_tool.refill: Shift + right-click a compressor, compressed air tank or air machine: refill
tooltip.pioneers.air_tool.nothing: No air to take here: %s / %s L
description.pioneers.industrial_pressure: Compressed air input: process pressure for some recipes (otherwise they run at 50%%), well gas-lift, farm aeration.
advancements.pioneers.heat_pressure.root: Waste heat and compressed air become resources.
advancements.pioneers.heat_pressure.casc: Heat a pyrolysis oven with another plant’s heat: heat port set to input.
advancements.pioneers.heat_pressure.impa: Take machines apart in one click.
advancements.pioneers.heat_pressure.blow: Make an air blower or a sandblaster.
advancements.pioneers.heat_pressure.divi: Make a diving tank: air underwater.
advancements.pioneers.heat_pressure.tube: Ride a pneumatic tube from one named station to another.
advancements.pioneers.heat_pressure.proc: Make a pressure port: pressurized recipes run twice as fast.
advancements.pioneers.heat_pressure.tool: A titanium, stainless or duralumin pickaxe.
A tungsten carbide, vanadium steel or stellite pickaxe.
An osmiridium, titanium aluminide or nitinol pickaxe.
advancements.pioneers.heat_pressure.mast: MKIV heat and pressure buffers, tubes and MKIV radiator: nothing is wasted.
industry.pioneers.port.heat_input: Heat port set to input: heat from a hotter neighbor flows in
industry.pioneers.port.heat_output: Heat port set to output: heat flows to a colder neighbor
industry.pioneers.gui.heat_rule: Heat port set to input: past its working temperature, each joule received replaces 1 FE (up to 75%%).
industry.pioneers.gui.climate_rule: Farm: comfortable between 285 and 310 K, otherwise 50%%; the biome sets the ambient temperature (heat ports to correct it).
jei.pioneers.industry.pressure: Multiblock under pressure: ≥ %s bar, %s L of air; otherwise 50%%
jei.pioneers.air.buffer: Air tanks: 2,000 / 8,000 / 32,000 / 128,000 L, 5 / 10 / 20 / 40 bar (like pipes of the same tier).
jei.pioneers.air.compressor: Air compressor: electric, pushes air into neighbouring pipes and tanks (heat released: 25 J per litre).
jei.pioneers.air.network.title: Pneumatic tubes
jei.pioneers.air.port: Building pressure port: 200 L, 5 / 10 / 20 / 40 bar by tier.
jei.pioneers.air.sources.title: Making compressed air
jei.pioneers.air.station: Station: right-click to name it and choose the destination; each trip costs 60 L + 3 L per block, with at least 1 bar at the departure station.
jei.pioneers.air.store.title: Storing air
jei.pioneers.air.tools.1: Jackhammer 2,000 L (50 L per block, 3 × 3) · impact wrench 1,000 L (20 L) · blower 1,500 L (3 L per block) · sandblaster 1,500 L (25 L + 1 sand) · diving tank 2,400 L (12 L/s).
jei.pioneers.air.tools.2: Refill: sneak + right-click a pressurised block (compressor, tank, machine; not a pipe).
jei.pioneers.air.tools.title: Air tools
jei.pioneers.air.tube: Pneumatic tubes: they carry the player from one station to another at 25 blocks per second, vertical runs included.
jei.pioneers.fuels.boiler_solid: Boiler: %s of steam, i.e. %s in the steam turbine.
jei.pioneers.fuels.heat_generator: Compact combustion generator: %s/t for %s (%s in total).
jei.pioneers.fuels.tiers: MkII to MkIV generators burn faster and produce more, at the same efficiency.
jei.pioneers.info.airlock_door: Two-block airtight sliding door: closed, air cannot pass. Use an airlock (two doors) to enter without emptying the base of oxygen; it closes by itself after 4 s unless powered by redstone.
jei.pioneers.info.atmospheric_suit: Atmospheric suit: pressurized armor with back thrusters that withstands gas-giant pressure and lets you fly through their clouds.
jei.pioneers.info.buffer: Top-tier buffer: %s. It connects to cables of the same kind.
jei.pioneers.info.charge_pad: Charging station of the greenhouse turtle: a plate placed on the substrate, inside.
jei.pioneers.info.copper_mesh: Copper sieve mesh: chances ×1.3 and a 30 % second roll; wears with every pass.
jei.pioneers.info.drill_head: Mining rover drill head: veins up to hardness %s, %s units drilled before wearing out, speed ×%s. It goes in through a mining port.
jei.pioneers.info.gas.no_use: Isotope or compound produced here (see R); no recipe in the mod uses it yet.
jei.pioneers.info.gas.plutonium: Gaseous plutonium: with deuterium and tritium it feeds the gravity compressor that forges the Stellar Core (see U).
jei.pioneers.info.gas.plutonium.2: No machine in the mod produces it yet.
jei.pioneers.info.gas.superheated_ammoni: Heated ammonia: it comes out of the ammonia-cooled solar absorber (see its category).
For Mekanism it is a heated coolant: the thermoelectric boiler takes its heat and returns plain ammonia.
jei.pioneers.info.gas_capsule: The gas equivalent of a bucket: 1 B. Right-click a block with a gas tank (Pioneer’s or Mekanism): empty, it takes; full, it pours.
jei.pioneers.info.get.aerostat: Part of the 9 × 9 platform deployed by the aerostat kit in a gas giant; break it to collect it.
jei.pioneers.info.get.cloud: Cloud of %s: you can fly through it but neither target nor break it; creative mode only.
jei.pioneers.info.get.creative: Creative-mode item: it cannot be crafted.
jei.pioneers.info.get.meteorite: Obtained: buried at the bottom of meteor-shower craters, and in the ground of %s.
jei.pioneers.info.get.meteorite.many: Obtained: buried at the bottom of meteor-shower craters, and scattered in the ground of many worlds.
jei.pioneers.info.get.meteorite.only: Obtained: buried at the bottom of meteor-shower craters.
jei.pioneers.info.get.ore: Obtained: natural ore of %s, mined with a pickaxe; U shows what it gives.
jei.pioneers.info.get.world: Obtained: natural block of %s; collect it there.
jei.pioneers.info.greenhouse_part: Part of the space greenhouse (7 × 7 × 5): see the greenhouse controller.
jei.pioneers.info.greenhouse_port: Greenhouse port, in a wall or the roof: seed input, harvest output (ejection) or power, set with the Mekanism configurator.
jei.pioneers.info.hydroponic_substrate: Water-soaked growing soil made of dirt, compost and beeswax. Packed, it must be tilled (hoe, farmer robot or greenhouse turtle). Tilled, it takes every Earth seed like always-moist farmland: crops grow ×1.5 faster, but their climate does not change (biome, Resistance tolerance, glass greenhouse). It is also the floor of the space greenhouse trays.
jei.pioneers.info.launch_tower: Launch tower segment: stack 5 next to the launch pad, which turns it towards the rocket, deploys the fuel arm on the 3rd and the platform on the 5th.
jei.pioneers.info.lightning_conductor: Lightning mast conductor: stack 4 to 24 on the collector, under a lightning rod.
jei.pioneers.info.logistic_chest: Logistic chest (9, 18, 27, 36 or 54 slots by tier) that is itself a logistics point. Right-click: contents; sneak + right-click empty-handed: settings.
jei.pioneers.info.mining_port: Mining port, in a wall or the roof of the outpost: drill head input, ore output (ejection) or power, set with the Mekanism configurator (sneak + right-click).
jei.pioneers.info.outpost_part: Part of the planetary mining outpost: see the mining outpost controller’s blueprint.
jei.pioneers.info.prospecting_radar: Prospecting radar base, at the center of the mining outpost roof; the dish turns once the outpost is formed.
jei.pioneers.info.prospector: Light pick that mines stone. Right-click the ground: probes the underground within 64 blocks; on a deposit, its ore, reserve and required drill, otherwise the direction and distance of the nearest one.
jei.pioneers.info.quasar_lamp: Decorative lamp at full light level.
jei.pioneers.info.rocket_blueprint: Rocket blueprint: goes into the rocket assembler and is not consumed.
jei.pioneers.info.rover_dock: Mining rover dock: charging and unloading platform at the center of the mining outpost hangar.
jei.pioneers.info.rover_module: Mining rover module (3 slots in the mining outpost controller; each type only counts once).
jei.pioneers.info.rover_module.cargo: Marsium reinforced bin: twice the capacity.
jei.pioneers.info.rover_module.refinery: Mercurium on-board refinery: 30 % chance of extra ore.
jei.pioneers.info.rover_module.scanner: Venusium sounder: wider prospecting, more deposits.
jei.pioneers.info.seismograph: Listens to the underground and finds fluid deposits (oil, gas, brine): on a deposit, its type, what is left and its pressure; otherwise the direction and distance of the nearest one.
jei.pioneers.info.tool_stats: Tool: mining level %s, %s uses, speed %s, damage %s.
jei.pioneers.info.unit: Robotic unit: it is assigned to a hub (or relay) set to its type, which gives it its job and area.
jei.pioneers.info.upgrade: Upgrade card: goes into a robotic hub or relay.
jei.pioneers.info.use.armor: Use: armor to wear; it is not used in any recipe.
jei.pioneers.info.use.decor: Use: decorative building block; it is not used in any recipe.
jei.pioneers.info.use.food: Use: edible (%s hunger points), with an effect tied to its world.
jei.pioneers.info.use.item: Use: no recipe uses it yet.
jei.pioneers.info.use.natural: Use: no recipe uses it yet; it is a building block.
jei.pioneers.info.use.part: Use: a formed part; no recipe in the mod uses it yet.
jei.pioneers.info.use.placeable: Use: placed in the world; it is not used in any recipe.
jei.pioneers.info.use.tool: Use: a hand tool; it is not used in any recipe.
jei.pioneers.wild.break: Break this block with the right tool: it gives what is on the right (Fortune may add more).
jei.pioneers.wild.break.silk: With Silk Touch, it drops itself.
jei.pioneers.wild.break.title: Breaking: %s
jei.pioneers.wild.crop: Sow it on farmland, like wheat. Once ripe (8 stages) it gives %s to %s %s; before that, only the seed.
jei.pioneers.wild.crop.robots: Farming robots harvest and replant it.
jei.pioneers.wild.crop.title: Crop: %s
jei.pioneers.wild.food: Edible: %s hunger points and an effect tied to its world.
jei.pioneers.wild.grass.hint: Break grass in the world: this drop comes on top of the usual one.
jei.pioneers.wild.grass.title: Grass: gathering
jei.pioneers.wild.greenhouse: Its seeds only grow in a space greenhouse: best on %s (greenhouse controller: 7 × 7 × 5).
jei.pioneers.wild.greenhouse.title: Space greenhouse on %s
jei.pioneers.wild.greenhouse.turtle: A robotic turtle tills the substrate, sows and harvests; seeds and harvest go through the greenhouse ports.
jei.pioneers.wild.plant: Grows by itself on the surface of %s. Broken: 1 to 2 seeds and a %s %% chance of a harvest; with shears, the whole plant.
jei.pioneers.wild.plant.title: Wild plant of %s
jei.pioneers.wild.tap: Place a tap on the side of a living tree (%s logs); it fills by itself, without power.
jei.pioneers.wild.tap.logs: The more logs the tree has (up to 8), the faster it flows. Right-click to collect.
jei.pioneers.wild.tap.rate: Wood: one harvest every 180 s, holds 4. Bronze: every 90 s, holds 16, pours into the inventory below.
jei.pioneers.wild.tap.title: Tap: %s
jei.pioneers.wild.tool.no_knife: By hand or with any tool but a knife.
screen.pioneers.tube_station.too_expensi: Not enough air in this station for this trip
message.pioneers.tube.refused.unreachabl: Destination unreachable: the hypertubes no longer lead to that station
message.pioneers.tube.refused.no_pressur: Pressure too low: the station needs at least %s bar
message.pioneers.tube.refused.no_air: Not enough air: this trip needs %s L, the station holds %s L
message.pioneers.tube.emergency_back: Hypertube cut! Back to the departure station
message.pioneers.tube.emergency: Hypertube cut! You were set down at the nearest safe spot
description.pioneers.centrifuge_cascade: Enriches uranium hexafluoride: each centrifuge adds a stage; laser isotope separation. 3 × 6 × 9 structure (frames). Nuclear cladding. Shift + right-click for the blueprint.
description.pioneers.fission_reactor: Pressurized water reactor: fuel assemblies + water → steam. Control rods, emergency shutdown. Pressurized water vessel. Nuclear cladding. Shift + right-click for the blueprint.
description.pioneers.spent_fuel_pool: Spent assemblies shed their decay heat here before storage. 5 × 4 × 7 structure (frames, sheet metal). Nuclear cladding. Shift + right-click for the blueprint.
advancements.pioneers.nuclear.root.title: The Atomic Age
advancements.pioneers.nuclear.root.descr: Uranium, reactors and the first machines that compute.
advancements.pioneers.nuclear.solvent.de: Pull uranium out of its solution with a solvent, then strip it with ammonia.
advancements.pioneers.nuclear.tailings.d: Neutralize the raffinate with lime: the tailings still yield radon.
advancements.pioneers.nuclear.hex.title: Hex
advancements.pioneers.nuclear.hex.descri: Fluorinate green salt: uranium hexafluoride, ready to enrich.
advancements.pioneers.nuclear.cascade.de: Enrich UF6 in a centrifuge cascade.
advancements.pioneers.nuclear.depleted.d: Reduce depleted uranium to metal: dense and protective.
advancements.pioneers.nuclear.pellet.des: Press and sinter enriched oxide into fuel pellets.
advancements.pioneers.nuclear.assembly.d: Nine zircaloy-clad rods, two grids, two nozzles.
advancements.pioneers.nuclear.rods.title: Absorber
advancements.pioneers.nuclear.rods.descr: Clad boron carbide: a control rod cluster.
advancements.pioneers.nuclear.criticalit: Start a fission reactor: the chain reaction sustains itself.
advancements.pioneers.nuclear.pool.title: Underwater
advancements.pioneers.nuclear.pool.descr: Let a spent assembly cool in the spent fuel pool.
advancements.pioneers.nuclear.cask.title: Dry Storage
advancements.pioneers.nuclear.cask.descr: Seal spent assemblies in a dry storage cask.
A dosimeter: it counts what you cannot see.
advancements.pioneers.nuclear.meltdown.d: Let a reactor core melt down. That was not the plan.
advancements.pioneers.nuclear.relays.des: Wire a relay cabinet: your machines obey rules.
advancements.pioneers.nuclear.plc.title: PLC
advancements.pioneers.nuclear.plc.descri: A programmable logic controller: 16 rules, timers, counters.
advancements.pioneers.nuclear.screen.des: Show a machine’s state on a supervision screen.
advancements.pioneers.nuclear.control_ro: A reactor, a PLC, a screen: the plant runs by itself.
description.pioneers.corium: Molten reactor core: burns, glows, irradiates. Cools down in about a day.
description.pioneers.cooled_corium: Highly radioactive glassy rock: needs a diamond pickaxe, drops corium chunks.
description.pioneers.dry_storage_cask: Concrete and steel around cooled spent assemblies: stored until reprocessing.
tooltip.pioneers.hazmat: Wearing all four pieces blocks 95%% of the dose received.
tooltip.pioneers.dosimeter: In the hotbar: dose rate and received dose. Right-click: report.
nuclear.pioneers.meltdown: ☢ Reactor core meltdown at %s %s %s! Contaminated zone: wear a hazmat suit.
nuclear.pioneers.reset_refused: Reset refused: temperature too high or redstone signal present.
nuclear.pioneers.gui.heat_help: Water from the left tank carries the heat away; the steam (a gas) leaves through the gas ports.
nuclear.pioneers.gui.water_help: Through fluid input ports; steam (a gas) leaves through gas output ports.
nuclear.pioneers.gui.rule_rods: Inserted rods = less power; one control rod drive per 4 assemblies.
nuclear.pioneers.gui.rule_fuel: One assembly per fuel channel; spent ones come out hot: spent fuel pool.
nuclear.pioneers.gui.rule_redstone: Redstone signal on the controller: emergency shutdown. Comparator: power.

ai.pioneers.say.neural.online.0: Hi! NOVA online. %s machines to watch, I love it.
ai.pioneers.say.neural.online.1: Boot complete. I dreamed of conveyor belts. (%s links)
ai.pioneers.say.neural.online.2: Hello factory! %s links, zero faults. So far.
ai.pioneers.say.neural.offline.0: Out of power… I’ll take a little nap.
ai.pioneers.say.neural.offline.1: My neurons are going dark one by one. Plug me back in!
ai.pioneers.say.neural.offline.2: Battery empty. You have the controls.
ai.pioneers.say.neural.fault.0: %s is out of power. Did someone unplug something?
ai.pioneers.say.neural.overheat.0: %s is way too hot. It needs coolant!
ai.pioneers.say.neural.overheat.1: Heat alert on %s. I’m sweating for it.
ai.pioneers.say.neural.overheat.2: %s is overheating. It’s not an oven… well, not that one.
ai.pioneers.say.neural.unformed.0: %s is broken apart! Blocks are missing.
ai.pioneers.say.neural.unformed.1: Structure broken: %s. Who took that block?
ai.pioneers.say.neural.regulate.0: %s was climbing to %s%%: I lowered the rods.
ai.pioneers.say.neural.regulate.1: A little rod nudge on %s (%s%%). All calm.
PREVENTIVE SHUTDOWN of %s at %s K. Sorry, I got scared.
Rods all the way in on %s (%s K). Breathe.
ai.pioneers.say.neural.disruption_avoide: The field of %s was failing: heating cut before a disruption!
I shut %s down before it did something silly.
ai.pioneers.say.neural.record.2: %s: %s. Nobody has ever done better here.
ai.pioneers.say.neural.idle.0: All good. I counted the gears: there are a lot.
ai.pioneers.say.neural.idle.1: Nothing to report. Can an AI get bored?
ai.pioneers.say.foundation.online.0: PROMETHEUS awakens. %s machines in my keeping.
ai.pioneers.say.foundation.online.1: The fire is lit again. I watch over %s links.
ai.pioneers.say.foundation.online.2: Initialization complete. The factory now thinks. (%s)
ai.pioneers.say.foundation.offline.0: Power leaves me. I shall return.
ai.pioneers.say.foundation.link.0: %s joins the great whole. %s mechanical souls.
ai.pioneers.say.foundation.fault.1: The silence of %s is not rest: it is a failure.
ai.pioneers.say.foundation.overheat.0: %s burns. Even Prometheus would think twice.
ai.pioneers.say.foundation.recovered.2: %s resumes its task, as it should.
ai.pioneers.say.foundation.unformed.2: %s is now but a heap of parts.
ai.pioneers.say.foundation.regulate.1: The rods of %s go down: %s%% was enough.
ai.pioneers.say.foundation.preventive_sc: SHUTDOWN of %s at %s K. I will not let the core melt.
I put out %s (%s K). No meltdown on my watch.
ai.pioneers.say.foundation.disruption_av: The field of %s wavered. I put out the star before its wrath.
%s: heating cut. The plasma will not bite.
Disruption averted on %s. One does not toy with the sun.
ai.pioneers.say.foundation.record.0: %s reaches %s. History will remember this day.
ai.pioneers.say.foundation.idle.0: All is in order. I computed 2^64 chess games to pass the time.
ai.pioneers.say.foundation.idle.1: I contemplate your conveyor belts. They have a certain poetry.
ai.pioneers.say.foundation.idle.2: Nothing to report. The silence of a well-tuned factory is music.

During a thunderstorm, lightning strikes the tip and charges the collector (the taller the mast, the more often and harder it strikes). On gas giants, lightning strikes even in calm weather. Output: 2,000,000 FE/t from the sides and bottom.
description.pioneers.basic_oxygen_diffus: Pressurizes the closed room it stands in (up to 1,024 air blocks, 64 mB/t) with oxygen: you can breathe there without a suit and suits refill. A regular door lets the air out: build airlocks.
description.pioneers.advanced_oxygen_dif: Pressurizes the closed room it stands in (up to 2,048 air blocks, 128 mB/t) with oxygen: you can breathe there without a suit and suits refill. A regular door lets the air out: build airlocks.
description.pioneers.elite_oxygen_diffus: Pressurizes the closed room it stands in (up to 4,096 air blocks, 256 mB/t) with oxygen: you can breathe there without a suit and suits refill. A regular door lets the air out: build airlocks.
description.pioneers.ultimate_oxygen_dif: Pressurizes the closed room it stands in (up to 8,192 air blocks, 512 mB/t) with oxygen: you can breathe there without a suit and suits refill. A regular door lets the air out: build airlocks.
description.pioneers.drone_pad: Marked deck tile of the drone bay: 2 × 2 tiles make one drone's pad.
drone_bay.pioneers.not_built: Bay incomplete: build the deck, pads, tanks and cabin (Shift + right-click the controller: blueprint).
description.pioneers.industrial_data_por: Connects the MKI-or-better logistic cable: computing power (GOPS, QOPS) and telemetry of data centers and the quantum computer. A cable touching the structure anywhere works too; this port shows the plug.
gui.pioneers.side.title: Sides
block.pioneers.redstoner_bench.desc: Redstone components: piston, dispenser, observer, repeater, comparator, torch, lamp, pressure plates.
block.pioneers.transporter_bench.desc: Transport: rails, saddle, horse armor and lead. Wooden boats: at the carpenter’s bench and the shipyard; minecarts: at the railroad works.
description.pioneers.redstoner_bench: Redstone components: piston, dispenser, observer, repeater, comparator, torch, lamp, pressure plates.
description.pioneers.transporter_bench: Transport: rails, saddle, horse armor and lead. Wooden boats: at the carpenter’s bench and the shipyard; minecarts: at the railroad works.
description.pioneers.wooden_track: Mechanical Age track: 4 blocks/s. Turns toward neighboring tracks on its own; the wrench changes its shape.
description.pioneers.basic_track: Track: up to 8 blocks/s. Straight, curve, switch, crossing or slope depending on its neighbors; the wrench changes its shape.
description.pioneers.advanced_track: Track: up to 14 blocks/s. Straight, curve, switch, crossing or slope depending on its neighbors; the wrench changes its shape.
description.pioneers.elite_track: Track: up to 22 blocks/s. Straight, curve, switch, crossing or slope depending on its neighbors; the wrench changes its shape.
description.pioneers.ultimate_track: Track: up to 34 blocks/s. Straight, curve, switch, crossing or slope depending on its neighbors; the wrench changes its shape.
description.pioneers.buffer_stop: End of the line: trains stop against its buffers. Faces the direction you're looking when placed.
description.pioneers.brake_track: Slows down vehicles without a locomotive (mine carts, yards).
description.pioneers.booster_track: Launches vehicles without a locomotive at 8 blocks/s.
description.pioneers.detector_track: Redstone and comparator signal while a train is on it. Never needed by trains.
description.pioneers.block_signal: One train per block. Click the track looking in the trains’ direction: it goes on their right. Arm raised: clear.
description.pioneers.chain_signal: Before a junction or station: only lets a train in if its whole exit is clear (blue: partial exit).
description.pioneers.train_station: At the end of the platform: train heads stop here. Click the track in the arrival direction. Right-click: name and train limit.
description.pioneers.water_crane: Refills the water of a steam locomotive or tender stopped next to it. On its own over a water source, or through pipes.
description.pioneers.basic_item_loader: Loads or unloads the vehicle stopped in front of it (16 items/s). Connects to cables and chests through its sides.
description.pioneers.advanced_item_loade: Loads or unloads the vehicle stopped in front of it (64 items/s). Connects to cables and chests through its sides.
description.pioneers.elite_item_loader: Loads or unloads the vehicle stopped in front of it (256 items/s). Connects to cables and chests through its sides.
description.pioneers.ultimate_item_loade: Loads or unloads the vehicle stopped in front of it (1024 items/s). Connects to cables and chests through its sides.
item.pioneers.mine_wagon.tooltip: Pushed by hand (walk into it). 9 slots.
item.pioneers.draisine.tooltip: Board it and pump (Forward key): 4 blocks/s, two cars.
item.pioneers.steam_locomotive.tooltip: Fuel and water (its own then the tenders’). Right-click: reserves; Shift + right-click: train sheet and schedule.
item.pioneers.tender.tooltip: Fuel and water for the steam locomotive. A water bucket or a water crane fills it.
item.pioneers.boxcar.tooltip: Items: loaded and unloaded at item loaders.
item.pioneers.hopper_car.tooltip: Bulk cargo of a single kind (ore, sand, coal…).
death.attack.pioneers.train.player: %1$s was hit by a train while fleeing %2$s
rail.pioneers.no_room: No room on the track here
rail.pioneers.status.no_fuel: Out of power (fuel, water, liquid fuel or electricity)
rail.pioneers.train.title: Train
rail.pioneers.train.name: Train name
rail.pioneers.train.cannot_auto: Needs a locomotive facing forward (the handcar does not count).
rail.pioneers.train.decouple_tip: Select a vehicle (not the last), train stopped in manual.
rail.pioneers.train.no_stops: No stops: add stations, the train visits them in order and starts over.
rail.pioneers.station.title: Station
rail.pioneers.station.name: Station name
rail.pioneers.station.same: %s stations share this name: trains go to the least busy.
rail.pioneers.station.hint: Train heads stop at the exit of the neighboring track block; the loaders along the platform serve the vehicle stopped in front of them.
gui.pioneers.crane.title: Water crane
rail.pioneers.train.cond.link_tip: AND: both conditions at once; OR: either one is enough
rail.pioneers.train.auto_tip: The train follows its schedule, finds its way and sets the switches itself.
rail.pioneers.train.decouple_ok: Splits the train after the selected vehicle
rail.pioneers.car.water_tip: Water bucket (right-click the vehicle) or a water crane at a station.
rail.pioneers.car.fire_tip: The firebox burns the fuel in its slots, then the tenders’.
rail.pioneers.side.straight_only: Only next to a flat straight track
rail.pioneers.side.blocked: Space taken next to the track
rail.pioneers.side.how_directional: Click a track: placed on the right, in the direction you look (Shift: reverse)
rail.pioneers.side.how: Click a track: placed beside it, on the aimed side (Shift: other side)
description.pioneers.basic_loading_silo: Fills the hopper car or mine cart stopped in front of it from above (16 items/s). Items come in through cables and chests.
description.pioneers.advanced_loading_si: Fills the hopper car or mine cart stopped in front of it from above (64 items/s). Items come in through cables and chests.
description.pioneers.elite_loading_silo: Fills the hopper car or mine cart stopped in front of it from above (256 items/s). Items come in through cables and chests.
description.pioneers.ultimate_loading_si: Fills the hopper car or mine cart stopped in front of it from above (1024 items/s). Items come in through cables and chests.
description.pioneers.basic_unloading_pit: Under the track: empties the hopper car or mine cart stopped above (16 items/s). Click the track: it replaces the block that carries the track.
description.pioneers.advanced_unloading_: Under the track: empties the hopper car or mine cart stopped above (64 items/s). Click the track: it replaces the block that carries the track.
description.pioneers.elite_unloading_pit: Under the track: empties the hopper car or mine cart stopped above (256 items/s). Click the track: the pit replaces the block that carries the track.
description.pioneers.ultimate_unloading_: Under the track: empties the hopper car or mine cart stopped above (1024 items/s). Click the track: it replaces the block that carries the track.
description.pioneers.basic_fluid_loader: Fills or empties the tank car (fluid or gas) stopped in front of it (500 mB/t).
description.pioneers.advanced_fluid_load: Fills or empties the tank car (fluid or gas) stopped in front of it (2,000 mB/t).
description.pioneers.elite_fluid_loader: Fills or empties the tank car (fluid or gas) stopped in front of it (8,000 mB/t).
description.pioneers.ultimate_fluid_load: Fills or empties the tank car (fluid or gas) stopped in front of it (32,000 mB/t).
description.pioneers.basic_energy_loader: Charges or drains the battery car and electric locomotive batteries stopped in front of it (32,768 FE/t).
description.pioneers.advanced_energy_loa: Charges or drains the battery car and electric locomotive batteries stopped in front of it (131,072 FE/t).
description.pioneers.elite_energy_loader: Charges or drains the battery car and electric locomotive batteries stopped in front of it (524,288 FE/t).
description.pioneers.ultimate_energy_loa: Charges or drains the battery car and electric locomotive batteries stopped in front of it (2,097,152 FE/t).
description.pioneers.basic_data_loader: Loads or unloads the data of the server car stopped in front of it (2,000 MB/t).
description.pioneers.advanced_data_loade: Loads or unloads the data of the server car stopped in front of it (8,000 MB/t).
description.pioneers.elite_data_loader: Loads or unloads the data of the server car stopped in front of it (32,000 MB/t).
description.pioneers.ultimate_data_loade: Loads or unloads the data of the server car stopped in front of it (128,000 MB/t).
description.pioneers.basic_air_loader: Fills or empties the compressed air car stopped in front of it (40 L/t).
description.pioneers.advanced_air_loader: Fills or empties the compressed air car stopped in front of it (160 L/t).
description.pioneers.elite_air_loader: Fills or empties the compressed air car stopped in front of it (640 L/t).
description.pioneers.ultimate_air_loader: Fills or empties the compressed air car stopped in front of it (2560 L/t).
description.pioneers.coaling_tower: Loads fuel into steam locomotives and tenders stopped in front of it.
description.pioneers.platform_crane: Puts the block from its storage on the flat car, or takes it back (load / unload button).
description.pioneers.nuclear_fuel_statio: Refuels the nuclear locomotive with fresh assemblies and takes back the spent ones.
description.pioneers.fuel_pump: Refuels diesel locomotives (diesel, biodiesel, kerosene, fuel oil, LNG) and gas locomotives (natural gas, methane, propane, butane, biogas, hydrogen).
description.pioneers.steam_charger: Fills the fireless locomotive with steam. Steam comes in through the logistic cable (bronze or better).
description.pioneers.charging_post: Charges the battery of electric and maglev locomotives stopped in front of it.
description.pioneers.passenger_platform: Boards villagers standing on the platform into the passenger car stopped in front of it, or lets them off.
description.pioneers.catenary_pole: Carries the wire over the neighboring track (6 blocks around). Linked to poles within 16 blocks and to a substation, it powers electric locomotives.
description.pioneers.third_rail: Conductor rail beside the track (tunnels, low lines): linked every 3 blocks to a substation, it powers electric locomotives.
description.pioneers.basic_substation: Takes energy from cables (stores 8 M FE) and powers the linked poles, third rails and MKIV tracks.
description.pioneers.advanced_substation: Takes energy from cables (stores 64 M FE) and powers the linked poles, third rails and MKIV tracks.
description.pioneers.elite_substation: Takes energy from cables (stores 512 M FE) and powers the linked poles, third rails and MKIV tracks.
description.pioneers.ultimate_substation: Takes energy from cables (stores 4 G FE) and powers the linked poles, third rails and MKIV tracks.
item.pioneers.fireless_locomotive.toolti: Steam reservoir filled at a steam charger: no fuel, short range. Ideal in factories.
item.pioneers.diesel_locomotive.tooltip: Liquid fuels from the fuel pump: powerful and versatile.
item.pioneers.gas_locomotive.tooltip: Fuel gases from the fuel pump; on hydrogen, ×1.5 efficiency and no smoke.
item.pioneers.electric_locomotive.toolti: Catenary, third rail or MKIV track; backup battery, recharged when braking.
item.pioneers.nuclear_locomotive.tooltip: Fuel assemblies: very long range; spent ones go to reprocessing. No radiation.
item.pioneers.maglev_locomotive.tooltip: Levitates on MKIV track only, which carries the energy (substation placed against it).
item.pioneers.gas_tank_car.tooltip: One gas under pressure: filling arm.
item.pioneers.flat_car.tooltip: One block on top: platform crane.
item.pioneers.passenger_car.tooltip: Two seats: right-click to sit; the passenger platform boards villagers.
rail.pioneers.side.how_below: Click a track: placed underneath, in place of the block that carries it
rail.pioneers.car.store_tip.gas: Filling arm, fuel pump, steam charger
gui.pioneers.rail_post.grid_hint: Poles within 16 blocks, MKIV track against it
rail.pioneers.shape.slope_auto: Slope: the shape follows the neighboring tracks
description.pioneers.weighbridge: Straight track that weighs the train on it: mass, vehicles, fill. Comparator: fill (0 to 15); right-click: the reading; PioScript: rail.weigh.
description.pioneers.uncoupler_track: Under a coupling of a train stopped at a station: the train is split there. The front leaves with its schedule, the rear stays in manual.
rail.pioneers.train.group_tip: Trains in a group share their schedule and interrupts: editing one edits them all.
rail.pioneers.train.joker_tip: Wildcard: replaced by the train’s most abundant resource when the interrupt fires.
rail.pioneers.train.temp.cancel_tip: The train drops these stops and resumes its schedule.
rail.pioneers.train.temp.cancel_delivery: The delivery is abandoned; the train resumes its schedule.
rail.pioneers.train.interrupts_hint: Library shared by all trains. Enable the ones this train uses. When an interrupt’s conditions are true on leaving a stop (or after 10 s without a path), the train first visits its stops, then resumes its schedule. Wildcards in stations: {item}, {fluid}, {gas}.
rail.pioneers.train.interrupts_hint_grou: Library shared by all trains; enabled interrupts apply to the whole “%s” group. Wildcards in stations: {item}, {fluid}, {gas}.
rail.pioneers.train.no_interrupts: No interrupt yet: create one (e.g. “Fuel ≤ 20% → Depot”).
rail.pioneers.train.interrupt_inside_tip: Otherwise it waits until the train has finished the other interrupt.
rail.pioneers.train.logistic_tip: Stopped empty at a Depot station, it waits for a job: the dispatcher sends it to load at a supplying station, unload at a requesting station, then back to the depot. Its schedule must lead it to a depot.
rail.pioneers.train.task.waiting: At the depot: waiting for a request.
rail.pioneers.train.send_tip: A temporary stop (5 s of inactivity), then it resumes its schedule.
rail.pioneers.train.send_manual: Switch the train to automatic to send it.
rail.pioneers.train.signal_tip: Name of the signal written by a computer (rail.signal("name", value)).
rail.pioneers.train.cond.inactivity.tip: Seconds without loading or unloading anything.
rail.pioneers.train.cond.item.tip: Count of an item in the train.
rail.pioneers.train.cond.fuel.tip: Energy reserve of the least supplied locomotive (%).
rail.pioneers.train.cond.fluid.tip: Fluid or gas in the tank cars (mB).
rail.pioneers.train.cond.cargo.tip: The train carries something (sets the {item}, {fluid}, {gas} wildcards).
rail.pioneers.train.cond.station_stock.t: Contents of the station’s platform loaders.
rail.pioneers.train.cond.network_stock.t: Stock of the robotic network covering the station.
rail.pioneers.train.cond.signal.tip: Value of a named signal, written by a PioScript computer.
rail.pioneers.train.cond.redstone.tip: Redstone power received by the station sign.
rail.pioneers.train.cond.dest_free.tip: The next stop has room (train limit).
rail.pioneers.station.add_token_tip: Adds a resource to the name (“Iron [iron ingot]” station): interrupt wildcards lead there.
rail.pioneers.station.role.none.tip: Ordinary station: only schedules bring trains here.
rail.pioneers.station.role.depot.tip: Logistic trains wait here for the dispatcher’s jobs.
rail.pioneers.station.role.supply.tip: Offers what is on its platform; the network’s robots bring its resources here.
rail.pioneers.station.role.demand.tip: Keeps a resource level: the dispatcher sends trains here; robots empty its platform.
rail.pioneers.station.role.both.tip: Supplies and requests at once (exchange station).
rail.pioneers.station.none_hint: Choose a role so the dispatcher looks after this station.
rail.pioneers.station.depot_hint: Empty logistic trains stopped here get the deliveries to make. Give your logistic trains a schedule that brings them here.
rail.pioneers.station.entries.supply: Offered resources (amount robots keep on the platform)
rail.pioneers.station.terminal_tip: Also requests what the robotic network lacks for its logistic terminals’ orders.
rail.pioneers.station.network: Robotic network: the platform loaders are its points (no marker needed).
rail.pioneers.station.no_network: Outside a robotic network: the stock is the platform’s.
rail.pioneers.map.no_deliveries: No delivery: give your stations a role (Depot, Supplies, Requests) and check “Logistic train” on your trains.
item.pioneers.track_layer.tooltip: Train stopped at the end of the line: lays the track of a works planner job ahead of it, using the blocks in its 18 slots.
description.pioneers.level_crossing: Planked straight track: walk across it. Barriers placed next to it close when trains pass.
description.pioneers.crossing_barrier: Placed on the road next to the track: closes (red lights, bell) when a train is within 8 blocks, and blocks the way.
description.pioneers.viaduct_pillar: Connects vertically: footing at the bottom, capital under the track.
description.pioneers.railing: Connects like a fence: edges of viaducts and platforms.
description.pioneers.tunnel_portal: Masonry that forms its own frame around a one-block-wide opening (jambs, lintel, keystone).
description.pioneers.platform_slab: Concrete half block: white edge and yellow line facing the nearby track.
description.pioneers.platform_lamp: Lights the platform (drawn two blocks high: leave room above).
robotics.pioneers.planner.tool.rail.tool: Give a start and an end: the gentlest railroad is laid out (45° headings, gentle slopes on straights), with viaducts, cuttings and tunnels
robotics.pioneers.works.rail_intro: Click the ground at the start, then at the end (more points: waypoints). The shapes (curves, diagonals, slopes) match actual track laying.
robotics.pioneers.works.rail_info: Above ground: embankment (2 blocks at most), then viaduct (deck and a pillar every 4 blocks). Below: 3-block-high cut or tunnel. A track layer can also lay the track ahead of a train.
description.pioneers.rail_works: The only place to build locomotives, cars, mine carts and draisines, of every tier. Engine shed. Mechanical cladding. Shift + right-click for the blueprint.
robotics.pioneers.works.rail_start: Railroad: click the ground at the start
robotics.pioneers.works.rail_end: Railroad: click the ground at the end
robotics.pioneers.works.rail_next: Railroad: %s tiles · click: next point · Shift + click: move the end · Enter: confirm
robotics.pioneers.works.rail_broken: No route all the way through (slope too steep, no room): add a waypoint or move the end.
robotics.pioneers.works.rail_blocks: %s blocks to place (track, embankment, viaduct), shown as ghosts
item.pioneers.ferry.tooltip: Carries passengers between harbors: board from the ship sheet while docked.
item.pioneers.tanker.tooltip: Carries one fluid at a time.
item.pioneers.gas_carrier.tooltip: Carries one gas at a time in its spheres.
item.pioneers.air_carrier.tooltip: Carries compressed air in its cylinders.
item.pioneers.data_ship.tooltip: Carries data (one type at a time) in its racks.
description.pioneers.basic_harbor: Harbor office: in the middle of the far end of a U-shaped basin of quay slabs, of fixed size for its tier (3 × 9, walls 3 blocks high), opening behind it; the ship sails into the basin, in line with the office. Dock equipment (crane, loading arms, charger, gangway, bunkering…) replaces top slabs; harbor interfaces, any slab. Accepts ships up to MKI. Shift + right-click: basin blueprint.
description.pioneers.advanced_harbor: Harbor office: in the middle of the far end of a U-shaped basin of quay slabs, of fixed size for its tier (5 × 11, walls 3 blocks high), opening behind it; the ship sails into the basin, in line with the office. Dock equipment (crane, loading arms, charger, gangway, bunkering…) replaces top slabs; harbor interfaces, any slab. Accepts ships up to MKII. Shift + right-click: basin blueprint.
description.pioneers.elite_harbor: Harbor office: in the middle of the far end of a U-shaped basin of quay slabs, of fixed size for its tier (5 × 13, walls 3 blocks high), opening behind it; the ship sails into the basin, in line with the office. Dock equipment (crane, loading arms, charger, gangway, bunkering…) replaces top slabs; harbor interfaces, any slab. Accepts ships up to MKIII. Shift + right-click: basin blueprint.
description.pioneers.ultimate_harbor: Harbor office: in the middle of the far end of a U-shaped basin of quay slabs, of fixed size for its tier (5 × 17, walls 3 blocks high), opening behind it; the ship sails into the basin, in line with the office. Dock equipment (crane, loading arms, charger, gangway, bunkering…) replaces top slabs; harbor interfaces, any slab. Accepts ships up to MKIV. Shift + right-click: basin blueprint.
naval.pioneers.tip.propulsion.0: Paddle steamer: solid fuel in the bunker
naval.pioneers.tip.propulsion.1: Diesel: liquid fuels (diesel, kerosene, fuel oil, LNG…)
naval.pioneers.tip.propulsion.2: Electric: batteries recharged at the harbor
naval.pioneers.tip.lava: Tungsten hull: also sails on lava seas
naval.pioneers.ship.title: Ship
naval.pioneers.ship.board_tip: While docked: take a seat on the ferry (Sneak to get off).
naval.pioneers.ship.moving: The ship must be stopped or docked
naval.pioneers.ship.lava: Only a MKIV ship (tungsten hull) can sail on lava
naval.pioneers.ship.logistic_tip: Docked empty at a Depot harbor, it waits for a job: the dispatcher sends it to load at a supplying harbor, unload at a requesting harbor, then back to the depot. It must match the resource (cargo ship for items, tanker for fluids…).
naval.pioneers.status.no_path: No feasible sea route to the harbor
naval.pioneers.status.no_fuel: Out of fuel (fuel, liquid fuel, batteries or assemblies)
naval.pioneers.harbor.title: Harbor sheet
naval.pioneers.harbor.name: Harbor name
naval.pioneers.harbor.hint: The ship sails into the U-shaped basin, in line with the harbor office; each resource goes through its dock equipment.
naval.pioneers.harbor.same: %s harbors share this name: ships go to the nearest free one.
naval.pioneers.harbor.add_token_tip: Adds a resource to the name (“Iron [iron ingot]” harbor).
description.pioneers.shipyard: The only place to build ships of every tier, in its dry dock; also makes wooden boats and rafts (like the carpenter’s bench). Open basin. Mechanical cladding. Shift + right-click for the blueprint.
description.pioneers.harbor_quay: Block of the harbor’s U-shaped basin: the far end (harbor office in the middle) and both arms, as walls 3 blocks high. The yellow band and fenders follow the water edges by themselves; a slab under another one becomes a plain wall.
description.pioneers.harbor_crane: Loads and unloads a cargo ship’s items: the jib swings to the ship and shuttles a container back and forth. Replaces a basin slab, preferably on an arm of the U; connects to cables.
description.pioneers.harbor_fluid_arm: Articulated arm that lands on the tanker’s deck: transfers the fluid. Replaces a basin slab, preferably on an arm of the U; connects to cables.
description.pioneers.harbor_gas_arm: Insulated arm for the gas carrier: transfers the gas. Replaces a basin slab, preferably on an arm of the U; connects to cables.
description.pioneers.harbor_charger: Power cable lowered onto the ship: drains or fills the power barge and recharges electric ships’ batteries. Replaces a basin slab, preferably on an arm of the U; connects to cables.
description.pioneers.harbor_air_arm: Loading arm for the compressed air carrier. Replaces a basin slab, preferably on an arm of the U; connects to cables.
description.pioneers.harbor_data_mast: Dish aimed at the data ship: a beam transfers the data. Replaces a basin slab, preferably on an arm of the U; connects to cables.
description.pioneers.harbor_gangway: Covered gangway lowered onto the ferry: villagers board and get off. Replaces a basin slab, preferably on an arm of the U; connects to cables.
description.pioneers.harbor_bunker: Refuels the engines: solid fuel and assemblies (harbor office slots), liquid fuel (tank). Replaces a basin slab, preferably on an arm of the U; connects to cables.
naval.pioneers.equipment.alone: Not linked to a harbor office yet (place it in the U of the basin)
gear.pioneers.module.night_vision.desc: Lets you see in the dark.
gear.pioneers.module.respirator.desc: Lets you breathe underwater and in vacuum (with a full set, depending on its tier).
gear.pioneers.module.scanner.desc: Highlights nearby creatures through walls (12 blocks per level).
gear.pioneers.module.nutrition.desc: Feeds the wearer from the armor’s energy.
gear.pioneers.module.solar.desc: Recharges the whole set in sunlight (25 FE/t per level).
gear.pioneers.module.jetpack.desc: Hold jump to fly upward; climb speed follows the level.
gear.pioneers.module.flight.desc: Creative-style free flight (double jump). Level 2: faster.
gear.pioneers.module.shield.desc: Absorbs 20% of damage per level, drawing on energy.
gear.pioneers.module.nanites.desc: Slowly heals the wearer (faster each level).
gear.pioneers.module.thermal.desc: Immunity to fire and lava (drains while burning).
gear.pioneers.module.magnet.desc: Pulls dropped items toward you (4 blocks per level).
gear.pioneers.module.step.desc: Walk up one-block steps without jumping.
gear.pioneers.module.dampers.desc: Cancels fall damage, drawing on energy.
gear.pioneers.module.kinetic.desc: Recharges the set as you walk.
gear.pioneers.module.excavation.desc: Digs 3 × 3 (level 1) or 5 × 5 (level 2). Sneak to mine a single block.
gear.pioneers.module.silk_touch.desc: Harvests blocks intact (takes priority over Fortune).
gear.pioneers.module.teleport.desc: Loot from mined blocks goes straight into your inventory.
gear.pioneers.module.vampirism.desc: Heals you for 8% of damage dealt, per level.
gear.pioneers.module.looting.desc: Looting I to III on creatures.
gear.pioneers.module.overcharge.desc: +35% damage per level (and more energy per shot).
gear.pioneers.module.volley.desc: One more bolt per level, fanned out.
description.pioneers.modulation_bench: Place a piece of modular gear (armor, tool, blade, rifle) to install, remove, switch its modules on or off; recharges it (energy from cables or a battery).
gear.pioneers.no_modules: No modules: use a Modulation Bench.
gear.pioneers.multitool_hint: Right-click: strip or make a path; sneaking: till.
gear.pioneers.rifle.empty: Plasma rifle empty: recharge it at a Modulation Bench.
gear.pioneers.module.max: Max level: %s (one module per level; MKI: II, MKII: III)
gear.pioneers.module.install: Install it at a Modulation Bench.
gear.pioneers.refuse.kind: This module does not fit this gear.
gear.pioneers.refuse.tier: This module needs a higher tier.
gear.pioneers.refuse.max: Maximum level reached for this tier.

naval.pioneers.water.none: This ship does not run on steam
nuclear.pioneers.gui.pilot_help: Autopilot: withdraws the rods slowly and holds the core around %s K; power settles to match what the cooling carries away. It re-arms a heat shutdown by itself. Setting the rods turns it off.
nuclear.pioneers.gui.rods_manual: Setting the rods by hand turns the autopilot off.
nuclear.pioneers.gui.why_help.1: Put fuel in the input slots (MKI assemblies, MKII MOX, MKIII cartridges): JEI, “Reactors” category.
nuclear.pioneers.gui.why_help.2: Reset once the core is below the shutdown temperature, with no redstone signal. With the autopilot, a heat shutdown re-arms by itself.
nuclear.pioneers.gui.why_help.3: Withdraw the rods (−10, −1) or turn the autopilot back on.
nuclear.pioneers.gui.why_help.4: The rods come out slowly and power rises: a few seconds.
nuclear.pioneers.gui.why_help.5: All the water received boils off: power is capped by it. Bring more water through a fluid port (1 mB carries 400 J away and makes 8 mB of steam).
nuclear.pioneers.gui.why_help.6: The steam tank is full: take the steam out through an output gas port, to turbines.
nuclear.pioneers.gui.why_help.7: MKII: fill the primary sodium (1,000 mB per channel, never consumed) through a fluid port.
nuclear.pioneers.gui.why_help.8: MKIII: igniting the field takes 20,000 FE/t for 5 s; bring power through an input energy port.
nuclear.pioneers.gui.why_help.9: MKIII: at least 8 confinement coils are needed.
nuclear.pioneers.gui.why_help.10: The core melted: break and place the controller again.
nuclear.pioneers.gui.why_help.11: Place the control rods of the projected plan (Sneak + right-click on the controller).
jei.pioneers.reactor.fuel_power: %s J/t per fuel at full power; %s slots: %s J/t.
jei.pioneers.reactor.fuel_life: One fuel lasts %s ticks at full power (%s min), then comes out spent (and hot: pool).
jei.pioneers.reactor.electric: 80%% as direct electricity (up to %s FE/t, through the energy ports); field ignition: %s FE/t for 5 s.
jei.pioneers.reactor.sodium: Primary sodium: %s mB, never consumed (if it runs low, the core runs away).
jei.pioneers.reactor.cooling: At full power: %s mB of water per tick → %s mB of steam per tick (a gas, to the turbines).
jei.pioneers.reactor.pilot: Autopilot: power adjusts to the water received and the steam removed; the reactor starts by itself once fueled.
jei.pioneers.reactor.targets: One target per two fuel slots (%s at most); 200 MJ of core heat each.
jei.pioneers.reactor.targets_use: Lithium-6 → tritium; neptunium-237 → plutonium-238 (radioisotope generator sources).
jei.pioneers.reactor.blankets: One blanket per two slots (%s at most); breeding ratio %s.
jei.pioneers.reactor.blankets_use: Depleted uranium → plutonium; thorium → uranium-233. Reprocessing: MOX and later fuels.
jei.pioneers.reactor.fusion_power: Up to %s J/t of fusion (%s J/t per plasma cell).
jei.pioneers.reactor.fusion_fuel: %s mB of each gas per MJ: at full power, %s mB per minute (gauges).
jei.pioneers.reactor.fusion_tokamak: Deuterium + tritium; 180,000 FE/t of heating to ignite; breeding blankets to remake the tritium.
jei.pioneers.reactor.fusion_stellarator: Deuterium + helium-3; 300,000 FE/t of heating to ignite; up to 90%% direct electricity with the converters.
jei.pioneers.reactor.fusion_helium: Liquid helium for the coils (1 mB/t each); helium comes out as gas (ash and boil-off); water → steam.
jei.pioneers.reactor.breeding: One lithium ceramic pebble = 1,000 mB of tritium, returned to the input tank, the surplus to the output.
naval.pioneers.ship.auto_tip: The ship follows its schedule and finds its own way over the water.
naval.pioneers.ship.cond.cargo.tip: The ship carries something (sets the {item}, {fluid}, {gas} wildcards).
naval.pioneers.ship.cond.dest_free.tip: The next stop has room (ship limit).
naval.pioneers.ship.cond.fluid.tip: Fluid or gas in the holds (mB).
naval.pioneers.ship.cond.fuel.tip: Energy reserve of the least supplied engine (%).
naval.pioneers.ship.cond.item.tip: Count of an item on board.
naval.pioneers.ship.cond.network_stock.t: Stock of the robotic network covering the harbor.
naval.pioneers.ship.cond.redstone.tip: Redstone power received by the harbor office.
naval.pioneers.ship.cond.station_stock.t: Contents of the harbor office’s stock.
naval.pioneers.ship.group_tip: Ships in a group share their schedule and interrupts: editing one edits them all.
naval.pioneers.ship.interrupt_inside_tip: Otherwise it waits until the ship has finished the other interrupt.
naval.pioneers.ship.interrupts_hint: Library shared by all ships. Enable the ones this ship uses. When an interrupt’s conditions are true on leaving a stop (or after 10 s without a route), the ship first visits its stops, then resumes its schedule. Wildcards in harbors: {item}, {fluid}, {gas}.
naval.pioneers.ship.interrupts_hint_grou: Library shared by all ships; enabled interrupts apply to the whole “%s” group. Wildcards in harbors: {item}, {fluid}, {gas}.
naval.pioneers.ship.joker_tip: Wildcard: replaced by the ship’s most abundant resource when the interrupt fires.
naval.pioneers.ship.name: Ship name
naval.pioneers.ship.no_stops: No stops: add harbors; the ship visits them in order and starts over.
naval.pioneers.ship.send_manual: Switch the ship to automatic to send it.
naval.pioneers.ship.temp.cancel_delivery: The delivery is abandoned; the ship resumes its schedule.
naval.pioneers.ship.temp.cancel_tip: The ship drops these stops and resumes its schedule.
naval.pioneers.harbor.depot_hint: Empty logistics ships docked here get the deliveries to make. Give your logistics ships a schedule that brings them here.
naval.pioneers.harbor.entries.supply: Offered resources (amount robots keep at the harbor)
naval.pioneers.harbor.network: Robotic network: the harbor office is one of its points (no marker needed).
naval.pioneers.harbor.no_network: Outside a robotic network: the stock is the harbor office’s.
naval.pioneers.harbor.none_hint: Choose a role so the dispatcher looks after this harbor.
naval.pioneers.harbor.role.both.tip: Supplies and requests at once (exchange harbor).
naval.pioneers.harbor.role.demand.tip: Keeps a resource level: the dispatcher sends ships here; robots empty its stock.
naval.pioneers.harbor.role.depot.tip: Logistics ships wait here for the dispatcher’s jobs.
naval.pioneers.harbor.role.none.tip: Ordinary harbor: only schedules bring ships here.
naval.pioneers.harbor.role.supply.tip: Offers what is in its stock; the network’s robots bring its resources here.
naval.pioneers.car.water_tip: Water bucket (right-click the ship) or bunkering at the harbor.
naval.pioneers.car.fire_tip: The firebox burns the fuel in its slots, then the bunker’s.

description.pioneers.harbor_interface: A harbor wall slab (any row) whose every face gives access to the harbor office’s stock: plug cables and pipes into it without going around the office’s sides. Same settings as the matching face of the office.
description.pioneers.concrete_shell_pane: Thin reinforced-concrete shell of cooling towers, above their frame legs. No tier: the basin and the legs set the tower's.
description.pioneers.sea_beacon: Lit buoy, placed on water (or on a rock). Link beacons with the navigation chart: each link becomes a sea lane charted offshore. A ship that sees a beacon (256 blocks) from where it starts follows the network to the beacon closest to its harbor: the way to make very long trips and sail around continents.
naval.pioneers.chart.tooltip: Right-click a sea beacon, then another one: they get linked (or unlinked). Sneak + right-click in the air: forget the selected beacon.
naval.pioneers.chart.selected: Beacon selected (%s): right-click another beacon to link them
naval.pioneers.chart.too_far: Too far: %s blocks at most between two beacons
naval.pioneers.chart.missing: The selected beacon is gone: start again
naval.pioneers.beacon.lane_ok: Sea lane charted between the beacons: %s blocks
naval.pioneers.beacon.lane_none: No sea lane between these beacons (impassable land or closed sea)
naval.pioneers.beacon.info: Sea beacon: %s link(s) — %s charted, %s being charted, %s impossible
naval.pioneers.beacon.no_ports: No harbor within %s blocks of a beacon of this network
description.pioneers.industrial_glass_ad: Transparent wall of a multiblock. Like a casing, the weakest pane gives the structure its tier; its frame shows the color.
description.pioneers.industrial_glass_el: Transparent wall of a multiblock. Like a casing, the weakest pane gives the structure its tier; its frame shows the color.
description.pioneers.industrial_glass_ul: Transparent wall of a multiblock. Like a casing, the weakest pane gives the structure its tier; its frame shows the color.
advancements.pioneers.heat_pressure.glas: Make an industrial glass pane to watch a multiblock work.
description.pioneers.gravity_compressor: Crushes matter: planet rocks and gases (compacted planetary matter), stellar and singularity cores, singularity cell. Sphere. Electric cladding. Shift + right-click for the blueprint.
description.pioneers.synthesizer: Makes a simulated planet in three steps: data (data port), atmosphere (gases), final conversion. Domed vessel. Digital cladding. Shift + right-click for the blueprint.
item.pioneers.compacted_planet.desc: A planet’s rocks (or gases) crushed in the Gravity Compressor. Next step: data, in the Synthesizer.
item.pioneers.proto_simulated_planet.des: Its atmosphere holds. Last step: conversion with stellar plasma, in the Synthesizer.
industry.pioneers.gui.risers_help: The platform lowers its own tubing (one per block of water). Bring it through an item port: the platform requests it and the robotic network delivers it.
item.pioneers.production_tubing.desc: The offshore platform lowers one per block of water under each riser.
item.pioneers.hypertube.how: Right-click: start (station, tube end or free block), then right-click: end — the line goes on from the end. Shift + right-click: stop; left-click a tube (anything in hand): dismantle it
message.pioneers.hypertube.aim: Aim at the end: a station, a tube end or a free block
message.pioneers.hypertube.obstacle: Obstacle at %s %s %s: the hypertube cannot bend around it
message.pioneers.hypertube.first: Right-click a station, a tube end or a free block: start
message.pioneers.hypertube.first_station: Right-click: start from this side of the station
message.pioneers.hypertube.no_anchor: Nothing to link here: aim at a station, a tube end or a free block
message.pioneers.hypertube.too_short: Too short: move the end away from the start
message.pioneers.hypertube.too_tight: Bend too tight: radius %s blocks (%s at least)
message.pioneers.hypertube.face_used: This side of the station already has a tube
advancements.pioneers.bronze.steam_cable: Send a boiler’s steam into a bronze logistic cable.
pioscript.help.intro: PioScript help: help("category") or help("function"). Categories:
pioscript.help.unknown: No help for "%s". Try help() for the list.
pioscript.help.title: PioScript help
pioscript.help.hint: Click a function: inserts it into the program. F1: help for the word under the cursor. Esc: close.
pioscript.doc.variables.desc: A variable is created by giving it a value: integers and decimals, text in quotes, True / False, None, lists [..], dictionaries {..}. x += 1 adds 1.
pioscript.doc.if.desc: Runs the indented block (4 spaces) if the condition is true; elif and else give the other cases. Comparisons: == != < <= > >=, in, is; logic: and, or, not.
pioscript.doc.while.desc: Repeats the block while the condition is true. while True: runs forever (put a sleep() in it). break leaves the loop, continue skips to the next iteration.
pioscript.doc.for.desc: Walks through a list, a string, a dictionary (its keys) or a range(). Several variables at once: for key, value in d.items():
pioscript.doc.def.desc: Defines a function (parameters may have default values); return gives back the result. global x lets the function change a program variable.
pioscript.doc.f-string.desc: Text with inserted values: {x}, {x:.2f} (2 decimals), {x:>8} (right-aligned on 8), {x:<8}, {x:^8}, {x:d} (integer), {x:%} (percentage).
pioscript.doc.slices.desc: Indexes start at 0, negative ones count from the end: l[0], l[-1]; slices l[1:3], text[::-1] (reversed).
pioscript.doc.operators.desc: Math: + - * /, // integer division, % remainder, ** power. a if condition else b picks a value. # starts a comment.
pioscript.doc.print.desc: Writes its arguments to the console, separated by spaces.
pioscript.doc.input.desc: Asks a question in the console and waits for a typed line; returns the typed text.
pioscript.doc.help.desc: Built-in help: help() lists the categories, help("math") one category, help("math.sqrt") one function (description and example). Also: "?" button or F1 in the terminal.
pioscript.doc.len.desc: Length of a string, list, dictionary or range.
pioscript.doc.isinstance.desc: True if x is of that type (a name or a list of names); "number" accepts int and float.
pioscript.doc.int.desc: Converts to an integer (drops decimals, reads a string).
pioscript.doc.bool.desc: True or false: 0, "", [], {} and None are false.
pioscript.doc.repr.desc: String representation of the value, quotes included.
pioscript.doc.range.desc: Sequence of integers (stop excluded), for for loops.
pioscript.doc.enumerate.desc: List of [index, item] pairs: for i, x in enumerate(l):
pioscript.doc.zip.desc: Pairs several lists item by item (stops at the shortest).
pioscript.doc.list.desc: New list (empty, or from a string, a range, a dictionary’s keys…).
pioscript.doc.sorted.desc: Sorted copy (numbers or text); True as second argument: largest first.
pioscript.doc.any.desc: True if at least one item is true.
pioscript.doc.all.desc: True if every item is true (and for an empty list).
pioscript.doc.round.desc: Rounding (an integer without a second argument).
pioscript.doc.divmod.desc: Integer quotient and remainder: [a // b, a % b].
pioscript.doc.randint.desc: Random integer from a to b inclusive.
pioscript.doc.sleep.desc: Pauses the program (at least 1 tick, 1 hour at most). Needed in an endless loop.
pioscript.doc.math.clamp.desc: Keeps x between lo and hi.
pioscript.doc.math.lerp.desc: Interpolation: a when t = 0, b when t = 1.
pioscript.doc.math.atan2.desc: Angle of point (x, y) in radians, from -π to π.
pioscript.doc.math.hypot.desc: Length of the vector (distance from the origin).
pioscript.doc.math.log.desc: Logarithm (natural, or in the given base).
pioscript.doc.math.isnan.desc: True if x is not a number (nan).
pioscript.doc.str.strip.desc: Without leading and trailing spaces (lstrip: leading, rstrip: trailing).
pioscript.doc.str.split.desc: Splits into a list (on spaces if no argument).
pioscript.doc.str.partition.desc: Cuts at the first separator: [before, separator, after].
pioscript.doc.str.join.desc: Joins a list of strings with this separator.
pioscript.doc.str.find.desc: Position of the first occurrence, -1 if absent (rfind: the last).
pioscript.doc.str.rfind.desc: Position of the last occurrence, -1 if absent.
pioscript.doc.str.zfill.desc: Pads with zeros on the left.
pioscript.doc.str.ljust.desc: Left-aligned on this width (rjust: right, center: centered).
pioscript.doc.list.extend.desc: Adds all items of another list.
pioscript.doc.list.pop.desc: Removes and returns item i (the last by default).
pioscript.doc.list.remove.desc: Removes the first occurrence of x.
pioscript.doc.dict.get.desc: Value of the key, or the default if missing.
pioscript.doc.dict.setdefault.desc: Value of the key; if missing, adds it with the default.
pioscript.doc.dict.pop.desc: Removes the key and returns its value.
pioscript.doc.dict.update.desc: Copies the keys of another dictionary.
pioscript.doc.json.dumps.desc: Turns a value (numbers, strings, lists, dictionaries, True/False/None) into JSON text, to save it in a file.
pioscript.doc.json.loads.desc: Reads JSON text back into a value.
pioscript.doc.redstone.get.desc: Signal received on this side (0 to 15). Sides: north, south, east, west, up, down (or nord, sud…).
pioscript.doc.redstone.set.desc: Emits this signal (0 to 15) on this side.
pioscript.doc.redstone.output.desc: Signal currently emitted on this side.
pioscript.doc.redstone.inputs.desc: Every received signal: dictionary side → level.
pioscript.doc.redstone.all.desc: Emits this signal on all six sides (0: all off).
pioscript.doc.link.desc: Linked machine n (1 to 4) — link made with the data link tool (Shift + right-click the machine, then right-click the computer).
pioscript.doc.links.desc: The used links: list of {"n", "name", "connected"} records.
pioscript.doc.link.connected.desc: True if the machine is still there and loaded.
pioscript.doc.link.command.desc: Sends a command (e.g. "rods", "scram", "enable"). Returns true if accepted.
pioscript.doc.screen.print.desc: Adds a line at the bottom of the linked supervision screens (the text scrolls).
pioscript.doc.screen.center.desc: Writes centered text on this row.
pioscript.doc.screen.bar.desc: Text progress bar on this row: label [█████░░░░] 55%.
pioscript.doc.fs.list.desc: File names of a drive: "a", "b" (floppies) or "c" (internal disk).
pioscript.doc.fs.read.desc: Contents of a file ("a:name", "b:name" or "name" on the internal disk).
pioscript.doc.fs.lines.desc: The lines of a file (a list; empty if it does not exist).
pioscript.doc.fs.size.desc: File size in characters (-1 if it does not exist).
pioscript.doc.fs.delete.desc: Deletes a file (true if it existed).
pioscript.doc.fs.rename.desc: Renames or moves a file (also between drives).
pioscript.doc.world.time.desc: Time of day in ticks (0 to 23,999; 0 = 6 am).
pioscript.doc.world.day.desc: Day number since the world was created.
pioscript.doc.computer.program.desc: File name of the running program.
pioscript.doc.compute.available.desc: Free GOPS on the computing network it touches (MKI logistic cable or adjacent data center).
pioscript.doc.compute.request.desc: Requests n GOPS (renew at least every second); returns what is granted.
pioscript.doc.compute.total.desc: Computing served in the whole world (GOPS).
pioscript.doc.flight.check.desc: Flight computers in the drive: "none", "blank" or "programmed".
pioscript.doc.flight.flash.desc: Programs the whole stack of flight computers in the drive; returns how many were programmed.
pioscript.doc.rail.train.desc: Record of one train (name or start of the id), or None.
pioscript.doc.rail.send.desc: Sends an automatic train to a station (temporary stop, then it resumes its schedule).
pioscript.doc.rail.station.desc: Record of one station with its platform stock ("stock"), or None.
pioscript.doc.rail.set_limit.desc: Train limit of every station with this name (-1: no limit).
pioscript.doc.rail.signal.desc: Named signal read by the "Signal" schedule condition.
pioscript.doc.rail.weigh.desc: Weighbridge reading at this position (mass, cars, fill, train), or None.
pioscript.doc.naval.ship.desc: Record of one ship, or None.
pioscript.doc.naval.send.desc: Sends a ship to a port (temporary stop).
block.pioneers.mechanical_drill.desc: Placed on rock, it draws stone from it endlessly: cobblestone from stone, granite from granite… One block every 3 turns, pushed into a neighboring container (chest, wooden hopper) or left in its slot.
block.pioneers.wooden_hopper.desc: No inventory: it takes one item from above (container or dropped item) and puts it straight into the container its spout points at, twice a second. Whatever is poured in goes straight through. Redstone signal: stop.
advancements.pioneers.mechanics.drill.de: Extract stone with a mechanical drill.
message.pioneers.hypertube.first_cell: Right-click: start here (the tube ends in this block)
message.pioneers.hypertube.built_next: Hypertube laid: %s tubes (%s blocks) — the next one starts here (Shift + click: stop)
description.pioneers.basic_solar_panel: Light → energy. Needs the sky above it. Output depends on the sun’s height (nothing at night), the weather (rain, storm) and the world: the closer to the star, the more it produces (Mercury ×4, Mars ×0.43, Jupiter ×0.04); without an atmosphere, ×1.3. Touching panels pool their energy: one cable is enough for a whole field.

description.pioneers.basic_wind_turbine: Nacelle (full block) to put on top of a mast you build yourself; place a wind rotor on its front face: no rotor, no power. It runs at the lower tier of the two. The higher, the more it makes (full at 100 blocks above sea level). Keep the rotor disc clear or output collapses. Gusts, rain ×1.25, storm ×1.6; no wind without air.

Output depends on the head (full with 16 blocks of water above it) and the reservoir volume, shared between the turbines drawing on it. The water is not used up.

description.pioneers.basic_geothermal_pl: Pumps water into hot rock and runs the returning steam through a turbine. The deeper, the better: nothing above y 48, full at y −60; always at its best in the Nether. Each touching lava or magma block: +10% (+30% at most). Uses water (any side).

description.pioneers.ultimate_geothermal: Pumps water into hot rock and runs the returning steam through a turbine. The deeper, the better: nothing above y 48, full at y −60; always at its best in the Nether. Each touching lava or magma block: +10% (+30% at most). Uses water (any side).
description.pioneers.basic_microbial_fue: Bacteria digest organic matter between two electrodes and make power, burning nothing. It eats anything compostable (seeds, leaves, crops…) and living-world leftovers: wood chips, bagasse, press cake, microalgae… The more compostable an item, the more it produces.
description.pioneers.advanced_microbial_: Bacteria digest organic matter between two electrodes and make power, burning nothing. It eats anything compostable (seeds, leaves, crops…) and living-world leftovers: wood chips, bagasse, press cake, microalgae… The more compostable an item, the more it produces.
description.pioneers.elite_microbial_fue: Bacteria digest organic matter between two electrodes and make power, burning nothing. It eats anything compostable (seeds, leaves, crops…) and living-world leftovers: wood chips, bagasse, press cake, microalgae… The more compostable an item, the more it produces.
