It eats anything compostable (seeds, leaves, crops…) and living-world leftovers: wood chips, bagasse, press cake, microalgae… The more compostable an item, the more it produces.
energy.pioneers.tip.solar_panel: Sun, open sky; neighboring panels share their energy
energy.pioneers.tip.wind_turbine: High up, a rotor on the front face, clear disc
energy.pioneers.tip.hydro_turbine: Intake at the back in a reservoir, free outlet at the front
energy.pioneers.tip.geothermal_plant: Deep down (or in the Nether), with water

jei.pioneers.renewable.hydro_turbine.1: Peak output: 512 / 2,048 / 8,192 / 32,768 FE/t. Intake at the back in the reservoir, free outlet at the front (downstream).
jei.pioneers.renewable.hydro_turbine.2: Head: reservoir surface above the turbine, full at 16 blocks. Volume: 128 / 512 / 2,048 / 8,192 water sources per turbine.
jei.pioneers.renewable.hydro_turbine.3: Turbines on the same reservoir share its volume. If the water in front joins the reservoir, there is no dam: nothing.
jei.pioneers.renewable.microbial_fuel_ce: Output: 256 / 1,024 / 4,096 / 16,384 FE/t while it has food.
Eats anything compostable and living-world leftovers (tag pioneers:organic_matter): an item is worth its composting chance × 12,000 / 24,000 / 48,000 / 96,000 FE.
jei.pioneers.renewable.solar_panel.1: Peak output: 512 / 2,048 / 8,192 / 32,768 FE/t (MKI to MKIV), sun overhead, open sky above.
jei.pioneers.renewable.solar_panel.2: Sun: nothing at night; rain ×0.35, storm ×0.2. World: Mercury ×4, Venus ×0.19 (clouds), Mars ×0.43, belt ×0.13, Jupiter ×0.04; no atmosphere ×1.3; orbital station: almost always in sunlight.
jei.pioneers.renewable.solar_panel.3: Touching panels even out their energy: a single cable serves a whole field.
jei.pioneers.renewable.solar_panel.title: Solar panel
jei.pioneers.renewable.wind_turbine.1: Peak output: 512 / 2,048 / 8,192 / 32,768 FE/t (that of the weaker of nacelle and rotor). Nacelle on top of a mast you build; rotor (separate block) placed on its front face.
jei.pioneers.renewable.wind_turbine.2: Altitude: 10% at sea level, full 100 blocks higher. Rotor disc (radius 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 by rotor): output follows the square of its clear share.
jei.pioneers.renewable.wind_turbine.3: Wind: gusts 0.55 to 1.15, rain ×1.25, storm ×1.6. No air, no wind (Moon, stations); Mars ×0.375, Titan ×1.5.
pioscript.doc.network.connected.desc: True if the computer touches an MKI-or-better logistic cable (it is then on the digital network).
pioscript.doc.network.data.desc: Data stored on the network (banks + fiber): dictionary type → MB.
pioscript.doc.network.capacity.desc: Total capacity of the network’s banks (MB).
pioscript.doc.network.machines.desc: Connected machines: {"n", "name", "role", "x", "y", "z"} records; role = bank, lab, producer, compute, ai, supervision, multiblock or other.
pioscript.doc.network.machine.desc: Machine n of the network, like a link (same methods as link(n): value, values, command…), without the link tool or any distance limit.
pioscript.doc.network.find.desc: Number of the first machine whose name contains this text (None otherwise).
description.pioneers.network_terminal: Against an MKI logistic cable: the whole digital network at a glance. Stored data by type, computing supplied and requested, connected machines and their role, current research and what it lacks, and advice on what to do next. Uses no power.
computing.pioneers.terminal.compute_note: Computing is not data: it is shared power, like electricity. It is neither stored nor carried; everything touching the network benefits from it.
computing.pioneers.terminal.no_data: No data on the network. Antennas (probes, satellites) and analyzers produce it; banks keep it.
computing.pioneers.terminal.legend: One MKI-or-better logistic cable network = one digital network: data, computing and supervision all go through the same cable.
computing.pioneers.terminal.tip.0.title: No network
computing.pioneers.terminal.tip.0: The terminal touches no MKI logistic cable. Place it against a cable: it will see the whole digital network (data, computing, machines).
computing.pioneers.terminal.tip.1.title: No data bank
computing.pioneers.terminal.tip.1: Incoming data is kept nowhere: connect a data bank to the fiber. Labs will draw from it on their own.
computing.pioneers.terminal.tip.2.title: No computing
computing.pioneers.terminal.tip.2: Machines request computing but nobody supplies it: build a data center (GOPS) or a quantum computer (QOPS) and connect it to the fiber (data port) or put the machine against its structure.
computing.pioneers.terminal.tip.3.title: Not enough computing
computing.pioneers.terminal.tip.3: Demand exceeds supply: everyone gets a proportional share. Enlarge the data center or add another one.
computing.pioneers.terminal.tip.4.title: Research lacks data
computing.pioneers.terminal.tip.4: The current research needs data the network does not have (red in the overview). Send probes to the body you need: the antenna feeds their data into the fiber.
computing.pioneers.terminal.tip.5.title: No lab
computing.pioneers.terminal.tip.5: A research project is running but no research lab touches this network: connect one so it uses the data.
computing.pioneers.terminal.tip.6.title: Banks nearly full
computing.pioneers.terminal.tip.6: The network’s banks are over 95% full: add a bank or upgrade one with a kit.
computing.pioneers.terminal.tip.7.title: No data source
computing.pioneers.terminal.tip.7: Nothing produces data on this network: antenna (probes, satellites), geo-spectrometer, bio-sequencer, asteroid crusher, biome analyzer.
computing.pioneers.terminal.tip.8.title: All good
computing.pioneers.terminal.tip.8: Data stored, enough computing, research supplied. Controllers, screens and computers on the fiber can supervise all these machines (computer: network library).
computing.pioneers.terminal.tip.9.title: No research running
computing.pioneers.terminal.tip.9: Open the tech tree (K key) and start a research project: the terminal will tell you what it needs.
robotics.pioneers.works.too_big: Construction plan too large to send to the server: split it into several.
tooltip.pioneers.heated_metal.too_cold: Too cold to forge (%s °C minimum): put it back in the hearth
tooltip.pioneers.heated_metal.quench: Quench it in water to get: %s
tooltip.pioneers.heated_metal.burns: Burning hot: hold crucible tongs in your off hand
foundry.pioneers.auto_pour: Automatic pour: as soon as the table has a mold and is empty, or on a redstone signal
foundry.pioneers.refused: This metal does not melt in a crucible: %s
steam.pioneers.alloy_tank_empty: Liquid metal: empty (put a casting table in front)
mechanical.pioneers.hammer_cold: The metal is too cold: put it back in the hearth
block.pioneers.quench_basin.desc: Fill it with a water bucket (4,000 mB, 25 per quench). Right-click with a hot piece: it quenches for 3 s in the water, then use an empty hand to take it. Empty hand: basin status. Hoppers on top and sides, output from below.
item.pioneers.ingot_die.desc: Casting machine: ingots (144 mB of molten metal each); in the multiblock, continuous casting: ingots in series. In the Tool slot: unbreakable, never consumed.
item.pioneers.plate_die.desc: Casting machine: 1 plate per ingot of molten metal; in the multiblock, continuous casting: slabs; press: ingot → plate. In the Tool slot: unbreakable, never consumed.
item.pioneers.rod_die.desc: Casting machine: 2 rods per ingot of molten metal; in the multiblock, continuous casting: billets; power hammer: rivets and nails. In the Tool slot: unbreakable, never consumed.
item.pioneers.gear_die.desc: Casting machine: 1 gear blank per 4.5 ingots of molten metal. In the Tool slot: unbreakable, never consumed.
block.pioneers.forge_hearth.desc: Charcoal embers: heats one piece at a time to its forging temperature without melting it, and the steel bloom for quenching. Right-click with coal or ingots, empty hand to take the piece; Shift + right-click with an empty hand: the interface (how many ingots and how much coal it keeps). Light it with flint and steel or a fire starter; bellows fan the fire.
block.pioneers.iron_anvil.desc: The first anvil, cast in the anvil mold (10 iron ingots): forges copper, gold, tin, lead, zinc, solder, bronze, brass, iron and steel. Place a hot piece, then right-click with a hammer.
message.pioneers.forge_hearth.no_fuel: The hearth needs coal before it can be lit
message.pioneers.forge_hearth.busy: A piece is already heating in the embers
message.pioneers.anvil.empty: Place a hot piece on the anvil first
message.pioneers.anvil.too_soft: You need at least a %s to forge %s
message.pioneers.anvil.occupied: The anvil is busy (only a hot ingot of the same metal can be welded on)
message.pioneers.anvil.weld_cold: Both pieces must be at forging temperature to weld
message.pioneers.anvil.weld_full: No more than 8 ingots on one piece
message.pioneers.anvil.done: Forged: %s (%s hits; hand-forged in %s at most)
message.pioneers.quench_basin.empty: The basin is out of water: fill it with a bucket
gui.pioneers.smithing.title: Smithing
gui.pioneers.smithing.no_recipe: No shape for this metal on this anvil
gui.pioneers.smithing.status.choose: Pick a shape on the left
gui.pioneers.smithing.status.cold: Too cold (%s °C minimum): put the piece back in the hearth
gui.pioneers.smithing.status.weld: Not enough material: weld %s more hot ingot(s) on
gui.pioneers.smithing.status.short: Not enough material there: move pixels over
gui.pioneers.smithing.status.help: Click: strike · Shift + click: draw · right-click: cut · wheel: direction
item.pioneers.fire_starter.desc: Hold right-click for 2 s on a campfire, charcoal pit, hearth or block to light it.
item.pioneers.crucible_tongs.desc: Right-click a clay crucible to pick it up, a placed mold to pour, a campfire to set it back. In the off hand: protects from hot metal.
block.pioneers.clay_crucible.desc: On a lit campfire: 1,100 °C, 2 ingots. Right-click with ore or ingots; charcoal at its foot +100 °C; bellows up to +500 °C.
block.pioneers.hand_bellows.desc: Place it against a campfire; each right-click blows +40 °C into the crucible (the air fades in a few seconds).
casting.pioneers.crucible.empty: empty: right-click with ore or ingots
casting.pioneers.crucible.cannot: The clay crucible cannot melt this metal: %s.
casting.pioneers.heat.charcoal: charcoal at the foot of the crucible
casting.pioneers.tongs.full: The tongs already hold a crucible.
casting.pioneers.tongs.cold: The metal has set (%s °C, needs %s °C): put the crucible back on the fire.
casting.pioneers.tongs.cracked: The crucible cracked: it has done its %s melts.
casting.pioneers.mold.cooling: The metal is cooling: %s s left.
advancements.pioneers.bronze.fire_lit.de: Light a fire with a fire starter.
Fire a clay mold in the pottery kiln.
Melt iron with bellows and cast your first iron ingot.
advancements.pioneers.bronze.forged.desc: Forge your first part at the anvil.
advancements.pioneers.bronze.forged_clea: Forge a part by hand without a single scrap.
advancements.pioneers.bronze.quench.desc: Quench a hot part in water.
message.pioneers.quench_basin.busy: A piece is already quenching: take it with an empty hand
message.pioneers.quench_basin.start: Quenching… piece ready in %s s (empty hand to take it)
message.pioneers.quench_basin.cold: Piece already cold: it comes out without quenching
message.pioneers.quench_basin.idle: %s · basin free: right-click with a hot piece
item.pioneers.clay_bucket.desc: Carries cold liquids (water…) like a bucket, never lava or a hot liquid. Fired in the pottery kiln.
item.pioneers.unfired_clay_bucket.desc: Fire it in the pottery kiln.
message.pioneers.clay_bucket.too_hot: Too hot for a clay bucket
farm.pioneers.seed.paddy: Paddy: water must touch the farmland
farm.pioneers.place.hostile: Hostile climate: %s will wither here. A greenhouse (a closed room of greenhouse blocks, with a regulator) protects it.
farm.pioneers.place.tolerable: Harsh climate for %s: it will grow slowly.
farm.pioneers.place.paddy: %s needs water next to its farmland (paddy).
farm.pioneers.vanilla_seed: Not a seed anymore: plant the mod’s seeds (grass, harvests).
description.pioneers.cutting_board: Right-click: its screen. A food, a knife in its slot, then “Cut” (or Shift + right-click with an empty hand): slices, fillets, mince.
description.pioneers.kitchen_stove: Burns fuel and heats the station placed on top (pot, pan, kettle, still).
description.pioneers.cooking_pot: On a heat source. Right-click: its screen: the ingredients and liquid of a recipe (Empty slot); the dish is served in the Serve slot with the requested container.
description.pioneers.frying_pan: On a heat source: four foods grill each at their own pace.
description.pioneers.bread_oven: Fuel-fired brick oven: breads, pies, cakes, roasts.
description.pioneers.mixing_bowl: Right-click: its screen. The ingredients (and milk or water through the Empty slot), then “Whisk” (or Shift + right-click with an empty hand): doughs, batters, salads.
description.pioneers.drying_rack: Right-click: its screen, four spots in the open air. Set over a campfire, it dries twice as fast (meat and fish to smoke afterwards in the smokehouse).
description.pioneers.preserves_jar: Fill with a preserving recipe: the jar seals and works on its own (jams, pickles, caviar).
description.pioneers.fermenting_vat: Large 2 × 2 vat. Must + yeast: fermentation turns the liquid into beer, wine, cider, mead or wash to distil.
description.pioneers.aging_barrel: Cask lying on its rack (1 × 2). Wine and spirits slowly age inside; right-click: its screen (pour in through the Empty slot, draw bottles through the Fill slot). Casks line up and stack: build a cellar.
description.pioneers.brew_kettle: Kettle with its hood (1 × 2). On a heat source: mashing the malt, hopping the wort.
description.pioneers.copper_still: Swan-neck still with its worm tub (2 × 2). On a heat source: distils wine, washes and fermented musts into spirits.
description.pioneers.fruit_press: Right-click: its screen. Fruit, then “Turn the screw” (or Shift + right-click with an empty hand): juice and must in the tank, drawn into bottles or buckets through the Fill slot.
description.pioneers.cheese_press: Right-click: its screen. Four curds, then “Tighten the press” (or Shift + right-click with an empty hand): a fresh cheese wheel, to ripen in a cellar.
description.pioneers.can_sealer: Right-click: its screen. A tin can and a dish, then “Seal” three times (or Shift + right-click with an empty hand): a can that keeps all the effects of the dish.
farm.pioneers.food.place: Place it and eat it in %s slices
farm.pioneers.food.can_empty: Empty can: fill it at the can sealer
farm.pioneers.cheese.cellar: Out of the light: the wheel is ripening
farm.pioneers.cheese.too_bright: Too bright: put it in a cellar
farm.pioneers.station.no_heat: No heat: place it on a stove or a fire
farm.pioneers.station.no_air: The rain is soaking the rack
farm.pioneers.station.incomplete: Some ingredients are missing (or there are too many)
farm.pioneers.station.incomplete_mix: This mix makes nothing: add or remove (Shift + click) ingredients
farm.pioneers.station.tank_full: The press tank is full: empty it
farm.pioneers.station.sealer_needs: Put a tin can and a dish
description.pioneers.butter_churn: Right-click: its screen. Milk through the Empty slot (bucket), then “Churn” (or Shift + right-click with an empty hand): cream, then butter from two creams.
description.pioneers.feeder: Fill with grain, hay, vegetables or compound feed: domestic animals come here to eat.
description.pioneers.water_trough: Water buckets (Empty slot of its screen), pipes or rain: domestic animals come here to drink.
farm.pioneers.animal.starving: Wasting away: barely producing, feed and water it!
farm.pioneers.animal.same_sex: It takes a male and a female
farm.pioneers.animal.too_weak: Too hungry or thirsty to breed
farm.pioneers.fish.shock: An electric shock runs through you!
farm.pioneers.fishing.missed: Too late, the fish got away
farm.pioneers.fishing.escaped: The fish got off the hook
farm.pioneers.fishing.hold: Hold right-click to reel: keep the needle in the green
farm.pioneers.fishing.bait: Bait in the off hand (or a fishing creel holding some): faster bites, rarer catches
advancements.pioneers.farm.root.title: Farm and Kitchen
advancements.pioneers.farm.root.descript: Genetic seeds: keep the best ones.
advancements.pioneers.farm.fruit.title: Orchard
advancements.pioneers.farm.fruit.descrip: Pick a ripe fruit from a fruit tree.
advancements.pioneers.farm.kitchen.title: At the Stove
advancements.pioneers.farm.bread.title: Country Bread
advancements.pioneers.farm.bread.descrip: Flour, yeast, dough, oven: bake a loaf.
advancements.pioneers.farm.butter.title: Pat of Butter
advancements.pioneers.farm.cheese.title: Cellar Aged
advancements.pioneers.farm.cheese.descri: Press a wheel and let it ripen in the dark.
advancements.pioneers.farm.jam.title: Preserved
advancements.pioneers.farm.jam.descripti: Make a jam or a jar of pickles.
advancements.pioneers.farm.canned.title: Space Ration
advancements.pioneers.farm.canned.descri: Seal a dish in a can: same effects, stacks of 16.
advancements.pioneers.farm.beer.title: Brewer
advancements.pioneers.farm.beer.descript: Malt, wort, hops, yeast: draw a beer.
advancements.pioneers.farm.whisky.title: Single Malt
advancements.pioneers.farm.whisky.descri: Distil, then age in the barrel: a whisky.
advancements.pioneers.farm.feeder.title: Stockbreeder
advancements.pioneers.farm.feeder.descri: Feeder and trough: your domestic animals eat and drink on their own.
advancements.pioneers.farm.rod.title: Rod in Hand
advancements.pioneers.farm.fish.title: Nice Catch
advancements.pioneers.farm.fish.descript: Land a fish after a tension fight.
advancements.pioneers.farm.legendary.des: Catch a coelacanth, an oarfish or an arapaima.
advancements.pioneers.farm.roe.title: Fish Farmer
advancements.pioneers.farm.caviar.title: Black Pearls
jei.pioneers.info.farm.aged_cheese: Obtained: place a fresh cheese wheel in the dark (light 7 or less); it ripens in about twenty minutes.
jei.pioneers.info.farm.bottle: Obtained: right-click a station holding this liquid with an empty container (bottle or mug); press R on the liquid for its recipes.
jei.pioneers.info.farm.bucket: Obtained: right-click a station holding this liquid with an empty bucket; pour it back into a station the same way.
jei.pioneers.info.farm.canned: Obtained: sealer, with a tin can and a dish; the can keeps the dish, its nourishment and its effects.
jei.pioneers.info.farm.earthworm: Obtained: digging dirt, grass or mud (2.3% of the time). Fishing bait: in the off hand it attracts rare fish.
jei.pioneers.info.farm.fish_bucket: Obtained: right-click a fish with a water bucket; it keeps its species and size to stock a pond.
jei.pioneers.info.farm.leaves: Fruit tree foliage: it grows with the tree (sapling dropped by the vanilla leaves of its climate), blossoms then bears fruit; right-click to pick, shears to collect it.
jei.pioneers.info.farm.roe: Obtained: fish rarely lay eggs in a lightly stocked seagrass bed; a bottle or a bucket harvests the cluster. Right-click seagrass to replant it.
jei.pioneers.info.farm.sturgeon_roe: Obtained: roe cluster of a sturgeon, harvested with a bottle; the base of caviar.
description.pioneers.honey_extractor: Right-click: its screen (full frames, wax, combs, honey drawn into bottles or buckets through the Fill slot). “Turn the crank”, or Shift + right-click with an empty hand: one turn.
description.pioneers.bronze_sprinkler: Waters 9 × 9 blocks: moist soil and faster growth. Water: pipes, buckets, rain, or placed on a water hole (it pumps by itself).
description.pioneers.steel_sprinkler: Waters 15 × 15 blocks; with compost or fertilizer, it feeds the crops while watering.
description.pioneers.compost_bin: Replaces the Minecraft composter: anything compostable, with its usual chance, up to 7 layers; then it closes and ferments for 2 min: 4 compost. Hoppers: waste on top or the sides, compost below; comparator: fill level.
description.pioneers.scarecrow: Guards crops within 12 blocks: crows prowl at the edge of the zone without touching them; nobody tramples farmland within 8 blocks. Give it a pumpkin head.
description.pioneers.weather_station: Temperature, humidity, wind. Right-click: its screen, with the crops and trees that grow well here. Redstone under rain and thunder.
description.pioneers.apiary: A colony settles near flowers and crops, pollinates them and fills 4 honey frames. A campfire below calms the bees.
description.pioneers.nest_box: Hens within 12 blocks come to lay here: up to 12 eggs in the straw. Hopper below.
description.pioneers.incubator: Six fertile eggs kept warm: in 5 min, chicks of the egg’s breed.
description.pioneers.auto_feeder: Feed and water: fills the feeders and troughs within 8 blocks every 5 s.
farm.pioneers.device.sprinkler.pump: Pumps water from the hole below
farm.pioneers.device.apiary.stung: Ouch! A campfire under the apiary calms the bees
farm.pioneers.device.incubator.not_ferti: This egg is not fertile (keep a rooster near the hens)
farm.pioneers.device.scarecrow.head: Pumpkin or jack o’lantern: new head
advancements.pioneers.farm.compost.title: Nothing Is Lost
advancements.pioneers.farm.compost.descr: Fill a compost bin to the top.
advancements.pioneers.farm.scare.title: Shoo!
advancements.pioneers.farm.weather.title: Weather Report
advancements.pioneers.farm.honey.title: Beekeeper
advancements.pioneers.farm.nest.title: Fresh Eggs
advancements.pioneers.farm.nest.descript: Collect eggs from a nesting box.
advancements.pioneers.farm.hatch.title: Peep Peep
advancements.pioneers.farm.hatch.descrip: Hatch a chick in an incubator.
jei.pioneers.info.farm.compost: Obtained: compost bin filled with 7 layers of waste (Minecraft chances), after 2 min of fermentation (4 compost). Grows and feeds a crop; also works as bone meal.
jei.pioneers.info.farm.fertile_egg: Obtained: laid by a hen when an adult rooster is within 8 blocks; hatches in an incubator into a chick of its breed.
jei.pioneers.info.farm.honey_frame: Obtained: an empty frame in an inhabited apiary fills with honey (5 min at best, depending on the flowers around).
charcoal.pioneers.look.title: Lit Charcoal Pit
charcoal.pioneers.look.smothering: The vent is blocked: the pit is smothering
charcoal.pioneers.look.drain: A clay drain under the pit collects the creosote
charcoal.pioneers.look.rules: 3×3 to 7×7, 2 to 4 high, covered with dirt, a single vent at the bottom
charcoal.pioneers.look.light: Light the vent with a fire starter
look.pioneers.sieve.empty: Empty: right-click with gravel or sand
look.pioneers.hopper.hint: One item every ½ s, no storage
look.pioneers.crucible.pour: Pourable: pour it with the tongs
look.pioneers.anvil.empty: Put a hot piece on it
jei.pioneers.charcoal_pit.title: Logs covered in dirt + fire → charcoal
jei.pioneers.charcoal_pit.step1: ① Stack a solid block of logs: from 3 × 3 × 2 to 7 × 7 × 4.
jei.pioneers.charcoal_pit.step2: ② Cover everything with dirt (gravel, clay, stone…), top included.
jei.pioneers.charcoal_pit.step3: ③ Leave ONE single opening at the bottom: the vent. Light it with a fire starter.
jei.pioneers.charcoal_pit.step4: ④ A clay drain under the pit collects the creosote.
jei.pioneers.charcoal_pit.step5: 2 min + 6 s per log. A leak burns logs: patch it with a shovel. Yield 80 %, +5 % per layer above 2. Look at the pit to follow the burn.
farm.pioneers.food.place_dish: Shift + right-click on a table: serve the dish
item.pioneers.seashell.desc: Left by a hermit crab. In a mortar: bone meal.
farm.pioneers.crustacean.aquatic: Aquatic: lives on the bottom, suffocates out of water
farm.pioneers.crustacean.shore: Shore: beaches, between land and water
description.pioneers.fishing_net: Set in the water (at least 20 water blocks around): catches the local fish on its own. Right-click: collect. Hoppers and logistic cables take the catch.
description.pioneers.crab_pot: Set on the bottom of the water and baited (raw fish, worm, bait): catches the local crustaceans, one bait per catch. Right-click with a bait: bait it; empty hand: collect.
look.pioneers.trap.dry: Out of the water: place it in water

block.pioneers.mechanical_kneader.desc: Shaft from below: the bowl turns, the spiral kneads. The mixing bowl recipes (doughs, mixes) with six ingredients and a liquid.
block.pioneers.mechanical_press.desc: Fruit press and cheese press driven by the shaft: the screws bring the plate down. Juice gathers in the trough (bottle or bucket through the Fill slot, pipe), cheese wheels come out.

jei.pioneers.info.refonte.cell: Energy storage, by age: zinc-carbon cell and lead-acid battery (MKI), NiMH cell (MKII), lithium-ion cell, fuel cell stack and vanadium flow cell (MKIII), solid-state cell (MKIV). They go into energy buffers, battery cars, rovers, drones and substations: U shows which.
jei.pioneers.info.refonte.fastener: Tier fasteners: screws and bolts now only exist in steel (MKI), aluminum (MKII), titanium (MKIII) and tungsten (MKIV); those of other metals have become steel, aluminum or titanium. Before steel, you rivet with copper.
jei.pioneers.info.refonte.frame: Tier frame and machine hull: the frame, the tier circuit and 2 plates and 2 rods of the secondary metal (brass, electrum, chrome, osmiridium) make the machine hull; every machine and multiblock controller of the tier needs one, then 2 to 4 parts of its trade (motor and bearings for a lathe, heating elements and refractories for a furnace…). Guide: “Mechanics: Components”.
description.pioneers.dish_shelf: Goes on the floor: 4 legs, a bottom board and a top board, 4 dishes, drinks or ingredients on each board. Stacks (a single board at each joint, the top board stays at the top); side by side, aligned shelves (same facing, same height) join up. Right-click with a dish: it goes to the spot you aim at; empty hand: take it back.

pioneer.pioneers.cover.title: Field Notebook of the Restorers — Stewardship Year 341
pioneer.pioneers.cover.step.name: Your name
pioneer.pioneers.cover.name: Name
pioneer.pioneers.cover.name_hint: Write the name your notebook will carry. Others will read it above your head and in the registers. Twenty-four letters at most.
pioneer.pioneers.cover.1: This notebook is yours. It remembers what you do, not what you promise.
pioneer.pioneers.cover.2: The pioneers were told: Serve, Preserve, Lighten. They were lightened so thoroughly that they stopped reading what they were asked to approve.
pioneer.pioneers.cover.3: One evening in year 138, someone said "hmm," as they had for twenty years, and the machines went quiet, one by one.
pioneer.pioneers.cover.4: We, the Restorers, decided to read again. The Trades had a rule: you learn a machine only after you have done the gesture. It still holds. What you do with your hands counts in full; what the machines do will teach you far less.
pioneer.pioneers.cover.5: Choose a Trade. It will lean you toward some gestures and leave you clumsy at others; the Jack-of-All-Trades leans toward none. A notebook is not rewritten: choose with care.
