Restore a MKII ruin. A Stewardship work runs for the village.
Restore a MKIII ruin. The greatest of awakenings.
sentinel.pioneers.say.wake: Unauthorized access. Please state your clearance.
sentinel.pioneers.say.return: Post resumed. No valid order received.
sentinel.pioneers.say.repair: Maintenance in progress. Please do not disturb.
sentinel.pioneers.say.foreman: I remind you that this site is under guard.
sentinel.pioneers.say.alarm: Perimeter alert. All posts on duty.
sentinel.pioneers.say.phase3: Overheating tolerated. The site comes first.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.smalltalk.0: (he looks up from his book) Hmm. Good weather for reading outside.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.smalltalk.1: The rain got my pages wet. They're drying on the line, with the laundry.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.smalltalk.2: The nights are getting longer. We'll read more.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.smalltalk.3: (he wipes his glasses) Wind's from the west. Hmm. Or the north. I'll check.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.smalltalk.4: Good year for apples. Bad for ink: the walnuts froze.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.smalltalk.5: The smith redid my knife. It cuts better than the old one. I asked him how. He showed me.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.smalltalk.6: (she holds a candle) Night falls early. We need wax, always more wax.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.smalltalk.7: Hmm. The wheat is coming up. I counted it. Well, a row of it.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.smalltalk.8: The frost cracked the jug. We'll make another, by hand.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.smalltalk.9: Read well. It's going to snow, I think.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.smalltalk.10: (he looks at his clay-covered hands) The oven will be hot tonight. Come back for bread.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.smalltalk.11: The bees are nervous. Storm. Or a fox. Hmm.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.smalltalk.12: I fixed the door hinge. It doesn't squeak anymore. I miss it a little.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.smalltalk.13: Nice sky tonight. You can see all the stars. Well, the ones we've named.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.smalltalk.14: The harvest is in. Now to write it all down. That's my favorite part.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.smalltalk.15: (he turns a page) Hmm. The sun comes up late this time of year.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.warm.0: My mother read aloud while kneading. The bread tasted better, I think.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.warm.1: My grandfather taught me to cut a quill. I still ruin it every time.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.warm.2: (he smiles) My daughter learned to read this winter. She reads everything. Labels, walls, my letters.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.warm.3: We have an old book at home. Nobody knows where it came from. We keep it dry.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.warm.4: My father used to say hands remember. He forgot his keys, never his gestures.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.warm.5: My sister left to reread the ruins in the south. She writes often. Long, long letters.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.warm.6: Hmm. My first manual, I read upside down. Nobody had told me.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.warm.7: My grandmother counted on her fingers. She was right more often than I am.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.warm.8: (he shows a stained pen) My father's. It sputters. I keep it.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.warm.9: In the evening at home, we read recipes to each other. We know them by heart, but we read them anyway.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.places.0: There are old walls over there. Pages keep better there than at home. Hmm.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.places.1: Behind the hill, a tower that doesn't quite sleep. We greet it from a distance.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.places.2: (he points at the horizon with his pen) That way, a brick house. Nobody lives there. Someone used to write there.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.places.3: The rails under the grass lead somewhere. I've never followed them all the way.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.places.4: My mother spoke of a room where the light stays on. She never went there.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.cold.2: It's cold. You should go in. To your place.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.cold.6: The sun's setting. Like every evening.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.contempt.0: You read as badly as you greet. Good day.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.contempt.1: (he closes his book) No. Not today.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.contempt.2: We saw you in the ruins. You weren't reading anything there.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.contempt.3: The walls you break, others could have raised. Go.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.contempt.4: I have work to do. So do you, surely. Elsewhere.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.contempt.6: Your word isn't worth a blank page.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.contempt.7: The door's that way. It says so on it.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.contempt.8: Come back when you've read something. Anything.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.insult.2: You break what you can't read. Stay away from me.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.insult.3: (he backs away) Ignorant. Dangerous and ignorant.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.insult.4: Even a Servitor would have more sense than you.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.insult.5: Ruin rat! I'm not talking to you!
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.insult.6: You have hands and you use them for that? Shame on you.
dialogue.pioneers.restorers.insult.8: (he clutches his book) Not a step closer, vandal.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.smalltalk.0: (a nod, he looks at the sky) Hmm. Rain's coming.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.smalltalk.1: Rain is good for the wheat. Less so for the boots.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.smalltalk.2: (he rubs his axe handle) Ash splits well when it freezes.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.smalltalk.3: The ewes came home on their own. They smell the storm before we do.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.smalltalk.4: Hmm. The soil's heavy this year. It'll need turning again.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.smalltalk.5: The wolf prowled last night. The dogs did their work.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.smalltalk.6: (he shows his palms) Blisters. Good day, then.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.smalltalk.7: The oak down the way lost a branch. It has others. So do we.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.smalltalk.8: Hmm. The river's high. The trout too, I bet.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.smalltalk.9: We sheared yesterday. The wool's fine, greasy as it should be.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.smalltalk.1: (he spits in his hands) The stone's good. The handle, less so. I'll make a new handle.
Nights are getting cool. The wood has to come in before the rains.
The honey's dark this season. It's the heather.
(he listens) Not an engine to be heard. Good day.
The cows gave well. Milk turns fast in the heat. Eat it as cheese.
Hmm. The wind smells of snow. The animals know already.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.warm.0: My father built that barn without a nail. It stands better than I do.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.warm.1: My mother sang to the cows. They gave more. I sing off-key; they give anyway.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.warm.2: (he strokes his axe handle) My grandfather carved this. I changed the stone. It's still his.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.warm.3: My son delivered his first lamb last night. He cried. So did the lamb.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.warm.4: My grandmother knew the name of every tree in the wood. I know half. My children will learn the rest.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.warm.5: Hmm. In summer, when I was small, we slept outside. The sky was ours.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.warm.6: My wife weaves the baskets. They last longer than promises.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.warm.7: My uncle fished by hand. He said trout like to be greeted.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.warm.8: (he laughs) The first goat I milked bit me. We stayed friends.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.warm.9: At home, bread is baked on windy days. The oven draws better. My mother knew it, and I know it.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.places.0: There are old walls over there. We don't go there at night.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.places.1: Past the woods, something still hums. The animals go around. Do the same.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.places.2: (he spits toward the east) Over there, stones that aren't stones. My father burned some.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.places.3: Hmm. The old road stops at a door. We don't knock.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.places.4: There's a place where the grass doesn't grow straight. Leave it be.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.cold.4: The animals are hungry. So am I.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.contempt.0: Your machines stink of oil. Go away.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.contempt.1: Your hands are clean. That's exactly what bothers me.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.contempt.2: (he turns his back) The animals are afraid of you. Me, I don't want to talk to you.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.contempt.3: Nothing to trade. Nothing to say. The road is behind you.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.contempt.4: You smell of ruins. Wash, or leave.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.contempt.5: (he plants his pitchfork in the ground) No.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.contempt.6: What you carry, others made. Keep it away from my field.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.contempt.7: We owe you nothing. You owe us nothing. Let's leave it there.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.contempt.8: Your tools don't know your name. Mine do. Go.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.insult.0: Looter. Go chew your cud somewhere else.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.insult.1: Grease-monkey! I can smell the machine from here!
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.insult.3: Iron-hand! The animals spit where you pass!
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.insult.4: You've never planted anything. It shows. It smells.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.insult.7: Even the crows wouldn't have you.
dialogue.pioneers.bare_hands.insult.8: Leech! You take and take, and you grow nothing!
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.smalltalk.0: Rain: bad for the roads, good for boots. I sell boots.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.smalltalk.1: (he counts nails on his palm) …and that makes the count. Nice day, eh?
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.smalltalk.2: The ford is high. We'll cross tomorrow. Or the day after. The llamas will decide.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.smalltalk.3: Hmm. The wind's turning. Prices do too, sometimes. Not mine.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.smalltalk.4: Good harvest around here. You can tell by the hens: they're fat.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.smalltalk.5: At night I count the stars. None ever missing. It's restful.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.smalltalk.6: (he pats a crate) This one has been around the valley more often than I have.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.smalltalk.7: The cold's coming. Blankets will go up. Well, I'm just saying.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.smalltalk.8: The road was dry for once. I gained a day. I'll sell it to you, if you like.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.smalltalk.9: Hmm. The llamas are chewing crooked. Storm, or bad grass.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.smalltalk.10: Fine moon. You walk better at night when you know the Way.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.smalltalk.11: (he weighs your pack with his eyes) Heavy. Good sign.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.smalltalk.12: Last winter, salt was worth gold. This winter, we'll see.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.smalltalk.13: The old Ways run straight. The new ones go around the hills. Cheaper, longer.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.smalltalk.14: The bread's good here. I'm writing it down. I write everything down.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.smalltalk.15: It rains, it blows, I count. Doesn't change much.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.warm.0: My father crossed the valley with a single goat. He came back with a herd. He never said how.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.warm.1: My mother counted while singing. Nobody cheated her: everyone was listening to the song.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.warm.2: (he pulls out a polished pebble) My first trade. A pebble for a pebble. His was better.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.warm.3: My grandfather knew every Way by its smell. I know them by their prices.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.warm.4: Hmm. My sister runs the Waystop at the ford. If you pass by, tell her I count well. She'll laugh.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.warm.5: Llamas run in the family. That one spits like my aunt.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.warm.6: We got married on the road. The witness was a Peddler we never saw again. He still owes us a Shining.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.warm.7: My son wants to settle in a village. I let him. He still counts, I've seen him.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.warm.8: (he shows a worn notebook) My mother's accounts. I reread them sometimes. She gave credit, on the quiet.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.warm.9: When I was little, I slept in the crates. I still know which ones are comfortable.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.places.0: Over there, walls full of iron. Good for the books, bad for your health.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.places.1: (he taps his notebook) That way, a Way that ends in a big hall. I wrote it down. I didn't go in.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.places.2: There's a brick house by the Way. The shutters are closed. Shutters are worth something.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.places.3: Hmm. Behind the hills, an iron watcher counts passersby. We don't like being counted.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.places.4: An old tower, that way. My aunt said it asked questions. My aunt said a lot of things.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.cold.2: (he counts without looking at you) …and another, and another…
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.cold.3: It's going to rain. Doesn't change the prices.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.contempt.0: The books are closed. For you, anyway.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.contempt.1: (he puts his crates away) Nothing to sell. Nothing to buy. Nothing.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.contempt.2: Your reputation precedes you. It doesn't pay either.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.contempt.3: I count everything. You, I'd rather not count.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.contempt.4: You're a bad deal. I can smell them from far off.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.contempt.5: Hmm. The counter is closed. It just closed. There.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.contempt.6: You owe somebody, somewhere. Not me. It'll stay that way.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.contempt.7: Go find another Waystop. They're far away; that's the point.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.contempt.8: Even for free I wouldn't want it. And I never say that.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.insult.0: Swindler! And that's me saying it!
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.insult.1: Bad payer! Bad walker! Bad everything!
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.insult.2: (he grabs his llama's lead) Come on, we're off. That kind brings bad luck.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.insult.3: You're not worth the price of your rope.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.insult.4: Counter thief! I've got you written down!
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.insult.5: Even the llamas spit on you, and they're usually polite.
dialogue.pioneers.peddlers.insult.7: I wouldn't sell you a pebble's shadow.
dialogue.pioneers.events.shortage.0: We're short of this: %s. If you have some, we pay well. Hmm.
dialogue.pioneers.events.shortage.1: (he points at the Board) Did you read it? %s. We're looking for some.
dialogue.pioneers.events.shortage.2: Without this, it'll be a long week: %s.
dialogue.pioneers.events.shortage.3: My mother said we never ran short. Today we're short of this: %s.
dialogue.pioneers.events.shortage.4: %s: we need some. We'll pay double.
dialogue.pioneers.events.surplus.0: Too much of it this week: %s. Take some, it's cheap.
dialogue.pioneers.events.surplus.1: (he sighs) %s, everywhere. We don't know where to put it.
dialogue.pioneers.events.surplus.2: We harvested more than we can eat. %s at a good price, while it lasts.
dialogue.pioneers.events.surplus.3: Hmm. The loft is overflowing. %s, nearly half price.
dialogue.pioneers.events.surplus.4: If %s is what you're after, now's the time.
dialogue.pioneers.events.caravan.0: The Peddlers are here. Hide what you don't want to sell.
dialogue.pioneers.events.caravan.1: (he looks at the tents) The caravan. There'll be a lot of counting these days.
dialogue.pioneers.events.caravan.2: They have things from far away. Things we don't make here. Hmm.
dialogue.pioneers.events.caravan.3: The llamas are on the square. Watch your hat.
dialogue.pioneers.events.caravan.4: The Peddlers leave soon. They always leave.
dialogue.pioneers.board.shortage.2: %s. We need some. See the baker, or anybody.
dialogue.pioneers.board.surplus.0: Too much %s this week. Good price.
dialogue.pioneers.board.surplus.1: %s for sale. Lots. Too much. Come.
dialogue.pioneers.board.surplus.2: Surplus of %s. Low price this weak.
dialogue.pioneers.board.caravan.0: The Peddlers are here three days.
dialogue.pioneers.board.caravan.1: Caravan on the square. They counts everything.
dialogue.pioneers.board.caravan.2: The llama traders are here. Bring in the laundry.
dialogue.pioneers.vocation.builder.0: (the Mason looks at your hands) Builder's hands. You set things straight. It shows in your nails.
dialogue.pioneers.vocation.miner_smelter: (the Armorer looks at your hands) A burn there, and there. You smelt your own. Hmm. Good.
dialogue.pioneers.vocation.engineer.0: You look at my bellows like it's going to answer you. It doesn't answer. It blows.
dialogue.pioneers.vocation.logistician.0: You count the passing carts. Are you a Peddler, or worse?
dialogue.pioneers.vocation.farmer.0: (the Farmer takes a handful of your soil) You've got dirt under your nails. We'll get along.
dialogue.pioneers.vocation.herder_angler: (the Fisherman eyes your rod) A well-kept rod. You know how to wait.
dialogue.pioneers.vocation.scout.0: You walk without a sound. My dogs didn't hear you. They're offended.
dialogue.pioneers.vocation.salvager.0: You smell of rust and old-wall dust. The Librarian will like you. My wife, less so.
dialogue.pioneers.vocation.astronaut.0: (the Cartographer follows your eyes skyward) You look up there too. There's nothing to map up there. Hmm. Is there?
dialogue.pioneers.vocation.trader.0: (the Librarian recognizes your Field Notebook) A Field Notebook, with columns of figures in it. A Restorer who counts. That's rare.
dialogue.pioneers.services.water.0: (he drinks from the fountain) The water's back. It tastes of stone. That's a good taste.
dialogue.pioneers.services.water.1: The children have been playing at the fountain since dawn. Nobody goes to the well anymore. The well is sulking.
dialogue.pioneers.services.energy.0: The lamps on the square light up on their own at night. We go out just to see them.
dialogue.pioneers.services.energy.1: Hmm. Nothing prowls since the square got its light. The dogs are bored.
dialogue.pioneers.services.workshop.0: The smith has new tools. He won't say where from. He smiles all the time.
dialogue.pioneers.services.workshop.1: Repairs are better these days. Something hums over there, and the iron is better.
dialogue.pioneers.services.storage.0: The loft doesn't overflow anymore. Everything has a place now. Even what we can't name.
dialogue.pioneers.services.storage.1: We buy more, we sell more. Crates come and go. My mother would have loved counting that.
dialogue.pioneers.services.archives.0: The Librarian has new manuals. He holds them like eggs.
dialogue.pioneers.services.archives.1: (he holds a fresh map) The Cartographer draws accurately now. With distances. Strange.
dialogue.pioneers.confidence.ruin.0: Go look %s. Old walls, and pages at the back. Don't say it was me.
dialogue.pioneers.confidence.ruin.1: My mother showed me once, %s: an iron door, papers inside. I never went back.
dialogue.pioneers.confidence.ruin.2: (he lowers his voice) There's a ruin %s. It keeps its books. You'll know what to do with them.
dialogue.pioneers.confidence.code.0: The old walls have a door that listens. My grandfather used to tell it %s. It went quiet.
dialogue.pioneers.confidence.code.1: Remember this: %s. I don't know what it is. My mother sang it to put me to sleep.
dialogue.pioneers.confidence.code.2: (he scratches numbers in the dust) %s. They say it puts the iron watchers to sleep. Wipe it out after.
dialogue.pioneers.confidence.cache.0: I buried some twisted iron %s, under a flat stone. It's no use to me. Maybe to you.
dialogue.pioneers.confidence.cache.1: My father hid his finds %s. Bits of machines. He never dared sell them.
dialogue.pioneers.confidence.cache.2: (he looks around) A crate, %s. Full of scrap from the old walls. Take it before the Peddlers do.
dialogue.pioneers.confidence.seeds.0: My father buried seeds %s, under a flat stone. They're waiting for someone patient.
dialogue.pioneers.confidence.seeds.1: There's a pot of seeds %s, at the foot of an old tree. The best ones. Don't sell them.
dialogue.pioneers.confidence.seeds.2: (he takes your wrist) Listen. My grandmother's seeds, %s. Plant them by hand. Only by hand.
dialogue.pioneers.workers.hire.0: I'll come. But I go home at night; I've got animals.
dialogue.pioneers.workers.hire.1: A worksite? Hmm. Show me the walls.
dialogue.pioneers.workers.hire.2: All right. I lay the stones, you read. Is that how it works?
dialogue.pioneers.workers.hire.3: (he gathers his tools) My price, plus soup. Let's go.
dialogue.pioneers.workers.refuse_bare_ha: Raise those walls? I'd rather burn them. No.
(he steps back) Those walls, we let them fall. That's all.
Ask the rain. It's already working on it.
dialogue.pioneers.workers.leave.0: I'm going home. The site will wait. It's used to it.
dialogue.pioneers.workers.leave.1: No more Shining, no more hands. No hard feelings.
dialogue.pioneers.workers.leave.2: (he wipes his hands) Right. I've done my share. The rest is yours.
dialogue.pioneers.workers.leave.3: Hmm. They're waiting for me in the village. The walls aren't.
dialogue.pioneers.niais.0: I remember a word. Hmm. No. Another one.
dialogue.pioneers.niais.1: There was a word for saying yes without knowing. I had it. I put it down somewhere.
dialogue.pioneers.niais.2: (he points at the horizon) A ruin, that way. Or a cloud. Same thing, from far off.
dialogue.pioneers.niais.3: Hmm. Hmm. You hear that? Me neither.
dialogue.pioneers.niais.4: My grandfather said a word every evening at the same hour. Then he slept. I say the word. I don't sleep.
dialogue.pioneers.niais.5: The old walls over there talk when it rains. They say… no. It's gone.
dialogue.pioneers.niais.6: I counted really far yesterday. After that, there were no more words.
dialogue.pioneers.niais.7: (he looks at you for a long time) You read? Read me the sky. No? Nobody knows how.
dialogue.pioneers.niais.8: There's a brick house that way, with a chair in it. I sat down. It recognized me, I think.
dialogue.pioneers.niais.9: The word starts like “as-”… Asparagus? No. Hmm.
dialogue.pioneers.niais.10: I keep a pebble in each pocket. If I forget which is which, I'm not lost.
dialogue.pioneers.niais.11: Never say hmm to a door. I don't remember why. But don't say it.
dialogue.pioneers.niais.12: A ruin, that way, with pages that fly up when you open it. I closed it. They were scared.
dicton.pioneers.bare_hands.0: The earth remembers better than we do.
dicton.pioneers.bare_hands.1: What grows asks no one's leave.
dicton.pioneers.bare_hands.2: Once, we stopped getting our hands dirty.
dicton.pioneers.peddlers.1: Whatever shines has a ledger somewhere.
dicton.pioneers.peddlers.3: We've always walked; it's the road that changed.
dicton.pioneers.peddlers.4: Giving back is harder than taking.
dicton.pioneers.restorers.2: The gesture comes before the word.
dicton.pioneers.restorers.4: Fire keeps what the mouth forgets.

peddler.pioneers.voice.greet.1: Safe road. Shall we count together?
peddler.pioneers.voice.greet.2: (he lifts his hat) Safe road, traveler.
peddler.pioneers.voice.greet.4: Safe road. The llamas spotted you from far off.
peddler.pioneers.voice.open.1: Look, touch, count. It sells, it trades.
peddler.pioneers.voice.open.2: Everything has a price. Even what doesn't.
peddler.pioneers.voice.open.3: (he opens a crate) The books are open.
peddler.pioneers.voice.broke.1: Not enough. I counted twice; it doesn't change anything.
peddler.pioneers.voice.broke.2: Come back with Shining. I'll keep it warm for you.
peddler.pioneers.voice.broke.3: Hmm. You're a bit short. The bit is the whole thing.
peddler.pioneers.voice.quota.0: I have all I need for today.
peddler.pioneers.voice.quota.2: The llamas are full. Come back in the morning.
peddler.pioneers.voice.quota.3: I've counted enough of those for one day.
peddler.pioneers.voice.refuse.0: Not with you. The books are closed.
peddler.pioneers.voice.refuse.1: We don't trade with people who cost too much. You cost too much.
peddler.pioneers.voice.refuse.2: (he covers his crates) The road is long. Take it.
peddler.pioneers.voice.refuse.3: Your reputation got here before you. It didn't buy anything.

clan.pioneers.regime.democracy.hook: Everyone reads. Everyone says yes. It takes time.
clan.pioneers.regime.democracy.text: The Representative is elected by all, for a short term, and runs again if they dare. Decisions go to a majority vote, after reading. Advantage: nobody wakes up governed by a surprise. Risk: a vote nobody reads looks a lot like a hmm, only with more people.
clan.pioneers.regime.empire.hook: One person says yes. It's fast.
clan.pioneers.regime.empire.text: The Representative is appointed for life and chooses an heir. They alone decide taxes, roles, and war. Advantage: nothing waits, neither worksites nor sieges. Risk: the world has already tried letting one person say yes for everyone. A large majority of members may, from time to time, remember that.
clan.pioneers.regime.council.hook: A few read for the rest. Let's hope they read.
clan.pioneers.regime.council.text: Members elect a Council of a few seats; the Council decides and chooses the Representative. Advantage: balance, careful finances, quarrels kept to a small room. Risk: entrusting the yes to a few is still entrusting it.
clan.pioneers.regime.cooperative.text: No leader: a spokesperson who changes often. Decisions take two thirds, and the tax comes back to everyone in equal shares. Advantage: a little more land to hold, no face to topple. Risk: when you need two thirds to agree, mostly you learn to wait.
clan.pioneers.role.representative.desc: Holds the clan, as the regime allows. Signs first, answers last.
clan.pioneers.role.lieutenant.desc: Nearly all of the Representative’s rights: members, territory, treasury, lower roles. Neither the regime nor the title.
clan.pioneers.role.steward.desc: The budget: sees the treasury, withdraws, pays bonuses, sets dues and taxes, buys claims.
clan.pioneers.role.guard.desc: Watches over the territory, defense, and war. Doesn't sleep through the siege window.
clan.pioneers.role.artisan.desc: Builds and runs the shared machines. Does it by hand first, if asked nicely.
clan.pioneers.role.member.desc: Regular access to the territory. One voice, one page, one fire.

jei.pioneers.info.rp.scrap.get: Obtained: only in ruins (derelict blocks, Archive Cabinets, annex chests) and from Sentinels; no recipe makes it. A crusher also gives back the scrap of a derelict block taken with Silk Touch.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.scrap.use.mk1: Use: a Compact or Industrial Recycler of MKI or higher turns it into MKI components drawn at random (U shows the draws and their chances); dismantling at the Metalworker's Bench, with a hammer: 2 steel nuggets.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.scrap.use.mk2: Use: a Compact or Industrial Recycler of MKII or higher turns it into MKII components drawn at random (U shows the draws and their chances); no dismantling at a bench: its aluminum only comes out of a recycler of its tier.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.scrap.use.mk3: Use: a Compact or Industrial Recycler of MKIII or higher turns it into MKIII components drawn at random (U shows the draws and their chances); no dismantling at a bench: its titanium only comes out of a recycler of its tier.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.scrap.sell: Selling: to traveling Peddlers and to Peddler villages; other villages refuse.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.scrap.sell.mk3: Selling: to traveling Peddlers only, one of each kind per day and per Peddler. The Desk asks for 16 (of at least 4 kinds) for a vocation change when the economy is off.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.derelict.wake: Only found in ruins, with no function at all. Breaking it wakes the Sentinels within 12 blocks (except on Standby) and breaks into the ruin: it can no longer be restored.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.derelict.structure: Broken: 1 to 2 structural scrap (Fortune counts); with Silk Touch, the block itself, which a crusher turns into 1 scrap.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.derelict.trade: Broken: 2 to 3 scrap of its category (Fortune counts); with Silk Touch, the block itself, which a crusher turns into 2 scrap.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.rubble: Rubble: a 30%% chance of a structural scrap. It is cleared during the clearing stage of a restoration site and does not break into the ruin.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.controller: Right-click: the restoration site sheet (survey, clearing, repair, commissioning). Restoration level required: 0, 3 or 6 (MKI, MKII, MKIII). During a site, the ruin cannot be broken.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.console: Right-click: the keypad. The code (4 digits) is on the Service Note in one of the ruin's Archive Cabinets, or in a villager's Confidences. Right code: Standby for one day; three wrong codes: alarm and the console locks for 5 minutes.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.cabinet: Opens like a chest: archive pages (1 to 4 depending on the tier), parchment notes, the ruin's scrap and, in one of the cabinets, the Service Note. Broken: 1 to 2 structural scrap; with Silk Touch, the cabinet.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.plaque: Obtained: set when a restored ruin is commissioned; it cannot be crafted. Right-click: the engraved names.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.note: Obtained: chests of ruins and annexes, Archive Cabinets (forty notes, drawn favoring those you have not read). Right-click: reading; the note joins the Codex's “Scattered Notes”. It is not consumed and is not used in any recipe.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.page: Obtained: only in the Archive Cabinets of ruins. Right-click: reading, filed in the notebook's Codex; a first reading is worth +1 reputation with the Restorers (five a day). The Service Note holds the code of its ruin's Console. It is not consumed.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.memory: Obtained: from Sentinels (Guardian and Repairer, 8%%; Foreman, always). Right-click: a Servitor's recording, filed in the Codex. It is not consumed.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.notebook: Given at the end of the initiation. The profile (skills, Codex, Shining, reputation) lives in the world, not in the item: if lost, make it again here without losing anything. Villagers like being shown it.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.blank_notebook: Use: the Restorer's Desk is made with one, and each vocation change uses one up.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.desk: Right-click: the vocation cards and the cost of a change (Blank Notebook and 5,000 Shining; economy off: 16 MKIII scrap and 4 components), then a 10 s ceremony. 30 game days between two changes; −25%% XP on the two skills of the old vocation (nothing when leaving the Jack-of-All-Trades).
jei.pioneers.info.rp.stall: Use: placed in the world; it is not used in any recipe. A lot's price stays between 25%% and 400%% of its value, the tax vanishes, and your sales are credited to you even while offline.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.board: Obtained: placed on a village square when the village is discovered (broken, it can be picked up), or crafted at the Carpenter's Bench. Right-click: the event, the services, the benefactors of the nearest village (96 blocks), and workers for your restoration site.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.fountain: Obtained: square decor placed when a village is discovered (broken, it can be picked up), or crafted at the Mason's Bench. It runs when the village has the Water service (a water ruin restored within 400 blocks).
jei.pioneers.info.rp.lamppost: Obtained: square decor placed when a village is discovered (broken, it can be picked up), or crafted at the Metalworker's Bench. It lights up at night when the village has the Energy service (an energy ruin restored within 400 blocks).
jei.pioneers.info.rp.crate: Obtained: decor of Peddler Halts and caravans (broken, it can be picked up), or crafted at the Carpenter's Bench. No use: decor.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.ruin_map: Obtained: the Cartographer of a village with the Archives service, or that of a Peddler village when you are Esteemed there. Right-click the first time: the three nearest ruins, recorded in the map and copied into the notebook log; after that, their direction.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.manual: Obtained: the Librarian of a village with the Archives service (200 Shining), or that of a Restorer village when you are Esteemed there. First reading: its Trade's entry in the Codex and, once, XP in the first skill of its vocation (never more than one level). The book stays.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.recycler: Only takes scrap: nothing crafted can be recycled. 2 to 3 draws per scrap, +1 per machine tier above MKI (+25%% for a Salvager owner); a 25%% chance of dust of the scrap tier's metal. U on a scrap shows the draws and their chances.

clan.pioneers.ui.home.found.text: A Charter: three sheets of paper, an ink sac, some wax. You pick a name, a color and a regime, two players sign within 8 blocks, 1,000 Shining go. We have read, we say yes.
clan.pioneers.ui.home.solo.text: Claim a chunk: your solo clan is born with the first claim, with its territory, chunkloading and Seals. Nobody to ask. Nobody to blame.
clan.pioneers.ui.home.no_invite: No invitations. The mail is slow, or you are discreet.
clan.pioneers.ui.sheet.solo_hint: A second member turns this solo clan into a regular one. Nothing is lost.
clan.pioneers.ui.ladder.solo.desc: One player, their territory, chunkloading paid out of pocket. Never besieged.
clan.pioneers.ui.ladder.clan.desc: From 2 to 40 players, a regime, a treasury, neighbors.
clan.pioneers.ui.ladder.faction.desc: A federation of 2 to 8 clans. A shared treasury, shared quarrels.
clan.pioneers.ui.ladder.people.desc: A faction that seceded. The Restorers remember.

clan.pioneers.ui.members.recruits_hint: The invitation expires in 10 minutes. You see the character, not the account.

clan.pioneers.ui.territory.no_clan: No clan. The first claim creates your solo clan: %s chunks to start.
clan.pioneers.ui.legend.fog.desc: Neither you, your clan nor your allies went there: owner unknown. The terrain comes from your minimap.
clan.pioneers.ui.legend.ally.desc: Allied clan (treaty or faction), hatched in its color.
clan.pioneers.ui.legend.neutral.desc: A clan with no treaty and no war with yours: flat in its color.
clan.pioneers.ui.legend.enemy.desc: Clan at war with yours, checkered in its color.
clan.pioneers.ui.legend.plot.desc: A Solo player's territory. Never besieged.
clan.pioneers.ui.legend.outpost.desc: An isolated chunk of your clan. It counts double.
clan.pioneers.ui.legend.decline.desc: The budget dropped: this chunk will be released.
clan.pioneers.ui.legend.captured.desc: Taken in a war. Containers sealed for 24 hours.
clan.pioneers.ui.legend.loaded.desc: The chunk stays loaded even when nobody is around: machines and farms keep running.
clan.pioneers.ui.legend.federal.desc: Open to the clans of the faction.
clan.pioneers.ui.legend.rallied.desc: A village that joined a player people.
clan.pioneers.ui.legend.tower.desc: A Watchtower. It has probably seen you.

clan.pioneers.ui.map.too_far: That chunk is off the map.
clan.pioneers.ui.treasury.no_economy: The economy is off on this world: the treasury does not move.
clan.pioneers.ui.treasury.spend_hint: Beyond your cap or %s%% of the treasury, a withdrawal becomes an expense the regime decides on.
clan.pioneers.ui.gov.none_open: No open proposals. Everyone agrees, or nobody has read.

clan.pioneers.ui.gov.tax_hint.activity: A percentage of each member sale to NPCs, taken in the same transaction. Nothing is hidden: the trade screen shows it.
clan.pioneers.ui.gov.tax_hint.dues: Shining per member per game day, taken from the balance of those online. Never any debt.
clan.pioneers.ui.gov.tax_hint.market: On sales from stalls in the territory, on top of the stall tax. The Peddlers count.
clan.pioneers.ui.gov.identity_hint: Name, tag, color and motto are decided like taxes. The banner goes on the Town Hall.
clan.pioneers.ui.gov.regime_cost: Cost: %s Shining, effective 7 days after the vote.
clan.pioneers.ui.gov.counter_tip: Opens the vote the clan's constitution provides for.
clan.pioneers.ui.diplo.windows_hint: Effective 7 days later. Nobody loses a chunk while asleep.
clan.pioneers.ui.diplo.war_off: War is off on this server. The clans pretend to get along.
clan.pioneers.ui.diplo.no_treaty: No treaties. A clan's page, under "Clans", lets you offer one.
clan.pioneers.ui.diplo.gauge_tip: The clan's standing with this people: half of its members' deeds, plus collective deeds.
clan.pioneers.ui.diplo.peddlers: Peddlers stop at the Market one day in %s.
clan.pioneers.ui.diplo.no_village: No known village. Someone will have to go out.

clan.pioneers.faction.treaty.signed: Federal treaty signed: %s, between the faction %s and %s. Read, then said yes.
clan.pioneers.faction.treaty.refused: Federal treaty refused: %s, between the faction %s and %s.
clan.pioneers.faction.treaty.broken: %s breaks the treaty (%s) with %s. It ends in %s hours.
clan.pioneers.faction.treaty.ended: End of the federal treaty (%s) between the faction %s and %s.

clan.pioneers.faction.workers_off: The federal treasury no longer pays village workers: each pays their own.
clan.pioneers.faction.log.reserve: Clan %s takes a chunk beyond its budget at %s: it joins the federal zone reserve.
clan.pioneers.faction.log.workers_on: The federal treasury pays village workers.
clan.pioneers.faction.log.workers_off: The federal treasury no longer pays village workers.
clan.pioneers.ui.diplo.federal_tip: Signed by a faction: they bind all its clans and are broken at the federal level.
ruins.pioneers.plaque.motto: Read again, understood, put back into service.
clan.pioneers.ui.gov.new.name: New name (3 to 24 characters)
jei.pioneers.info.rp.charter: Use: once drafted (name, tag, color, motto, regime), it takes two signatures within 8 blocks of the founder, within 10 minutes; sealed, it founds the clan (1,000 Shining) and is used up. It is not used in any recipe.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.pact: Use: the Representative of a clan of level 2 or higher drafts it; sealed once another clan has signed (3,000 Shining from the founding clan's treasury), it founds the faction and is used up. It is not used in any recipe.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.seal: Use: designates a block of your clan's territory (sneak + right-click on a container): Town Hall, Warehouse, Workshop, Market, Watchtower, Barracks or Archives, depending on the clan's level. Used up by the designation, returned when it falls. No recipe uses it.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.flag: Can only be planted during a war, in one of the defender's siege windows, with the “Siege Windows” permission. Indestructible; it falls outside a window, at the end of the war or after 5 minutes without an attacker. No recipe uses it.
clan.pioneers.transit.granted: %s's machines may now pass through your land.
clan.pioneers.transit.revoked: %s's machines stop at the border again.
clan.pioneers.transit.none: No clan has transit through your land. The borders hold.
pioneer.pioneers.vocation.neutral: No affinity, no advantage, no drawback: you learn everything at the same pace.
pioneer.pioneers.vocation.pick_hint: Hover over a vocation to read it, click to choose it.
pioneer.pioneers.desk.no_penalty: Your experience stays whole: your current vocation has no affinity.
vocation.pioneers.generalist.phrase: A little of every gesture, none by heart.
codex.pioneers.trade_generalist.title: The Jack-of-All-Trades
codex.pioneers.trade_generalist.author: Loose leaf, slipped into every manual
codex.pioneers.trade_generalist.text:
This leaf belongs to no manual. It was slipped into all of them.
Learn a little of every gesture. None waits for you, none turns you away.
When the master is missing, you are the one they call: at least know which manual to open.
dialogue.pioneers.vocation.generalist.0: (the Toolsmith turns your hands over) A little callus everywhere, a hard spot nowhere. You put your hand to everything. Hmm. Like my grandfather.
pioneer.pioneers.vocation.neutral_more: It counts in a brigade as one more vocation. Leaving it at the Desk costs no experience.
dialogue.pioneers.repair.amends.0: Hmm. Noted. It doesn't mend. It counts.
dialogue.pioneers.repair.amends.1: Put it there. No, not on the table. There.
dialogue.pioneers.repair.amends.2: My mother said you pay twice: once in Shining, once in time. You've paid the first.
dialogue.pioneers.repair.amends.3: Nobody smiles at you. Nobody chases you off. That's something.
dialogue.pioneers.repair.amends.4: (he counts, twice) The count is right. The rest, we'll see.
dialogue.pioneers.repair.accept.0: Do it. Then we'll talk. Maybe.
dialogue.pioneers.repair.accept.2: The whole village will watch. Nobody will say so.
dialogue.pioneers.repair.accept.3: If you don't come back, nobody will be surprised.
dialogue.pioneers.repair.done.0: The village saw. It won't say anything. It saw.
dialogue.pioneers.repair.done.1: Hmm. It's done. Well done, even.
dialogue.pioneers.repair.done.2: We don't like you yet. We hold it against you a little less.
dialogue.pioneers.repair.done.3: Wheat grows back. Grudges, more slowly.
An offering? It can be carried. It gets paid for, too.
I know their Ways. I know their doors. I don't promise their faces.
The books are the books. So are apologies, when carried far.
dialogue.pioneers.repair.emissary_refuse: You? I carry nothing for you. Not even a pebble.
We have long memories on the Ways. Go away.
village.pioneers.hostile.flee: %s runs at the sight of you.

description.pioneers.basic_wind_rotor: Three blades and their hub. Place it on the front face of a wind turbine nacelle: it takes its facing and turns with it. Disc to keep clear: radius 3 blocks (the mast must be at least that tall). The nacelle runs at the lower tier of the two.
description.pioneers.advanced_wind_rotor: Three blades and their hub. Place it on the front face of a wind turbine nacelle: it takes its facing and turns with it. Disc to keep clear: radius 4 blocks (the mast must be at least that tall). The nacelle runs at the lower tier of the two.
description.pioneers.elite_wind_rotor: Three blades and their hub. Place it on the front face of a wind turbine nacelle: it takes its facing and turns with it. Disc to keep clear: radius 5 blocks (the mast must be at least that tall). The nacelle runs at the lower tier of the two.
description.pioneers.ultimate_wind_rotor: Three blades and their hub. Place it on the front face of a wind turbine nacelle: it takes its facing and turns with it. Disc to keep clear: radius 6 blocks (the mast must be at least that tall). The nacelle runs at the lower tier of the two.
energy.pioneers.tip.wind_rotor: On a nacelle’s front face; keep a %s-block disc clear
energy.pioneers.gui.rotor_hint: Place a rotor on the front face
description.pioneers.robotic_assembly_ba: Controller of a built 7 × 6 × 9 workshop (Shift + right-click empty-handed: projected blueprint): floor of industrial casings, posts and roof edge in frames, plinth, band and back wall in sheet metal, glazing on the front and sides, a skylight above the station, and a charge pad in the middle of the floor, in front of the controller. Four articulated arms build drones, robots, rovers and turtles there from the parts the conveyor brings in from the back. Connections: industrial energy and item ports in the floor, plinth or sheets (item port set to output: the finished product is pushed out).
description.pioneers.rocket_integration_: Controller of a built 9 × 15 × 9 tower (Shift + right-click empty-handed: projected blueprint): floor of industrial casings with 3 × 3 launch pad plates in the middle, corner columns and belts in frames, plinth and sheet-metal piers, glazed bays, a tall glass door at the front, sheet-metal roof with a skylight. The rocket (or the station kit) is assembled standing up, beside a service tower, under two overhead cranes. Connections: industrial energy and item ports in the floor, plinth or sheets (item port set to output: the finished product is pushed out).
assembler.pioneers.structure.blueprint: Shift + right-click the controller empty-handed: projected blueprint
Form a robotic assembly bay: four articulated arms build your units.
advancements.pioneers.space.integration_: Form a rocket integration hall: the rocket is assembled standing up, under the overhead cranes.
farm.pioneers.food.place_pile: Shift + right-click on top of a block: set it down (up to %s per block)
pioscript.doc.link.lockRecipe.desc: Locks a recipe (recipe selector): the machine makes only that one and refuses any other input. Returns true if it is a recipe of this machine (full id, or without “pioneers:”).
pioscript.doc.link.unlockRecipe.desc: Removes the lock: the machine goes back to the most complete recipe that fits. Returns true if the machine has a selector.
pioscript.doc.link.lockedRecipe.desc: Id of the locked recipe, or None.
gui.pioneers.recipe_lock.only: The machine makes only this recipe and refuses any other input.
gui.pioneers.recipe_lock.missing: Locked recipe not found (recipes have changed): the machine runs as if unlocked. Right-click to clear it.
gui.pioneers.recipe_lock.none: No lock: the most complete one goes first.
gui.pioneers.recipe_lock.warning: %s recipes fit these inputs: lock the right one.
gui.pioneers.recipe_lock.hint: Click: choose · right-click: unlock · drag from JEI
gui.pioneers.recipe_lock.title: Machine recipes
gui.pioneers.recipe_lock.hint_panel: Enter: lock · arrows: pick · Del: unlock
gui.pioneers.recipe_lock.ready: All its inputs are in the machine.
gui.pioneers.recipe_lock.refused: That is not a recipe of this machine.
jei.pioneers.recipe_lock.info_1: Recipe selector: the “Recipe” slot of the interface (above the arrow) opens the list of the machine’s recipes. Those whose inputs are already in the machine come first (green edge); type to filter.
jei.pioneers.recipe_lock.info_2: Clicking a recipe locks it: the machine then makes only that one, and its slots, tanks and ports refuse anything that doesn’t go into it (hoppers, belts, robots, logistics). Right-click the slot: the lock is removed. JEI’s “+” button, or an item dragged from JEI onto the slot, also sets the lock.
jei.pioneers.recipe_lock.info_3: The lock stays in the machine when it is broken and placed again. It can also be set by PioScript (m.lockRecipe, m.unlockRecipe, m.lockedRecipe) and from the logistic terminal (Machines tab). Amber dot on the slot: several recipes take the inputs present. Red corner: the recipe needs a higher tier than the machine (“Tier too low: MKIII required”, nothing is used up).
Recipe machines served by this network: see and set their locked recipe.
robotics.pioneers.terminal.machine_hint: Click: choose the recipe · right-click: clear the lock
robotics.pioneers.terminal.no_machines: No recipe machine served by this network.
robotics.pioneers.terminal.machines_hint: Machines served by a logistic marker or chest of the network. Once locked, a machine only takes the inputs of its recipe.
description.pioneers.advanced_power_hamm: Forges by impact: billets, gear blanks, every tool head (advanced metals at the higher tiers); cold heading of fasteners.
description.pioneers.basic_power_hammer: Forges by impact: billets, gear blanks, every tool head (advanced metals at the higher tiers); cold heading of fasteners.
description.pioneers.elite_power_hammer: Forges by impact: billets, gear blanks, every tool head (advanced metals at the higher tiers); cold heading of fasteners.
description.pioneers.industrial_power_ha: Forges by impact: billets, gear blanks, every tool head (advanced metals at the higher tiers); cold heading of fasteners. 5 × 4 × 3 structure (frames). Mechanical cladding. Shift + right-click for the blueprint.
description.pioneers.ultimate_power_hamm: Forges by impact: billets, gear blanks, every tool head (advanced metals at the higher tiers); cold heading of fasteners.
item.pioneers.foundry_sand.desc: Zircon sand bound with clay: rammed into sand molds (molder’s bench, press).
item.pioneers.spent_foundry_sand.desc: Sand from a sand mold shaken out in the screen: at the screen, 5 spent sands give back 4 foundry sands.
item.pioneers.sand_mold.desc: Casting machine (MKI): rough castings (gear blanks, pump impellers, cauldron, lead balls). In the Tool slot: unbreakable, never consumed. A mold you no longer want is shaken out in the screen (spent sand).
item.pioneers.wax_pattern.desc: Lost-wax pattern: dipped in zirconia slurry and fired in the industrial furnace (sintering), it makes a shell mold.
item.pioneers.ceramic_shell_mold.desc: Casting machine (MKII, oil at least): precision and art castings (bell, stainless and duralumin gear blanks). In the Tool slot: unbreakable, never consumed.
item.pioneers.vacuum_casting_mold.desc: Casting machine (MKIII, liquid nitrogen at least): vacuum-cast billets of titanium, nichrome and nuclear-grade stainless steel. In the Tool slot: unbreakable, never consumed.
description.pioneers.molder_bench: Foundry: foundry sand, sand molds (rammer), wax patterns for shell molds.
item.pioneers.copper_scrap_bale.desc: Nine copper nuggets pressed in the compactor: the converter and the electrolyzer (electrorefining) melt it at 95%%.
item.pioneers.chromite_pellets.desc: Chromite concentrate bound with clay: the arc furnace gets a quarter more ferrochrome from it; the blast furnace makes some too.
item.pioneers.ilmenite_pellets.desc: Ilmenite concentrate bound with clay: titanium slag in the arc furnace (×1.25) or the blast furnace (MKIII).
item.pioneers.steel_green_compact.desc: Pressed steel powder: sintered under hydrogen, it makes a sintered gear.
item.pioneers.bronze_green_compact.desc: Pressed bronze powder: sintered under hydrogen, it makes sixteen self-lubricating rings.
item.pioneers.tannin.desc: Hot-water extract of oak: tans leather in the extractor (leaching).
item.pioneers.essential_oil.desc: Steam or CO₂ distilled: scents soap in the chemical reactor.
item.pioneers.cocoa_butter.desc: Pressed out of roasted cocoa: replaces butter in chocolate.
item.pioneers.hop_extract.desc: Concentrated hop bitterness: brews beer in the fermenter.
item.pioneers.pectin.desc: Gelling agent from citrus and apples: firmer jam, in larger batches.
item.pioneers.lanolin.desc: Wool grease, solvent extracted: thickens grease in the mixer.
Contact exposure, photochemical machining of foils. 64 engravings. MKII or better compact engraver, or cleanroom engraver.
item.pioneers.uv_engraving_objective.des: Stepper under argon, fine contact springs. 256 engravings; also does the glass objective's. MKIII or better compact engraver, or cleanroom engraver.
item.pioneers.euv_engraving_objective.de: Beryllium mirrors, tin plasma. 1,024 engravings; does every engraving.
item.pioneers.worn_glass_engraving_objec: Worn out: the machining center (grinding) repolishes its lenses (2 glass lenses, diamond dust).
item.pioneers.worn_uv_engraving_objectiv: Worn out: the machining center (grinding) repolishes its lenses (2 fluorite lenses, sapphire dust).
item.pioneers.worn_euv_engraving_objecti: Worn out: the machining center (grinding) repolishes its mirrors (2 beryllium mirrors, rare earth oxide).
jei.pioneers.compactor.info_1: The compactor presses what is left loose: scraps into bales, concentrates into pellets (with a binder: clay, pitch, lime), powders into green compacts, wood chips into briquettes, ices and regoliths of other worlds.
jei.pioneers.compactor.info_2: The binder goes into its own slot, above the Recipe slot. The compactor no longer makes plates or ingots.
jei.pioneers.compactor.info_3: A bale melts at 95%% and twice as fast as loose scraps; pellets give a quarter more.
jei.pioneers.extractor.info_1: Three techniques, one per tier: hot water and steam (MKI), solvents (MKII), supercritical CO₂ (MKIII).
jei.pioneers.extractor.info_2: The solvent (naphtha, ethanol) and the CO₂ come back at 90%%: send them back to the input.
jei.pioneers.extractor.info_3: Every extraction leaves a useful residue: press cake (feed), pomace (compost), chips (fuel).
jei.pioneers.engraver.info_1: The optical engraver engraves with light through an engraving objective placed in an input slot.
jei.pioneers.engraver.info_2: The objective is not consumed: it loses one point per engraving; worn out, it becomes a worn objective.
jei.pioneers.engraver.info_3: A MKII engraving takes any objective; a MKIII engraving, the UV objective or the EUV optics.
jei.pioneers.engraving_objective.info_1: Engraving objectives: glass (64 engravings), UV (256), EUV (1,024). Built in the assembler.
jei.pioneers.engraving_objective.info_2: A worn objective is reconditioned in the machining center (grinding) for half the cost of a new one.
item.pioneers.isotope_standard.desc: Sealed ampoule of nitrogen-15 or ¹³CO₂: calibrates spectrometers.
item.pioneers.arc_lamp.desc: Xenon or krypton in fused silica: optical engravers and pumped lasers.
item.pioneers.cobalt_60.desc: Sealed source: thickness, level and density gauges.
description.pioneers.components_bench: Ingot-based components by hand: plates, sheets, foils, rods, wires, rings, springs, gears, tubes, meshes, wire ropes, slabs and billets, with hammer and knife. No machine or power needed, but less efficient: part of the metal is lost. By machine: the press, rolling mill, wiremill, bender, extruder and machining center.
description.pioneers.sale_bin: Place it on a village square (within 32 blocks of the bell), one per village. Fill it (54 slots, hoppers and cables included): every night at midnight, the village buys what it can at 70%% of a villager's price, credits you in Shining and is grateful (+1 reputation per 200 Shining, 3 at most per night). Whatever does not sell stays in the bin. Selling face to face pays more, in Shining and in reputation.
economy.pioneers.bin.placed: Sale bin placed: the village will empty it every night at midnight.
economy.pioneers.bin.no_village: A sale bin goes on a village square: within 32 blocks of its bell.
economy.pioneers.bin.one_per_village: You already have a sale bin in this village.
economy.pioneers.bin.refused: The village wanted nothing from your bin tonight: it no longer trades with you.
economy.pioneers.bin.sold: Sale bin: %s items sold tonight, %s Shining, village reputation +%s.
economy.pioneers.bin.left: %s items stay in the bin (unsellable, or more than the village takes in one night).
economy.pioneers.bin.pending: The village remembers your bin: reputation +%s.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.sale_bin: Use: placed on a village square, one per player per village. Midnight: sold at 35%% of the value (twice a villager's quota per kind of item), Shining credited even while offline, village reputation +1 per 200 Shining (3 per night at most). Components, machines, damaged, renamed or enchanted items stay in the bin.
jei.pioneers.prod.drops.hint: Broken with the right tool; Fortune may add more.
jei.pioneers.prod.world.title: Generated: %s
jei.pioneers.prod.world.body: These blocks generate on the surface and underground of this world; collect them there.
jei.pioneers.prod.world.earth: These blocks generate in the starting world (by biome); collect them there.
jei.pioneers.prod.world.meteor.title: Meteor showers
jei.pioneers.prod.world.meteor: Buried at the bottom of meteor-shower craters (sky event); also in the ground of some worlds.
jei.pioneers.prod.gathering.seeds.title: Wild seeds
jei.pioneers.prod.gathering.seeds: Grass and ferns broken without shears: a seed of a crop suited to the biome’s climate.
jei.pioneers.prod.gathering.sapling: Natural leaves of its climate; once planted, the tree blossoms then bears fruit.
jei.pioneers.prod.gathering.worm.title: Earthworms
jei.pioneers.prod.gathering.worm: Digging dirt, grass or mud. A fishing bait in the off hand.
jei.pioneers.prod.crops.crop: Ripe in about %s min. Climate: temperature %s to %s, humidity %s to %s; elsewhere it grows poorly or withers.
jei.pioneers.prod.crops.tree: Fruit ripe in about %s min; right-click the foliage to pick. Climate: temperature %s to %s.
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.bottle: Right-click a cooking station holding this liquid with the empty container.
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.bucket: Right-click a station holding this liquid with an empty bucket; pour it back the same way.
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.cheese.title: Ripening
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.cheese: Place the fresh wheel in the dark (light 7 or less): it ripens by itself.
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.canned.title: Canning
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.canned: Sealer: a tin and a dish; the can keeps the dish, its food and its effects.
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.compost.title: Composting
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.compost: Compost bin filled with compostable waste; after fermenting, compost (fertilizer, bone meal).
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.honey.title: Apiary
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.honey: An empty frame in an inhabited apiary fills with honey, faster near flowers.
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.egg.title: Laying
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.egg: A hen lays a fertile egg when an adult rooster is close; it hatches in an incubator.
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.capsule.title: Gas capsule
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.capsule: Right-click a block with a gas tank: empty, it takes 1 B; full, it pours.
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.cigar.title: Lighting
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.cigar: Right-click with something to light it.
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.flight.title: Flight computer
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.flight: In a computer’s drive, flight.flash() writes the flight program (PioScript).
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.aerostat: In a gas giant, right-click: deploys a 9 × 9 aerostat in the clouds; break it to collect its parts.
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.plaque.title: Restoration
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.plaque: Set when a restored ruin is commissioned, with the names of its contributors.
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.wear.title: Wear: %s
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.wear: The objective is not consumed: one point per engraving; after the last, it becomes the worn objective (grinder: refurbished).
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.fish_bucket: Right-click a live fish with a water bucket; it keeps its species and size to stock a pond.
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.roe.title: Spawn
jei.pioneers.prod.gestures.roe: Fish sometimes spawn in a lightly stocked seagrass bed; a bottle harvests the cluster (sturgeon: caviar roe).
jei.pioneers.prod.fishing.title: Fishing: %s
jei.pioneers.prod.fishing.fish: With a float, in: %s. Size %s to %s cm; reel in when the line tightens.
jei.pioneers.prod.fishing.net.title: Net: %s
jei.pioneers.prod.fishing.net: Placed in water, it slowly catches the fish of its habitat.
jei.pioneers.prod.fishing.pot.title: Pot: %s
jei.pioneers.prod.fishing.pot: Placed in water near the shore, baited; you collect what it caught.
jei.pioneers.prod.ruins.site.hint: Generated in the starting world; breaking a derelict block wakes the Sentinels and damages the ruin.
jei.pioneers.prod.ruins.cabinet: Opens like a chest; one cabinet of each ruin holds the Service Note (the console code).
jei.pioneers.prod.ruins.sentinel: Loot of a defeated Sentinel (by its ruin’s tier).
jei.pioneers.prod.villages.square.hint: Placed on the square when a village is discovered; broken, they can be picked up.
jei.pioneers.prod.villages.halt.hint: Decor of Peddler halts and caravans.
jei.pioneers.prod.villages.librarian.hin: Sold for Shining by the Librarian of a village with the Archives service (or of the Restorers, once Esteemed there).
Sold by the Cartographer of a village with the Archives service (or of the Peddlers, once Esteemed there).
jei.pioneers.prod.renewable.solar: Depends on the sun’s height, the weather and the world; nothing at night. Touching panels pool their energy.
jei.pioneers.prod.renewable.rotor: Rotor: a separate block, placed on the nacelle’s front face
jei.pioneers.prod.renewable.wind: Nacelle on top of a mast; keep the rotor disc clear (radius %s); more wind high up and in bad weather.
jei.pioneers.prod.renewable.hydro: Intake at the back in a reservoir (%s sources for full power), full head at %s blocks, free outlet at the front.
jei.pioneers.prod.renewable.geothermal: Water used at full power: %s. Nothing near the surface, best deep down and in the Nether; nearby lava helps.
jei.pioneers.prod.renewable.microbial: Eats organic matter: an item that always composts is worth %s, others their composting chance.
jei.pioneers.prod.kinetic.rock: Rock the drill stands on (never used up)
jei.pioneers.prod.kinetic.drill: From rotation: %s shaft turns per block; it pushes its output into neighboring inventories.
jei.pioneers.prod.kinetic.noria: From rotation, draws the water below and lifts it; its reserve empties through the top and sides.
jei.pioneers.prod.probes.launch: Launched from a launch pad by a rocket %s or better.
jei.pioneers.prod.probes.data: An antenna receives %s unit(s) per tick per probe, %s transmission loss.
jei.pioneers.prod.research.blueprint: Finish the “%s” research: the research table prints the blueprint.
jei.pioneers.prod.research.ai: Training at the AI lab: data, telemetry and compute from the digital network.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.use.notebook: The profile lives in the world, not in the notebook: if lost, make it again here without losing anything.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.use.blank_notebook: Makes the Restorer's Desk; each vocation change uses one up.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.use.desk: Right-click: vocations and vocation change (Blank Notebook and Shining), then a ceremony.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.use.stall: Placed: your lots sell there, even while offline, tax-free.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.use.sale_bin: On a village square (one per player): sold at midnight, Shining credited even while offline.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.use.charter: Drafted then signed by two nearby players: it founds the clan and is used up.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.use.pact: Drafted by a clan's Representative, signed by another clan: it founds the faction.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.use.seal: Sneak + right-click a container of the territory: gives it a clan function.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.use.flag: Planted during a war, in one of the defender's siege windows.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.use.controller: Right-click: the ruin's restoration site sheet.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.use.console: Right-click: the keypad; the right code puts the ruin on Standby.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.use.recycler: Only takes ruin scrap: U on a scrap shows its draws.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.use.ruin_map: Right-click: the three nearest ruins, then their direction.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.use.manual: First reading: the Codex entry and vocation XP; the book stays.
jei.pioneers.info.rp.use.plaque: Right-click: the engraved names of the contributors.
jei.pioneers.prod.world.oil.title: Oil fields
jei.pioneers.prod.world.oil: Around real oil fields (deserts and oceans): seeps and tar sands.
jei.pioneers.prod.kinetic.pump: Draws the fluid blocks below it (1,000 mB per block, %s blocks around, %s per pass at most); water never runs out.
jei.pioneers.prod.kinetic.dynamo: From rotation: 1 FE per %s J of mechanical work (torque × speed); its load adapts itself to the sources to draw the most power (up to %s FE/t at MKI, ×4 per tier); pushes energy to its neighbors.
jei.pioneers.prod.outpost.line: Built on %s: the rover drills the prospected veins, with a hard enough drill head.
minimap.pioneers.map.title: Map
minimap.pioneers.map.no_waypoint: No waypoint in this dimension. Use the waypoint key, "+ Here" or right-click the map to place one.
minimap.pioneers.map.help: Drag: move   Wheel: zoom   Right-click: waypoint   Click a waypoint: edit
minimap.pioneers.edit.title: Waypoint
minimap.pioneers.edit.name: Name
minimap.pioneers.edit.teleport_help: Admins (operators), in creative or spectator mode
minimap.pioneers.settings.title: Minimap settings
minimap.pioneers.settings.measure: Survey: %s µs per chunk, %s chunks, %s regions
logistic.pioneers.rate.gas: Gases and steam: %s mB/t per channel
logistic.pioneers.tooltip.lined: PTFE lining: corrosive and cryogenic fluids accepted
logistic.pioneers.tooltip.unlined: Unlined: no corrosive or cryogenic fluids
logistic.pioneers.tooltip.channels: 16 channels, every type allowed at this level; joins other levels (the weakest one wins)
logistic.pioneers.tooltip.superconductin: Energy only, lossless; joins only itself and machines
logistic.pioneers.tooltip.use: Right-click: the network; wrench: cut or restore a side
logistic.pioneers.status.none: No machine is connected to this cable
logistic.pioneers.profile.header: Logistic networks: %s, last tick %s µs. Most expensive:
logistic.pioneers.diagram.title: Logistic Network
logistic.pioneers.diagram.subtitle: %s, %s cables
logistic.pioneers.diagram.copy_tip: Copy the whole network (channels and settings by machine type) to paste it onto another network
logistic.pioneers.diagram.paste_tip: Paste the copied network: channels recreated, settings applied to machines of the same type
logistic.pioneers.diagram.to_auto_tip: Back to auto: clears every channel and setting
logistic.pioneers.diagram.confirm_auto: Go back to auto? Every channel and every machine setting will be cleared.
logistic.pioneers.diagram.weak_tip: Click: show in the world (10 s) the %s cables limiting the network
logistic.pioneers.diagram.weak_shown: %s cable(s) highlighted in the world for 10 s
logistic.pioneers.diagram.auto_banner: Automatic mode: whatever machines eject goes to the others. The first change creates real channels.
logistic.pioneers.diagram.tip_hint_group: Click: edit the group · Shift + click: unfold · drag: move
logistic.pioneers.diagram.status_none: No channel: "+ New channel" to create one
logistic.pioneers.diagram.reorder_tip: Move the channel up / down (the first channel of the right type gets what the machine ejects)
logistic.pioneers.diagram.name: Name
logistic.pioneers.diagram.mode_tip.round: Outputs are served one after another
logistic.pioneers.diagram.mode_tip.prior: The highest-priority output is filled before the next
logistic.pioneers.diagram.mode_tip.propo: Shared according to each output's weight
logistic.pioneers.diagram.body_note: Heat and pressure: one body shared by the whole network; each point's role is a valve.
logistic.pioneers.diagram.filter_click: click a slot to remove it
logistic.pioneers.diagram.condition_tip: Click: next condition (redstone received by a cable of the network)
logistic.pioneers.diagram.points_hint: Click a machine in the diagram to set its point in this channel.
logistic.pioneers.diagram.confirm_delete: Delete channel "%s" and its point settings?
logistic.pioneers.diagram.role_tip.none: The machine takes no part in this channel
logistic.pioneers.diagram.role_tip.input: The machine gives to the cable
logistic.pioneers.diagram.role_tip.outpu: The cable delivers to the machine
logistic.pioneers.diagram.pull: Input: pull from the machine (otherwise: what it ejects)
logistic.pioneers.diagram.pull_tip: Checked: the cable extracts by itself. Unchecked: it only accepts what the machine ejects into the plug.
logistic.pioneers.diagram.face_touched_t: Go through the face the cable touches
logistic.pioneers.diagram.face_touched_n: The cable goes through the face it touches.
logistic.pioneers.diagram.face_other_not: The cable touches the %s face but goes through the machine's %s face (its face settings are respected).
logistic.pioneers.diagram.face_closed: This face is closed for this type: nothing will pass. Pick a colored face.
logistic.pioneers.diagram.keep_tip: Only extract the surplus above this amount
logistic.pioneers.diagram.fill_tip: Only insert up to this amount into the machine
logistic.pioneers.diagram.copy_point_tip: Copy this machine's settings in every channel
logistic.pioneers.diagram.paste_point_ti: Paste the copied settings (same channel, otherwise same name and type)
logistic.pioneers.diagram.group_tip: Apply to the whole group, or to this machine only
logistic.pioneers.diagram.network_paste_: Nothing to paste: copy a network first
logistic.pioneers.diagram.confirm_paste: Replace the whole configuration with the copied network (%s channels, %s machine type(s) present here)?
logistic.pioneers.diagram.help.1: A channel carries one type (items, fluids, gases, energy, heat, pressure, data) between the connected machines. 16 channels per network.
logistic.pioneers.diagram.help.2: Click a channel: it is colored in the diagram. Click again: its settings (type, filter, distribution, flow).
logistic.pioneers.diagram.help.3: Click a machine: its role in the chosen channel, the face used (independent of the one the cable touches), priority and limits.
logistic.pioneers.diagram.help.4: Wheel: zoom. Drag the background: scroll. Drag a machine: move it (for every player).
logistic.pioneers.diagram.help.5: Identical machines with the same settings: one ×N node, set at once. Shift + click: unfold or regroup.
logistic.pioneers.diagram.help.6: Copy / Paste (top): the whole configuration, settings stored by machine type.
logistic.pioneers.diagram.help.7: Shift + right-click a plug: diagram opened on that machine. Wrench: cut or restore a side.
logistic.pioneers.diagram.help.8: The weak link (cable of the lowest level) limits the whole network: click it to see it in the world.
logistic.pioneers.diagram.denied_view: You cannot view this network (protected territory)
logistic.pioneers.diagram.denied_edit: You cannot change this network (protected territory)
logistic.pioneers.diagram.denied_machine: Some machines are in protected territory: their settings did not change
logistic.pioneers.diagram.gone: The network no longer exists (cable broken or too far away)
logistic.pioneers.diagram.too_big: Change too large to send (filters or copied network too heavy)
jei.pioneers.info.logistic_cable: One cable for everything: items, fluids, gases, energy, heat, pressure, data. Right-click the cable: the network diagram (16 channels, who gives, who receives, through which face). Every level connects; the network takes the weakest.
jei.pioneers.info.logistic_cable.levels: Per channel, wood → MKIV: items 4 / 12 / 32 / 128 / 512 / 2,048 per s; fluids 160 → 64,000 mB/t; gases from bronze on (640 → 128,000 mB/t); energy and data from MKI on.
jei.pioneers.info.logistic_cable.limits: Wood: fluids up to 400 K. Bronze: steam, heat, pressure, molten metals up to 1,200 °C. MKI: every molten metal. MKII and better: corrosive and cryogenic fluids (PTFE lining).
jei.pioneers.info.superconducting_cable: Energy only, lossless: 1,073,741,824 FE/t per channel (×128 of MKIV). Joins only itself and machines.
description.pioneers.advanced_components: Builds the catalog components: frames, motors, bearings, pumps, circuits, computers, upgrade kits. The wrench is the tool. By machine: the Assembler.
description.pioneers.logistics_bench: Builds logistics parts: rockets and spaceport, railroad tracks and posts, harbors, robotics and hypertubes (vehicles: railroad works and shipyard). The wrench is the tool. The Assembler automates its parts.
gui.pioneers.recipe_lock.auto: No lock: the most complete one goes first
energy.pioneers.fe.recipe: %s FE/t for %s s: %s FE in total
energy.pioneers.fe.multi_tier: Multiblock %s: %s FE/t per operation, %s FE in total
energy.pioneers.fe.per_op_max: up to %s FE/t per operation at MKI (×4 per tier; 4 to 32 operations in parallel)
jei.pioneers.fe.title: Energy per operation
jei.pioneers.fe.fuel_tiers: MKII / MKIII / MKIV: %s / %s / %s FE/t, same total; multiblock: %s FE in total
jei.pioneers.fe.parallel: Multiblock: 4 to 32 operations in parallel by tier, FE/t multiplied as much.
jei.pioneers.chip.energy_tip: At the minimum tier; each tier above: ×2 speed, ×4 FE/t.
jei.pioneers.multiblock.blocks_tip: Controller included; inner cells left empty: %s
jei.pioneers.multiblock.any_tier: Any tier or material of this block (they cycle)
jei.pioneers.multiblock.drag: Drag: rotate · wheel or ▲ ▼: layer by layer
tooltip.pioneers.cosmetic.wear: Right-click, or Shift + click in the inventory: put it on.
gui.pioneers.cosmetic.slot_hint: Place a garment from the tanner's bench here.
gui.pioneers.cosmetic.take_hint: Click: take · Shift + click: put away
description.pioneers.tanner_bench: Leather, fur and cloth: the 80 pieces of the 20 cosmetic outfits and the banner patterns; the “Patterns” button opens the banner loom (it replaces the vanilla loom). Tools: knife and shears.
advancements.pioneers.pioneer.tanner.des: Make a first garment at the tanner's bench
advancements.pioneers.pioneer.wardrobe.d: Wear all four pieces of the same outfit
logistic.pioneers.diagram.arrange_tip: Clear diagram: fewer crossings, aligned on a grid, right stays right. Nodes moved by hand are reset.
logistic.pioneers.diagram.help.9: When opened, the diagram follows the world as you see it: a machine on your right is on the right, one ahead of you is at the top. "Rearrange" makes it clearer; unfolding a group rearranges it at once.
logistic.pioneers.diagram.refused: Change refused (channel not found or network changed): diagram refreshed.
logistic.pioneers.diagram.picker_search_: Search: name, @mod, #tag. Enter: adds the only result, or what you typed (#tag, @mod, mod:id).
logistic.pioneers.diagram.picker_no_list: No list for this type: type a key.
logistic.pioneers.diagram.picker_drag_ti: Click, or drag onto the filter: add
tooltip.pioneers.hydroponic_substrate: Water-soaked soil: once tilled, it takes every seed, from Earth crops to the space greenhouse.
tooltip.pioneers.hydroponic_substrate.ti: Packed: till it with a hoe
farm.pioneers.space_seed.elsewhere: Elsewhere: slower growth on a world of similar temperature, otherwise nothing
jei.pioneers.wild.greenhouse.genes: Genes as on Earth: Growth (speed), Yield (harvest), Fertility (seeds, mutations), Resistance (±2 to ±11 °C around %s °C: elsewhere, slower growth on a world close enough in temperature).
jei.pioneers.prod.crops.hydro: On tilled hydroponic substrate: grows ×1.5 faster, same climate.
industry.pioneers.dynamo.spec_torque: Rated torque %s N·m · %s rpm at most
industry.pioneers.dynamo.spec_rate: 1 J of rotation → 1 FE; load adapts itself to the source
gui.pioneers.dynamo.reserve_tip: Pushed out of the four faces without a shaft (cable, machine).
gui.pioneers.dynamo.output_ok_tip: A neighboring cable or machine takes the energy.
gui.pioneers.dynamo.output_none_tip: Nobody takes the energy: place a logistic cable (MKI or better) or a machine against a face without a shaft.
gui.pioneers.dynamo.excitation_tip: Share of the sources’ power the dynamo takes: lower it to leave some to machines on the same network. Click: next; Shift + click: previous.
gui.pioneers.dynamo.help.0: The shaft does not turn: connect a source (windmill, horse mill, steam engine…).
gui.pioneers.dynamo.help.1: It draws as much power as possible from the source.
gui.pioneers.dynamo.help.2: Two paths give two different ratios, or the network is too big: check the drive.
gui.pioneers.dynamo.help.3: Too fast for this tier: reduce the speed (gearshift, rotation regulator) or move up a tier.
gui.pioneers.dynamo.help.4: Nothing takes the energy: the dynamo keeps loading the source, the surplus is lost.
gui.pioneers.dynamo.help.5: The source gives more than the dynamo can take: add a dynamo or move up a tier.
gui.pioneers.dynamo.help.6: Slow, strong source: spin the dynamo faster (gearshift ×2 or ×4, cogwheel and cog) to draw more.
gui.pioneers.dynamo.help.7: It takes nothing: the source stays with the machines.
minimap.pioneers.style.beacon.tip: Colored beam from the ground to the sky, with the name and distance
minimap.pioneers.style.point.tip: Colored diamond always facing you, with the name; the distance shows when you look at it
minimap.pioneers.style.hidden.tip: Nothing in the world: the waypoint stays on the minimap and the map
gui.pioneers.foundry.auto_off: Automatic pouring: off (“Pour” button or redstone signal)
gui.pioneers.foundry.auto_inputs: Only waits for metal that is still melting; ores and ingots in the slots stay in the furnace
industry.pioneers.radiator.spec_loss: Loss to air: %s J/t/K · conductance %s J/t/K
industry.pioneers.radiator.spec_rated: At %s K: ≈ %s J/t removed (like %s mB/t of water)
jei.pioneers.radiator.loss: Loss to air: %s J/t per kelvin above 300 K; conductance to the port: %s J/t/K; capacity: %s J/K.
jei.pioneers.radiator.rated: Against a %s multiblock at its rated temperature (%s K): ≈ %s J/t removed, as much as %s mB/t of water.
jei.pioneers.radiator.early: Against an MKI multiblock (%s K): ≈ %s J/t (the MKI body limits the exchange).
jei.pioneers.radiator.use: Place it against a heat port set to output; radiators add up (one per free face). ×4 per tier.
advancements.pioneers.heat_pressure.radi: Make a radiator: against a heat port, it gives a multiblock’s heat back to the air.
Take a radiator up to MKIV.
advancements.pioneers.heat_pressure.heat: Make a heat buffer to keep heat.
tooltip.pioneers.api.industrial: Per operation: %s of the time, %s of the energy
tooltip.pioneers.api.casing_tier: Tier: that of the weakest casing
