gui.pioneers.api.info.help_heater: Set the power and the target temperature · heat leaves through the heat sides
gui.pioneers.api.info.help_compressor: Set the requested pressure · air leaves through the compressed air sides
gui.pioneers.api.info.help_space: Settings in the right column · the battery drains into the energy buffer
gui.pioneers.api.info.help_bench: Item on top, module below, then Install · on / off and removal in the list
gui.pioneers.api.info.help_generator: Energy leaves through the energy sides · the card shows what the site provides
gui.pioneers.api.info.help_rail: The post serves the vehicle stopped in front of it · the station sets what it loads
gui.pioneers.api.info.help_science: Produced data leaves through the data sides · follow the research with K
gui.pioneers.api.info.help_works: Put the requested parts in the grid · pick the blueprint on the left
gui.pioneers.api.info.help_network: Link the machine to the data network with a logistic cable
gui.pioneers.multiblock.tab_tip: Blocks by role, first fault, plan, JEI
gui.pioneers.multiblock.info_help: Multiblock: parallel set by the weakest part's tier. Plan: Shift + right-click, or the Structure tab.
tooltip.pioneers.multiblock.plan: Plan: Shift + right-click the controller, or the Structure tab
tooltip.pioneers.multiblock.sets_tier: Sets the structure tier: %s (the weakest part counts)
tooltip.pioneers.multiblock.port_rule: Serves the formed controller around it; direction with the wrench
gui.pioneers.api.info.help_age: Hoppers on every side · the left gauge shows the driving power
gui.pioneers.api.info.help_dynamo: Energy leaves through the 4 sides off the shaft · Shift + click: previous excitation
tooltip.pioneers.api.station: Hand station: not a machine (tools and clicks)
gui.pioneers.multiblock.house.head: Multiblock structure
gui.pioneers.api.info.help_house: Structure tab: state, first fault and plan · Shift + right-click the controller: the plan
gui.pioneers.api.info.help_kitchen: Recipes tab: lock a recipe (otherwise the most complete one) · buckets and bottles in the Fill / Empty slots
gui.pioneers.api.info.help_source: Rotation source: the shaft leaves by the sides · the left gauge shows what drives it
gui.pioneers.api.info.help_crucible: A bellows facing the furnace raises the fire · the casting table goes in front
gui.pioneers.api.info.help_casting: Place a mold, then pour from the furnace behind
gui.pioneers.api.info.help_workshop: Recipes tab: pick the part · the dies replace the bench tools
gui.pioneers.api.info.help_workbench: Pick the part in the grid (the search filters it) · tools and materials go in the left slots
gui.pioneers.mech.state_help.0: Input on the negative end of the axis, output on the other; a redstone signal goes back to ×1.
gui.pioneers.mech.state_help.1: A redstone signal disengages the output (two networks).
gui.pioneers.mech.state_help.2: A redstone signal reverses the output.
gui.pioneers.mech.slider_ratio_help: Mouse wheel: one notch. The wrench steps to the next ratio.
gui.pioneers.mech.slider_target: Target speed: drag the slider (5 to 120 rpm)
gui.pioneers.mech.slider_target_help: Mouse wheel: 1 rpm. The wrench steps to the next notch.
gui.pioneers.mech.governor.help: Above the target speed, it brakes the network harder the larger the gap, and emits a signal of 15.
message.pioneers.forge_hearth.full: The hearth keeps at most %s: set the limit in its interface (Shift + right-click).
gui.pioneers.hearth.state.out: Out: light it (flint and steel, fire starter)
gui.pioneers.hearth.state.ready: Ready to forge: to the anvil!
gui.pioneers.hearth.help: One piece at a time in the embers, never melted; a bellows facing the hearth fans it (up to +500 °C).
gui.pioneers.hearth.slider_ingots: Ingots kept waiting: drag the slider (1 to 16)
gui.pioneers.hearth.slider_coal: Coal kept: drag the slider (1 to 64)
gui.pioneers.hearth.slider_help: A right-click with a stack and hoppers put in no more than that. Mouse wheel: one notch.
gui.pioneers.hearth.slot_piece: Piece in the embers (comes out below once workable)
foundry.pioneers.mixed: Nothing to pour yet: too little metal for this mold.
foundry.pioneers.dosing: The filter is waiting for a metal for: %s (the furnace doses its metals).
tooltip.pioneers.anvil_mold: Place it on a block (right-click its top), pour 10 iron ingots (1,440 mB) into it with the tongs, in several goes: it keeps the metal between pours. Empty hand: the iron anvil. Wears with each anvil.
block.pioneers.tool_rack.desc: Holds up to 3 tools, in plain sight and facing you. Placed on the ground: a floor rack; placed on the side of a block: hung on the wall (tools hang from pegs, joins its neighbors). Right-click with a tool to rack it in the aimed slot; empty hand: take the aimed tool back. Comparator: 5 per tool.
block.pioneers.wooden_fluid_buffer.desc: An 8,000 mB barrel: takes and gives a cold liquid on every side (bucket: right-click). Placed on a noria, it hooks onto it and fills with water.
steam.pioneers.boiler.fire_out: Boiler fired dry: the fire goes out.
gui.pioneers.multiblock.house.auto_found: Missing fire brick firebox or foundry vat
gui.pioneers.api.info.auto_mold_value: the automatic foundry, through a channel above
gui.pioneers.api.info.help_auto_foundry: Bellows against a firebox · casting channels against the vat · hoppers on any part
gui.pioneers.api.info.help_auto_mold: A casting channel above · the part comes out underneath or on the sides
block.pioneers.auto_foundry.desc: The firebox door of a foundry: fireboxes below, a vat on top, 1×1×2, 2×2×3 or 3×3×5 (Shift + right-click with an empty hand: the blueprint). It melts the crucible furnace metals and pours them by itself, through the channels, into automatic molds.
block.pioneers.fire_brick_firebox.desc: Bottom layer of an automatic foundry: bellows plug into it, a hopper feeds it coal.
block.pioneers.foundry_vat.desc: The bath of an automatic foundry, above the fireboxes: it glows when the metal melts. Hoppers and cables feed it metal, casting channels connect to it.
block.pioneers.casting_channel.desc: Refractory trough: connects to an automatic foundry vat and to other channels; above an automatic mold, its spout pours the metal in.
block.pioneers.auto_mold.desc: Under a casting channel spout: pick the shape (ingot, nugget, plate, rods, gear, anvil); the metal sets by itself, the part comes out underneath or on the sides. Never wears out.
gui.pioneers.auto_foundry.status.2: No fire: coal, charcoal or coke
gui.pioneers.auto_foundry.status.5: No mold at the end of the channels
gui.pioneers.auto_foundry.status.10: The filter is waiting for a metal
gui.pioneers.auto_foundry.chain_tip: The vat pours into the first free mold along the channels, then into the next one
gui.pioneers.auto_foundry.chain_tip2: Casting channels against the vat, an automatic mold under the spout
gui.pioneers.auto_foundry.auto_tip: With no alloy picked, it waits until everything has melted; a redstone signal also pauses pouring
gui.pioneers.auto_mold.busy: Mold busy: change the shape once it is empty
gui.pioneers.auto_mold.out: Part: comes out underneath or on the sides (hopper, cable)
advancements.pioneers.bronze.auto_foundr: Build an automatic foundry: a firebox with a vat on top.
advancements.pioneers.bronze.auto_cast.d: Let an automatic mold set a part poured through the channels.
casting.pioneers.anvil_mold.iron_only: The anvil mold only takes iron (10 ingots, 1,440 mB), not: %s.
advancements.pioneers.journey.root.title: The Journey
advancements.pioneers.journey.root.descr: The guide steps (H key), from the first fiber to the Space Simulator.
advancements.pioneers.journey.j_primitiv: Primitive Age · Step 1: wood, flint and fiber
Get: Plant Fiber.
Primitive Age · Step 2: the hand crank and the shaking sifter
Get: Shaking Sifter.
Primitive Age · Step 3: the toolmaker's bench and flint tools
Get: Flint Knife, Flint Pickaxe, Flint Axe or Flint Saw.
Primitive Age · Step 4: fire and charcoal
Get: Campfire.
Primitive Age · Step 5: stone and the furnace
Get: Stone Hammer or Stone Mortar.
Primitive Age · Step 6: finding metal
Get: Raw Copper, Raw Tin or Raw Iron.
Primitive Age · Step 7: carpenter and mason
Get: Mason's Bench.
Primitive Age · Step 8: clay: the potter and the kiln
Get: Ingot Mold or Clay Crucible.
Primitive Age · Step 9: the first cast
Pour metal into a mold.
Primitive Age · Step 10: forging your tools
Forge your first part at the anvil.
advancements.pioneers.journey.j_mechanic: Get: Iron Shaft or Iron Flywheel.
Mechanical Age · Step 3: the bellows and the wooden buffer
Mechanical Age · Step 4: millstone, crusher and saw
Get: Millstone, Jaw Crusher, Mechanical Saw or Mechanical Drill.
Mechanical Age · Step 5: water, ropes and wooden cables
Mechanical Age · Step 6: the beam engine
Get steam up in a beam engine.
advancements.pioneers.journey.j_bronze_0: Bronze and Steam Age · Step 1: coppersmith and mass casting
Get: Crucible Furnace or Casting Table.
Bronze and Steam Age · Step 2: alloys
Bronze and Steam Age · Step 3: the boiler
Raise 1,000 mB of steam in a boiler.
Bronze and Steam Age · Step 4: steam engine and bronze cable
Bronze and Steam Age · Step 5: the steam factory
Crush raw ore in the steam macerator: three crushed ores.
Bronze and Steam Age · Step 6: prospecting and drilling
Bronze and Steam Age · Step 7: the blast furnace and steel
Bronze and Steam Age · Step 8: ruins and resin: getting ready for industry
advancements.pioneers.journey.j_industri: Industrial Age (MKI) · Step 1: the wrench and the industrial benches
Get: Assembly Bench or Advanced Components Bench.
Industrial Age (MKI) · Step 2: the coke oven
Get: Coke.
Industrial Age (MKI) · Step 3: the vacuum tube circuit and the MKI machine hull
Get: Machine Hull MKI.
Industrial Age (MKI) · Step 4: your first power
Get: Compact Dynamo MKI or Compact Solid Combustion Generator MKI.
Industrial Age (MKI) · Step 5: iron at MKI: crusher, crucible and casting
Get: Compact Casting Machine MKI.
Industrial Age (MKI) · Step 6: the other workshop machines
Grind ore in the crusher (fine grinding).
Industrial Age (MKI) · Step 7: your first multiblock
Form your first industrial multiblock.
Industrial Age (MKI) · Step 8: the drill
Work a level 2 deposit with the drill.
Industrial Age (MKI) · Step 9: concentrating: flotation and tar
Get: Compact Ore Separator MKI.
Industrial Age (MKI) · Step 10: silver and components by machine
Get: Silver Ingot.
advancements.pioneers.journey.j_chemistr: Chemical Age (MKII) · Step 1: finding and pumping oil
Chemical Age (MKII) · Step 2: distilling and cracking
Chemical Age (MKII) · Step 4: the living world at scale
Chemical Age (MKII) · Step 5: aluminum, the MKII metal
Chemical Age (MKII) · Step 6: rubber and gaskets
Get: Voltaic Chestplate, Voltaic Drill, Hydrogen Jetpack or Flamethrower.
Get: Logic Integrated Circuit or Transistor Circuit.
Get: Aluminum Machine Frame or Industrial Casing MKII.
Atomic and Computing Age (MKIII) · Step 1: protection and uranium
Atomic and Computing Age (MKIII) · Step 2: stainless steel and titanium
Atomic and Computing Age (MKIII) · Step 3: processors and the MKIII circuit
Atomic and Computing Age (MKIII) · Step 4: computing
Atomic and Computing Age (MKIII) · Step 5: the three space milestones
Atomic and Computing Age (MKIII) · Step 6: compute and data centers
Bring a data center online: energy becomes computation.
Atomic and Computing Age (MKIII) · Step 7: research

advancements.pioneers.journey.j_space_02: Form a robotic assembly bay: four articulated arms build your units.
advancements.pioneers.journey.j_space_03: Space Age (MKIV) · Step 3: world after world to Pluto
advancements.pioneers.journey.j_space_04: Space Age (MKIV) · Step 4: lunar alloy and tier MKIV
advancements.pioneers.journey.j_space_05: Form a robotic assembly bay: four articulated arms build your units.
advancements.pioneers.journey.j_space_06: Space Age (MKIV) · Step 6: world after world to Pluto
advancements.pioneers.journey.j_endgame_: Endgame · Step 1: gravity compressor and stellar core
Get: empty simulated earth, empty simulated mars or empty simulated venus.
Endgame · Step 3: gas giants and neighboring stars
Get: Aerostat Kit or Drone Bay.
Endgame · Step 6: the Space Simulator and galaxies
tooltip.pioneers.raw_ore.crush: Crushed (crusher, jaw crusher, steam crusher): 2 crushed ores, so twice the metal
tooltip.pioneers.crushed_ore.doubles: Electric furnace: 1 ingot · electric crucible: ×1.5 (MKI) to ×3 (MKIV) · foundry: 144 mB
jei.pioneers.info.crush_doubles: Crushing doubles the metal: one raw ore crushed (jaw crusher, steam crusher, crusher) gives 2 crushed ores; each melts into 144 mB in the clay crucible, the crucible furnace and the foundry, and smelts into one ingot in the electric furnace; in the primitive blast furnace it counts as one ore.
jei.pioneers.info.crush_doubles.mk1: In the electric crucible, ore (raw or crushed) yields ×1.5 at MKI, ×2, ×2.5, ×3 at MKIV: 3 to 6 ingots per crushed ore; from MKII, acid leaching gives 5 to 7.
jei.pioneers.grinding.jaw.tip: Mechanical age: %s shaft turns per operation
jei.pioneers.grinding.steam.tip: Bronze age: %s s per operation, on steam
jei.pioneers.grinding.kit.tip: Compact MKI to MKIV and multiblock: same recipe at every tier, faster at higher tiers
jei.pioneers.ore_yields.tip1: Electric crucible: raw and crushed ore ×1.5 / ×2 / ×2.5 / ×3 from MKI to MKIV (the multiblock at the same tier)
jei.pioneers.ore_yields.tip2: Ingots, dusts, nuggets: ×1; a fragment always melts into 36 mB
jei.pioneers.ore_yields.tip3: Clay crucible, crucible furnace, automatic foundry: ×1 everywhere
jei.pioneers.ore_yields.tip_mb: An ingot of molten metal is 144 mB, a nugget 16 mB
jei.pioneers.melt.group.ore.tip: Raw ore, crushed ore, fragment, raw ore block: ×1 here (the electric crucible multiplies: ×1.5 to ×3)
jei.pioneers.melt.group.metal.tip: Ingot, nugget, dust, block: their value (×1)
jei.pioneers.melt.group.recycle.tip: A metal part gives back 50 % of its value when melted (a plate cast from 144 mB gives 72 mB)
jei.pioneers.melt.air_tip: %s °C without air, up to +%s °C at full air (bellows); fuel: charcoal +30, coal +60, coke +100
jei.pioneers.alloys.molten_tip: Crucible furnace, automatic foundry, clay crucible, electric crucible (alloy selector) and steam alloy smelter: the ingots melt together in these proportions
jei.pioneers.alloys.no_powder_tip: A base alloy is never made by mixing dusts: only from molten metal
jei.pioneers.industry.tier_yield.tip: Yield by machine tier (compact or multiblock)
item.pioneers.extrusion_shape_rod.desc: Extruder: ingot → 2 rods (3 at MKII), billet → 18 rods. Comes back 98% of the time.
item.pioneers.extrusion_shape_pipe.desc: Extruder: rod → tube. Comes back 98% of the time.
jei.pioneers.parts.hand_only: Bench metals: iron, copper, bronze, tin, brass, zinc, lead, gold, solder, steel
jei.pioneers.parts.machine_only: This metal is worked in machines only
description.pioneers.advanced_gas_turbin: Burns combustible gases (natural gas, methane, propane, butane, hydrogen, biogas, syngas, wood gas…) → energy.
description.pioneers.advanced_liquid_com: Burns liquid fuels (diesel, gasoline, kerosene, ethanol, methanol, oils, creosote…) → energy.
description.pioneers.basic_gas_turbine: Burns combustible gases (natural gas, methane, propane, butane, hydrogen, biogas, syngas, wood gas…) → energy.
description.pioneers.basic_liquid_combus: Burns liquid fuels (diesel, gasoline, kerosene, ethanol, methanol, oils, creosote…) → energy.
description.pioneers.elite_gas_turbine: Burns combustible gases (natural gas, methane, propane, butane, hydrogen, biogas, syngas, wood gas…) → energy.
description.pioneers.elite_liquid_combus: Burns liquid fuels (diesel, gasoline, kerosene, ethanol, methanol, oils, creosote…) → energy.
description.pioneers.industrial_liquid_c: Burns liquid fuels (diesel, gasoline, kerosene, ethanol, methanol, oils, creosote…) → energy. 5 × 3 × 2 structure (sheet metal). Thermal cladding. Shift + right-click for the blueprint.
description.pioneers.ultimate_gas_turbin: Burns combustible gases (natural gas, methane, propane, butane, hydrogen, biogas, syngas, wood gas…) → energy.
description.pioneers.ultimate_liquid_com: Burns liquid fuels (diesel, gasoline, kerosene, ethanol, methanol, oils, creosote…) → energy.
jei.pioneers.metal_melting.clay_tip: Clay crucible: %s mB at most, on a campfire (+ charcoal, hand bellows beyond)
jei.pioneers.metal_melting.electric_tip: Compact MKI to MKIV and multiblock: ore gives more at higher tiers (details on each item)
jei.pioneers.metal_melting.item_fire: Fire stations (clay crucible, crucible furnace, foundry): %s mB
jei.pioneers.metal_melting.item_no_fire: Fire stations: no (electric crucible only; %s mB at MKI ×1)
jei.pioneers.casting_all.table_tip: Casting table (crucible furnace) or automatic mold (foundry, casting channels)
jei.pioneers.casting_all.tongs_tip: Mold placed on the ground, filled with the tongs from the clay crucible (%s mB per pour; the anvil mold in several pours)
jei.pioneers.alloys.title: Alloy: %s
jei.pioneers.alloys.ore_value: 1 raw or crushed ore = 1 ingot (144 mB)
jei.pioneers.alloys.ore_value2: at the fire stations: melted together
jei.pioneers.alloys.molten_tip2: The metals melt in the SAME bath: the forge pours the largest share of alloy at these proportions (middle of the ranges); the surplus stays and pours afterwards
jei.pioneers.alloys.how.furnace: Crucible furnace: pick “%s” in the selector (filter: it only takes what it needs, the rest waits in its slot), then pour in %s (ingots, ores, dusts); cast on the casting table
jei.pioneers.alloys.how.foundry: Automatic foundry: pick “%s” in the selector (filter), load %s; cast in the automatic mold
jei.pioneers.alloys.how.clay: Clay crucible (%s mB): small batch, e.g. %s (a nugget too many: the surplus is poured separately)
jei.pioneers.alloys.how.machine: Machine: %s ingots, %s (ingots only: cast the molten ore first)
jei.pioneers.alloys.gas_tip: One of the machines needs argon (shielding gas): see its tooltip
steam.pioneers.cutoff.set: Cutoff: shuts down below %s water, restarts at %s
steam.pioneers.cutoff.info_tripped: SHUT DOWN: water at %s, below %s · add water
steam.pioneers.cutoff.no_boiler: Place the cutoff on a formed boiler
steam.pioneers.cutoff.tripped: Low-water cutoff: water below %s, firebox shut down

Right-click with a dish: it goes to the spot you aim at; empty hand: take it back.

jei.pioneers.processes.title: Process: %s
jei.pioneers.processes.routes_tip: One line per route: start → steps → product. Hover a machine: process, reagents, byproducts. Amounts are in the recipes (R / U).

jei.pioneers.processes.first: First route: the test that opens the tier
jei.pioneers.processes.recipe_hint: Click the machine (R / U) for the recipe
process.pioneers.route.aluminium.bayer_s: Bayer and molten salt electrolysis (first route)
huge energy, anodes to remake, red mud
process.pioneers.route.aluminium.scrap_r: 5% of the primary route’s energy, two machines
depends on ruins and offcuts: no first aluminum
process.pioneers.route.aluminium.prebake: Prebaked anodes, red mud and recycled cryolite
more metal per alumina, twice as fast; iron from the red mud, recycled cryolite
multiblocks and fluorine handling, petroleum coke
process.pioneers.route.titanium.kroll.na: Kroll in a sealed retort (first route)
process.pioneers.route.titanium.kroll.pl: the first titanium: the test that opens MKIII
process.pioneers.route.titanium.refusion: simple, chlorine-free; bales melt at 95% and twice as fast
depends on offcuts and ruin scrap
process.pioneers.route.titanium.oxide_el: Titanium slag and direct oxide electrolysis
four steps, no chlorine or magnesium, more metal per ore than Kroll
commercial (impure) titanium: not pure enough for the aluminide, nitinol or niobium-titanium
process.pioneers.route.titanium.aeronaut: Chlorinated slag in a fluidized bed, magnesium-chlorine loop
twice as much titanium per ore, pig iron as a coproduct, magnesium and chlorine recycled
process.pioneers.route.zirconium.fused_z: Fused zirconia in the arc furnace
storable refractory in four steps (slurry for shell molds); also chlorinates in the Kroll route, faster than the concentrate
process.pioneers.route.zirconium.kroll_c: Chlorination and Kroll of the crude tetrachloride
hafnium included: less zirconium per tetrachloride, no hafnium oxide
process.pioneers.route.zirconium.hafnium: nuclear-grade zirconium (zircaloy) and hafnium oxide for MOSFETs
process.pioneers.route.tungsten.apt_sint: the first tungsten: the test that opens MKIV
process.pioneers.route.tungsten.carbide_: 80% of the carbide in cutting tools, no chemistry
depends on worn tools; carbide only (no tungsten metal)
process.pioneers.route.tungsten.plasma.p: four steps instead of ten, without APT chemistry
process.pioneers.route.tungsten.plasma.m: huge electricity, coarse powder (sintered without pressing)
process.pioneers.route.tungsten.hip.name: Ultrapure paratungstate and hot isostatic pressing
process.pioneers.route.tungsten.hip.plus: more tungsten per ore (solvent extraction, crystallization), dense ingot, fast
process.pioneers.route.platinum.sponge.m: impure platinum; only half of the PGM residue comes out
process.pioneers.route.platinum.pgm_sepa: platinum, osmium and iridium from one stream; half again as much platinum per solution
Alkaline fusion and tetroxide distillation in a hot cell
toxic tetroxide: hot cell; half of the residue
process.pioneers.route.osmium.ion_exchan: twice as much osmium and iridium per residue
resins (solvent) to regenerate, two liquors, hot cell
process.pioneers.route.chrome.electrolyt: twice as much chromium per concentrate; 99.9%: superalloys, chrome plating
process.pioneers.route.silicon.metallurg: Metallurgical silicon in the arc furnace
process.pioneers.route.silicon.siemens.p: polysilicon for solar cells and Gen 2 chips
process.pioneers.route.silicon.zone_refi: Chlorine-free metallurgical route: leaching and float zone
polysilicon without chlorine or hydrogen, more polysilicon per silicon than Siemens deposition
slow (float zone passes), small rods, hydrofluoric acid
process.pioneers.route.iron.melt_cast.pl: 3 ingots per ore at MKI (crucible ×1.5), then 4 / 5 / 6 at MKII / MKIII / MKIV, three MKI machines from the very first power
process.pioneers.route.iron.melt_cast.mi: neither pig iron nor steel: steel goes through pig iron (see steel)
process.pioneers.route.iron.acid_leach.p: one ingot more than the crucible at the same tier: 5 / 6 / 7 ingots per ore at MKII / MKIII / MKIV
process.pioneers.route.iron.acid_leach.m: sulfuric acid (250 mB per crushed ore), electricity; no byproduct
process.pioneers.route.iron.blast_furnac: twice as much iron; blast furnace gas heats the stove; slag for cement
multiblocks (blast furnace, stove, converter), constant coke
process.pioneers.route.iron.direct_reduc: Reverse flotation and direct reduction with syngas
two and a half times as much iron, no coke; sponge iron opens direct steel in the arc furnace
process.pioneers.route.steel.induction.n: Crucible pig iron and blast furnace
process.pioneers.route.steel.induction.p: pig iron from the crucible, no pelletized ore
process.pioneers.route.steel.induction.m: small batches of pig iron (coke and lime), blast furnace multiblock for the steel
process.pioneers.route.steel.thomas.name: Blast furnace: pig iron refined with hot blast
process.pioneers.route.steel.thomas.minu: two passes through the blast furnace; phosphorous steel, no special steel
process.pioneers.route.steel.arc_scrap.m: coke, scrap to sort and compact, two passes through the blast furnace
process.pioneers.route.steel.oxygen_cast: Oxygen blast furnace, ladle metallurgy and continuous casting
vanadium steel (plain steel comes from the blast furnace), direct slabs and billets
oxygen from the air separation unit, long chain
3 ingots per ore at MKI (crucible ×1.5), then 4 / 5 / 6 at MKII / MKIII / MKIV, three MKI machines from the very first power
process.pioneers.route.copper.acid_leach: one ingot more than the crucible at the same tier: 5 / 6 / 7 ingots per ore at MKII / MKIII / MKIV
sulfuric acid (250 mB per crushed ore), electricity; no byproduct
process.pioneers.route.copper.black_copp: half the copper, sulfur dioxide to handle; impure copper (electrorefine it for fine wire and electronics)
process.pioneers.route.copper.matte_elec: cathode copper for all electricity; sulfuric acid; anode slime (gold, silver, PGMs)
process.pioneers.route.copper.leach_sx_e: Tailings leaching, solvent extraction and electrowinning
puts every route’s tailings to use, no sulfur dioxide
process.pioneers.route.tin.melt_cast.plu: 3 ingots per ore at MKI (crucible ×1.5), then 4 / 5 / 6 at MKII / MKIII / MKIV, three MKI machines from the very first power
process.pioneers.route.tin.acid_leach.pl: one ingot more than the crucible at the same tier: 5 / 6 / 7 ingots per ore at MKII / MKIII / MKIV
process.pioneers.route.tin.acid_leach.mi: sulfuric acid (250 mB per crushed ore), electricity; no byproduct
process.pioneers.route.tin.cassiterite.n: Gravity tabling, roasting, reduction and liquation
process.pioneers.route.tin.cassiterite.p: tin for solder and tinning; niobium from the heavy sands
process.pioneers.route.lead.melt_cast.pl: 3 ingots per ore at MKI (crucible ×1.5), then 4 / 5 / 6 at MKII / MKIII / MKIV, three MKI machines from the very first power
process.pioneers.route.lead.melt_cast.mi: no silver or byproduct: plain lead and zinc
process.pioneers.route.lead.acid_leach.p: one ingot more than the crucible at the same tier: 5 / 6 / 7 ingots per ore at MKII / MKIII / MKIV
process.pioneers.route.lead.acid_leach.m: sulfuric acid (250 mB per crushed ore), electricity; no byproduct
process.pioneers.route.lead.argentiferou: Galena roasted and reduced with coke
zinc flies off, silver stays in the lead (impure)
process.pioneers.route.lead.imperial_sme: Bulk flotation, shaft furnace and zinc condensation
lead and zinc from the same charge
impure zinc and base bullion, two ores to blend
process.pioneers.route.lead.electrolytic: Selective flotation, electrolytic zinc and lead desilvering
pure zinc (galvanizing, brass), silver, soft lead
process.pioneers.route.gold.melt_cast.pl: 3 ingots per ore at MKI (crucible ×1.5), then 4 / 5 / 6 at MKII / MKIII / MKIV, three MKI machines from the very first power
process.pioneers.route.gold.acid_leach.p: one ingot more than the crucible at the same tier: 5 / 6 / 7 ingots per ore at MKII / MKIII / MKIV
process.pioneers.route.gold.acid_leach.m: sulfuric acid (250 mB per crushed ore), electricity; no byproduct
process.pioneers.route.gold.gravity.name: Gravity separation on the ore separator
process.pioneers.route.gold.amalgam.name: Mercury amalgamation and distillation
process.pioneers.route.gold.amalgam.minu: 10% of the mercury lost each cycle (mercury drawn from roasting gases)
Refining anode slime with aqua regia
pure gold, silver and a PGM solution, without gold ore
depends on the complex copper route; aqua regia
process.pioneers.route.nickel.ferronicke: Pentlandite roasted and smelted in the arc furnace
a ferroalloy: stainless steel and invar yes, pure nickel no
process.pioneers.route.nickel.pressure_l: Pressure leaching, solvent extraction and carbonyl
nickel and cobalt separated, very pure; PGMs
carbon monoxide, autoclave, solvent and hydrogen
process.pioneers.route.vanadium.metavana: pentoxide: catalysts, flow cells; lead recovered
process.pioneers.route.vanadium.aluminot: vanadium metal: fusion first wall, titanium alloys
process.pioneers.route.magnesium.pidgeon: Magnesia and ferrosilicon under vacuum (Pidgeon process)
slow, ferrosilicon consumed, one magnesia for half an ingot
process.pioneers.route.magnesium.chlorid: Dehydrated bischofite and molten chloride electrolysis
chlorine given back (Kroll, chemistry); titanium-magnesium loop: Kroll chloride goes back to the cell
process.pioneers.route.niobium.ferroniob: fast ferroalloy, then dissolved in hydrofluoric acid for niobium
process.pioneers.route.niobium.hf_attack: Hydrofluoric attack, solvent extraction and aluminothermy
hydrofluoric acid, fluorinated raffinate to recycle
process.pioneers.route.niobium.electron_: Pressure attack, recycled fluorides and electron beam
half again as much niobium per concentrate, fluorine recycled, superconducting niobium (electron beam melting)
process.pioneers.route.stainless_steel.i: Ferrochrome, ferronickel and scrap in the induction furnace
process.pioneers.route.stainless_steel.a: common stainless steel in volume; chromium from the slag recovered with ferrosilicon
oxygen to produce, chromium lost in the slag
low-carbon stainless steel (nuclear, cryogenics), pure; little chromium in the slag
process.pioneers.route.astre.simple.name: Grinding and hydrogen reduction (world pattern, simple route)
process.pioneers.route.astre.simple.minu: yields little (two dusts per ingot), worthless slag, hungry reduction
process.pioneers.route.astre.exotic.name: Exotic archetype: the world’s signature step
process.pioneers.route.astre.exotic.plus: two and a half ingots per ore; a material of its own
process.pioneers.route.astre.exotic.minu: a block of the world to bring back, hot cell and fired heater for the active residues
process.pioneers.route.astre.oxide.name: Oxide archetype: optical sorting, coke reduction and arc furnace refining
process.pioneers.route.astre.oxide.plus: two ingots per ore; the world’s byproduct at sorting
process.pioneers.route.astre.oxide.minus: coke, electrodes and argon; hungry reduction
process.pioneers.route.astre.sulfide.nam: Sulfide archetype: flotation, sulfating roast, electrolysis and remelting
process.pioneers.route.astre.sulfide.plu: two ingots per ore, sulfur and acid, precious metal at the cell

description.pioneers.firebox_basic: Building block for heated multiblocks (MKI): steel grate, fireclay refractory lining, large grate in front of the embers on all four sides; neighboring fireboxes form a single grate.
description.pioneers.heating_coil_basic: Building block for electric furnaces (MKI): annealed iron wire on porcelain combs, always vertical (terminals on top and bottom); neighboring coils form a single winding.
description.pioneers.firebox_advanced: Building block for heated multiblocks (MKII): vanadium steel grate, alumina lining, large grate in front of the embers on all four sides; neighboring fireboxes form a single grate.
description.pioneers.heating_coil_advanc: Building block for electric furnaces (MKII): platinum wire on alumina combs, always vertical (terminals on top and bottom); neighboring coils form a single winding.
description.pioneers.firebox_elite: Building block for heated multiblocks (MKIII): stainless steel grate, zirconia lining, large grate in front of the embers on all four sides; neighboring fireboxes form a single grate.
description.pioneers.heating_coil_elite: Building block for electric furnaces (MKIII): nichrome elements and wire on zirconia combs, always vertical (terminals on top and bottom); neighboring coils form a single winding.
description.pioneers.firebox_ultimate: Building block for heated multiblocks (MKIV): tungsten grate, ceramic composite lining, large grate in front of the embers on all four sides; neighboring fireboxes form a single grate.
description.pioneers.heating_coil_ultima: Building block for electric furnaces (MKIV): tungsten elements and wire on ceramic composite panels, always vertical (terminals on top and bottom); neighboring coils form a single winding.
description.pioneers.cleanroom_casing: Cleanroom, Chemical Age. Smooth white sandwich panel: PVC laminate, foam core, aluminum sheet. Neighboring panels form a seamless wall.
description.pioneers.cleanroom_glass: Cleanroom, Chemical Age. Borosilicate glass on an airtight gasket, aluminum frame. Neighboring panes form a single window.
description.pioneers.cleanroom_filter: Cleanroom, Chemical Age. Fan filter unit: fan, prefilter and glass fiber filter media, perforated diffuser and LED strips. Goes on the ceiling; it lights the room.
description.pioneers.turbine_rotor_basic: Stackable building block (MKI): shaft and a stage of pitched blades; on its own it has its bearing and coupling. Stacked, rotors form a single shaft (bearing at the bottom, coupling at the top). Material: steel blades. Only joins identical blocks.
description.pioneers.turbine_rotor_advan: Stackable building block (MKII): shaft and a stage of pitched blades; on its own it has its bearing and coupling. Stacked, rotors form a single shaft (bearing at the bottom, coupling at the top). Material: aluminum blades. Only joins identical blocks.
description.pioneers.turbine_rotor_elite: Stackable building block (MKIII): shaft and a stage of pitched blades; on its own it has its bearing and coupling. Stacked, rotors form a single shaft (bearing at the bottom, coupling at the top). Material: titanium blades. Only joins identical blocks.
description.pioneers.turbine_rotor_ultim: Stackable building block (MKIV): shaft and a stage of pitched blades; on its own it has its bearing and coupling. Stacked, rotors form a single shaft (bearing at the bottom, coupling at the top). Material: superalloy blades. Only joins identical blocks.
description.pioneers.drill_string_basic: Stackable building block (MKI): drill pipe and auger flight; on its own it has its bit and chuck. Stacked, sections form a single string (bit at the bottom, chuck at the top, continuous flight). Material: steel rods. Only joins identical blocks.
description.pioneers.drill_string_advanc: Stackable building block (MKII): drill pipe and auger flight; on its own it has its bit and chuck. Stacked, sections form a single string (bit at the bottom, chuck at the top, continuous flight). Material: diamond-set head. Only joins identical blocks.
description.pioneers.drill_string_elite: Stackable building block (MKIII): drill pipe and auger flight; on its own it has its bit and chuck. Stacked, sections form a single string (bit at the bottom, chuck at the top, continuous flight). Material: boron carbide teeth. Only joins identical blocks.
description.pioneers.drill_string_ultima: Stackable building block (MKIV): drill pipe and auger flight; on its own it has its bit and chuck. description.pioneers.column_pump_basic: Stackable building block (MKI): multistage pump stage, flanges and tie rods; on its own it has its strainer and discharge head. Stacked, stages form a single column (strainer at the bottom, gauge head at the top). Material: cast iron centrifugal pump. Only joins identical blocks.
description.pioneers.column_pump_advance: Stackable building block (MKII): multistage pump stage, flanges and tie rods; on its own it has its strainer and discharge head. Stacked, stages form a single column (strainer at the bottom, gauge head at the top). Material: aluminum pump. Only joins identical blocks.
description.pioneers.column_pump_elite: Stackable building block (MKIII): multistage pump stage, flanges and tie rods; on its own it has its strainer and discharge head. Stacked, stages form a single column (strainer at the bottom, gauge head at the top). Material: titanium pump. Only joins identical blocks.
description.pioneers.column_pump_ultimat: Stackable building block (MKIV): multistage pump stage, flanges and tie rods; on its own it has its strainer and discharge head. description.pioneers.exhaust_stack: Vents turbine exhaust steam and surplus steam to the air, with no energy and no water returned (half as fast as the cooling tower). 3 × 15 × 3 structure (frames, sheet metal). Thermal cladding. Shift + right-click for the blueprint.
description.pioneers.item_silo: Stores a single item in bulk, in very large amounts (inner volume × tier); the contents stay in the broken controller. 5 × 11 × 5 structure (frames, sheet metal). Fluids and chemistry cladding. Shift + right-click for the blueprint.
description.pioneers.industrial_pyrolysi: Heats without air: biochar, tar, wood vinegar, bio-oil, gas; recycles plastics and rubber. 3 × 4 × 5 structure (firebox walls, heating coils). Thermal cladding. Shift + right-click for the blueprint.
description.pioneers.tree_plantation: Saplings + water → logs, saplings, fruit, resin and latex. 7 × 8 × 7 structure (industrial glass, hydroponic substrate). Living cladding. Shift + right-click for the blueprint.
description.pioneers.drill_string_bronze: Stackable building block (Bronze Age): drill pipe and auger flight; on its own it has its bit and chuck. Stacked, sections form a single string (bit at the bottom, chuck at the top, continuous flight). Material: bronze rods, hardened iron teeth; the core of the steam drill. Only joins identical blocks.

description.pioneers.ai_lab: Trains AI chips: a chip, data (data cables) and compute (compute network) make a stronger model. Blank chip → expert system (5,000 MB, 20,000 GOPS·s); → neural network (20,000 MB including 5,000 of telemetry, 200,000 GOPS·s); → foundation model (100,000 MB, 2,000,000 GOPS·s and 2,000 QOPS·s). 256 FE/t while training.
description.pioneers.factory_ai_core: An AI that oversees the factory: put a neural network or a foundation model in it, then link machines to it with the configurator. It gives its bonus to linked multiblocks (−20% / −30% energy, +20% / +40% speed), runs linked reactors on its own (rods, preventive shutdown; fusion: heating cut before a disruption) and talks to you in chat and on linked supervision screens. 16 / 64 links; 512 / 2,048 FE/t.
item.pioneers.neural_chip_blank.desc: A blank neural chip. In the AI lab, with data and compute, it becomes an expert system.
item.pioneers.ai_model_expert.desc: Level 1 AI model. Right-click a multiblock controller: −10% energy. Improves further in the AI lab.
item.pioneers.ai_model_neural.desc: Level 2 AI model. In a controller: −20% energy, +20% speed; runs a factory AI core (16 links).
item.pioneers.ai_model_foundation.desc: Level 3 AI model, the strongest. In a controller: −30% energy, +40% speed; factory AI core: 64 links.

description.pioneers.aquarium: Thick glass in a blackened steel frame. Neighboring aquariums form a single tank. Water bucket: fills the lowest empty cell; fish bucket, or a raw fish in hand: it joins the tank if there is room (16 spaces per water cell; a fish takes one space per 12.5 cm: tropical fish 1, cod or salmon 6, tuna 18; the tank must contain water); crustacean bucket: it sinks to the bottom (2 per cell); empty bucket: takes back a dweller, otherwise water. A new aquarium only holds water: Shift + right-click (sneaking, whatever you hold) opens the bottom layout (floor, plants, decor: 4 spots per bottom cell, one item per element, returned when removed) and the tank’s status. Gray reef shark: a tank of at least 18 water cells.

party.pioneers.title: Guide party
party.pioneers.intro: A party shares Journey progress: a step done by one member counts for everyone. On joining, progress is merged; on leaving, everyone keeps what they have. Unrelated to clans.
party.pioneers.alone: You play alone: invite an online player to form a party. They accept from their guide (H → Party) or with /party accept.
party.pioneers.together: You progress together: each Journey step done by one of you is checked for all, even for an absent member (when they log in).

gui.pioneers.warehouse.still.tip: The rope is not turning: no parcel moves
warehouse.pioneers.counter.place_hint: Counter: place a small pulley above it (up to %s blocks higher) and tie it to the line
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.ok.detail: Linked: %s crate(s) in sight, %s pulley(s) in the network; the rope is turning.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.ok.fix: Nothing to do: click an item in the stock to put it in the cart.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.still.detail: The crates are in sight, but the counter’s small pulley (%s) is not turning: no parcel leaves.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.still.fix: Turn the line (windmill, crank, engine…): parcels move at the speed of the rope.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.no_pulley.de: No small pulley above the counter (up to 8 empty blocks).
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.no_pulley.fi: Place a SMALL pulley with a vertical axis right above the counter, or in its column up to 8 blocks higher (Shift + click the top of the counter, pulley in hand: it goes to the height of the line), then tie it to the line with a rope.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.big_pulley.d: The pulley at %s is not a small pulley: it only relays.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.big_pulley.f: Replace it with a small pulley with a vertical axis: only the small pulley serves a counter or a crate.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.horizontal.d: The pulley at %s has a horizontal axis: parcels can’t follow it.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.horizontal.f: Place the small pulley again with a vertical axis (like a standing shaft) above the counter.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.column.detai: The block at %s blocks the drop between the pulley (%s) and the counter.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.column.fix: Remove this block: the column between the pulley and the counter must stay empty (air, no fluid).
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.too_high.det: The small pulley at %s is %s blocks above the counter: %s at most.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.too_high.fix: Lower the pulley (and the whole line with it), or raise the counter on a block.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.no_rope.deta: The counter’s small pulley (%s) has no rope.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.no_rope.fix: Tie it to a pulley of the line with a rope: click this pulley, then the other one, rope in hand.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.rope_blocked: Rope %s → %s: a parcel hanging under the rope would hit the block at %s.
Remove this block, or raise the line by one block (shaft or post under the pulleys): a parcel hangs a good half block under the rope.
Under the pulley at %s, a parcel would hit the block at %s.
Clear around the wheel: nothing solid within half a block under the rope, except the pulley’s own shaft.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.one_way.deta: The rope %s → %s is only known from one end.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.one_way.fix: Break this rope and tie it again.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.unformed.det: The crate of the hatch at %s is not formed.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.unformed.fix: Complete it: 3 × 3 cross-section, 3, 5 or 7 blocks long, frames on the edges, panels or ports on the faces, hatch in the middle of the top (Shift + right-click the hatch: the blueprint).
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.off_hatch.de: The pulley at %s is above the crate (block at %s), but not above its hatch.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.off_hatch.fi: Move the small pulley right above the HATCH (the block in the middle of the crate’s top).
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.no_crate.det: The network (%s pulley(s)) leads to no crate.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.no_crate.fix: Place a small pulley on the hatch of a formed crate and tie it to the line with a rope.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.loading.deta: Part of the line is in a chunk that is not loaded yet.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.diag.loading.fix: Come closer to the line: the network completes itself.

description.pioneers.iron_greenhouse_fra: Opaque post or corner of a greenhouse (placed along the axis you choose). Counts as wall.
description.pioneers.iron_greenhouse_ven: Glazed ventilation hatch: open or closed, it counts as greenhouse wall.
description.pioneers.greenhouse_regulato: Greenhouse controller: set in a wall, it surveys the room. A greenhouse closed with greenhouse blocks (doors allowed), 8 to 4,096 air blocks: ideal climate all year. Shift + right-click: the fault plan.
gui.pioneers.greenhouse.error.leak: The greenhouse leaks: plug the hole (wall, roof or floor)
gui.pioneers.greenhouse.error.wrong_bloc: A wall or roof block is not a greenhouse block
gui.pioneers.greenhouse.error.too_small: Greenhouse too small: at least 8 air blocks
gui.pioneers.greenhouse.error.too_big: Greenhouse too big (at most 4,096 air blocks, 32 × 32 × 16), or open onto a cave
gui.pioneers.greenhouse.error.no_room: Set the regulator in a wall, one side facing the inside
gui.pioneers.greenhouse.error.shared: This greenhouse already has a regulator
gui.pioneers.greenhouse.error.unloaded: Part of the greenhouse is not loaded
gui.pioneers.greenhouse.title: Greenhouse
card.pioneers.greenhouse.hint_plan: Shift + right-click: the plan shows the fault
message.pioneers.greenhouse.update.title: [Pioneer’s 1.0.5] Greenhouses have changed
message.pioneers.greenhouse.update: Glass above crops no longer makes a greenhouse. Build a closed room of greenhouse blocks (panes, frames, vents, doors) with a greenhouse regulator in a wall: guide, “Building a greenhouse”. Until then, your crops follow the outside climate: out of season, they have a whole day before withering.
jei.pioneers.info.greenhouse: Greenhouse: a closed room whose walls and roof are greenhouse blocks (panes, frames, vents open or closed; any door is allowed), on a solid floor. 8 to 4,096 air blocks, at most 32 × 32 × 16. The regulator, set in a wall, surveys it: inside, ideal climate for every crop in every season. Shift + right-click: the plan shows the leak or the faulty blocks.

pet.pioneers.breed.german_shepherd.desc: Working dog: keen nose, strong and fast.
pet.pioneers.breed.labrador.desc: The hunting companion: reliable nose, even temper.
pet.pioneers.breed.husky.desc: Sled dog: does not mind the cold.
pet.pioneers.breed.beagle.desc: Scent hound: the best nose, small and stubborn.
pet.pioneers.breed.saint_bernard.desc: Mountain dog: massive, the strongest, at home in snow.
pet.pioneers.breed.braque.desc: Pointing dog: fine nose, great runner.
pet.pioneers.breed.dachshund.desc: Burrow dog: short legs, excellent nose.
pet.pioneers.breed.european_tabby.desc: The farm cat: good hunter, resourceful.
pet.pioneers.breed.siamese.desc: Talkative and close to its owner.
pet.pioneers.breed.persian.desc: Long fur, the temper of a cushion.
pet.pioneers.breed.maine_coon.desc: The giant among cats: likes water, formidable hunter.
pet.pioneers.breed.chartreux.desc: Blue-gray coat: the best rat hunter.
pet.pioneers.breed.norwegian.desc: Forest cat: thick fur, very independent.
pet.pioneers.breed.wild.desc: Shaggy mongrel. Once tamed, it becomes a dog of a random breed.
description.pioneers.dog_kennel: A dog’s home. Right-click with your dog on a lead: it is linked and lives on its own in a 30-block territory around it (sleeps in front of its kennel, guards livestock, comes to see you).
description.pioneers.cat_basket: A cat’s basket. Right-click with your cat on a lead: it is linked and lives on its own around it (sleeps curled up in it, hunts rats, brings fish back into the basket’s 3 slots). Right-click with an empty hand: take the fish.
pet.pioneers.mode.autonomous.tip: Lives around its kennel or basket (30 blocks): sleeps, guards, comes to see you.
pet.pioneers.mode.follow.tip: Follows you everywhere and catches up in a leap when left behind.
pet.pioneers.mode.hunt.tip: Tracks the nearest game within reach of its nose and guides you to it (waits for you, barks toward the animal).
pet.pioneers.gui.no_master: none (name it with a name tag)
pet.pioneers.gui.read_only: Only its owner can give it orders.
pet.pioneers.gui.link_kennel.tip: The nearest kennel (16 blocks) becomes its home: Autonomous mode.
pet.pioneers.gui.link_basket.tip: The nearest basket (16 blocks) becomes its home: Autonomous mode.
pet.pioneers.gui.mount_hint: Name it with a name tag to become its owner: Recall key, safe from other players.
pet.pioneers.gui.adopt.tip: The next player who renames it with a name tag becomes its owner (the box unticks).
pet.pioneers.gui.adopt.need_master: It needs an owner first: name it with a name tag.
pet.pioneers.card.hint: Shift + right-click, empty hand: its interface
pet.pioneers.msg.master: You are now the owner of %s.
pet.pioneers.msg.adopted: You adopted %s: you are its new owner.
pet.pioneers.msg.has_master: This animal already has an owner: %s.
pet.pioneers.msg.not_owner: Only the one who tamed it can name it.
pet.pioneers.msg.kennel_hint: Bring your dog on a lead and right-click the kennel.
pet.pioneers.msg.basket_hint: Bring your cat on a lead and right-click the basket.
pet.pioneers.msg.home_lost: %s has no home anymore: it follows you.
pet.pioneers.msg.need_home: Link it to a kennel or a basket first.
pet.pioneers.recall.release_all: Middle: cancel · short press: recall all
pet.pioneers.recall.done_wait: Recall: %s arrived, %s on the way (distant terrain loading).
pet.pioneers.recall.lost: Could not find %s at its last known place.
pet.pioneers.recall.caravan: %s is part of a caravan: not recalled.
jei.pioneers.info.pet_home: Kennel (dog) and basket (cat): bring your animal on a lead and right-click the block (or “Link” in its interface, Shift + right-click with an empty hand). It then lives on its own in a 30-block territory: it sleeps at its place at night, the dog guards livestock and barks at monsters, the cat hunts rats and brings fish back into the basket (3 slots; right-click with an empty hand or a hopper to take them).
wild.pioneers.boar.desc: Usually flees, but charges if you come within 4 blocks or wound it.
wild.pioneers.deer.desc: Lives in herds of 3 to 6 and flees very fast, in leaps. The stag sheds its antlers in winter; they grow back in spring.
wild.pioneers.turkey.desc: Lives in groups of 3 to 6; in spring, the tom fans its tail and struts before the hens.
wild.pioneers.hare.desc: Bigger than a rabbit, with long ears; very fast, it zigzags as it flees. White in winter (always in the snow).
wild.pioneers.bison.desc: Herds of 4 to 10. Peaceful, but the whole herd defends itself if one of them is attacked.
description.pioneers.deer_antler: Shed in late autumn and winter, or taken from a stag.
wild.pioneers.card.antlers_shed: Antlers shed (they grow back in spring)
wild.pioneers.card.hint: Game: wild, it flees hunters. Can be fed and bred like livestock.
jei.pioneers.prod.game.title: Game: %s
jei.pioneers.prod.game.antler: A stag wearing its antlers drops one or two; at shedding time (late autumn, winter) an antler may lie on the ground.
wild.pioneers.gray_wolf.desc: Hunts in packs of 3 to 5: livestock at night, and lone players. Fears fire: a torch or lantern in hand keeps it at bay.
wild.pioneers.bear.desc: Very dangerous: it charges anyone within 6 blocks, and the sow defends her cubs. Drawn to the mod’s apiaries, which it breaks (inside a claim it threatens without breaking). Active in winter.
wild.pioneers.woodpecker.desc: Clings to tree trunks and drums: you can hear it from far away. Fewer in winter.
wild.pioneers.rat.desc: Everywhere, mostly near buildings. Now and then it steals an item from an unprotected chest or barrel, and breeds near food stores. Counter it with a rat trap, a cat or a snake.
wild.pioneers.pigeon.desc: In flocks, drawn to buildings: it perches on rooftops and coos. Fewer in winter.
wild.pioneers.snake.desc: Hunts rats. Bites (mild poison) if you come within 2 blocks or attack it. Its coat depends on the biome.
wild.pioneers.card.predator: Predator: it attacks livestock at night and lone players. Hold a torch!
wild.pioneers.card.bear: Dangerous game: do not come within 6 blocks.
wild.pioneers.card.vermin: Vermin: rat trap, cat or snake.
wild.pioneers.card.bird: Wild bird: it flies off when approached.
wild.pioneers.card.snake: Venomous: bites if you come within 2 blocks.
wild.pioneers.bear.threat: A bear is prowling around your apiaries!
description.pioneers.rat_trap: Bait it (seeds, cheese): it lures rats within 8 blocks and catches the first one that touches the bait. One rat per bait: right-click to empty it, then re-arm it.
description.pioneers.bird_house: A house for wild birds (not to be confused with the hens’ nesting box). Hang it on a wall or set it on a post: it draws pigeons and woodpeckers, and now and then a feather falls below it.
wild.pioneers.trap.hint_bait: Right-click with seeds or cheese to set it.
wild.pioneers.trap.hint_armed: Lures rats within 8 blocks; catches the first one.
wild.pioneers.trap.hint_empty: Right-click to empty it, then set it again.
wild.pioneers.house.hint: Draws pigeons and woodpeckers; feathers fall below.
jei.pioneers.prod.wildlife.title: Wildlife: %s
jei.pioneers.prod.wildlife.feather: Now and then a feather falls below the bird house (more often when a bird is nearby).
jei.pioneers.prod.wildlife.trap_desc: Baited with seeds or cheese, it catches one rat at a time (the rat also drops whatever it had stolen).
wild.pioneers.giraffe.desc: Peaceful: it browses the tops of acacias, neck outstretched. Strike it and it kicks (mind the hooves), then runs off.
wild.pioneers.lion.desc: Lazy: lying down most of the time. It growls, then attacks if you linger within 6 blocks. The lioness hunts savanna game.
wild.pioneers.rhino.desc: Charges anything it sees within 8 blocks; very tough (armored hide), and its blow sends you flying.
wild.pioneers.elephant.desc: Family herds. It defends its calves; attack one and the whole herd charges. Gives only bones (no ivory).
wild.pioneers.monkey.desc: Climbs trees and picks bananas, peeling them and tossing the peel. It sometimes steals the banana in your hand (nothing else).
wild.pioneers.tiger.desc: Hunts players on sight: crouched in tall grass, it creeps closer, then pounces. It fears fire, like the wolf.
wild.pioneers.card.lion: Lazy: do not linger within 6 blocks, or it will attack.
wild.pioneers.card.rhino: It charges anything it sees within 8 blocks.
wild.pioneers.card.elephant: Keep away from the calves: the whole herd defends them.
wild.pioneers.card.giraffe: Peaceful, but it kicks if struck.
wild.pioneers.card.monkey: Mind your bananas: it steals the one you hold.
wild.pioneers.card.tiger: It hunts on sight and pounces. Hold a torch!
wild.pioneers.monkey.stole: A monkey stole a banana from you!
wild.pioneers.blue_whale.desc: The largest animal in the world (nearly 15 blocks). Peaceful; it blows a spout of spray at the surface. Very long to bring down.
wild.pioneers.humpback_whale.desc: Long white flippers. Blows at the surface and shows its tail before diving. Peaceful.
wild.pioneers.orca.desc: Hunts seals, penguins and sharks in pods. Leaves players alone, unless attacked.
wild.pioneers.sperm_whale.desc: Huge square head; dives for a very long time. Peaceful, but rams whoever attacks it. Very rarely white.
wild.pioneers.great_white_shark.desc: Aggressive: it attacks swimmers within 16 blocks. Also hunts fish.
wild.pioneers.hammerhead_shark.desc: Hammer-shaped head. Only attacks if you are bleeding (under half health, or recently hurt).
wild.pioneers.tiger_shark.desc: Darkly striped. Aggressive: it attacks swimmers within 16 blocks.
wild.pioneers.whale_shark.desc: The largest fish, spotted with white. Completely harmless: it filters plankton.
wild.pioneers.gray_reef_shark.desc: Of warm reefs. Only attacks if you are bleeding (under half health, or recently hurt).
wild.pioneers.manta_ray.desc: Glides in schools, slowly beating its wings. Harmless.
wild.pioneers.seal.desc: Basks on rocks and pack ice; dives as soon as you come near. Prey of the orca.
wild.pioneers.sea_lion.desc: Props itself up on its flippers and barks. Basks on the shore; dives when approached. Prey of the orca.
wild.pioneers.seagull.desc: Of beaches and harbors. Sometimes steals a food item from your hotbar (never the tool in hand or armor).
wild.pioneers.penguin.desc: Lives in colonies on the pack ice. Dives to fish and brings a fish back in its beak.
wild.pioneers.razorbill.desc: Small auk of cold, rocky coasts, in colonies. Dives to fish and brings a fish back in its beak.
description.pioneers.whale_blubber: Thick fat of whales (and a little from seals). Rendered, it will become lamp oil.
wild.pioneers.card.whale: Peaceful and very tough. It surfaces to blow.
wild.pioneers.card.orca: Hunts seals, penguins and sharks. Leaves players alone.
wild.pioneers.card.shark: Dangerous: it attacks swimmers on sight.
wild.pioneers.card.shark_blood: Attacks only if you are bleeding.
wild.pioneers.card.pinniped: Dives as soon as you come near.
wild.pioneers.card.seagull: Watch your food: it steals a food item from your hotbar.
wild.pioneers.card.diver: Dives to fish and brings back a fish.
wild.pioneers.card.fish: Holding a fish in its beak
description.pioneers.deer_trophy: A mounted stag head on its shield. Hangs on a wall. A rare drop from a stag carrying its antlers.
description.pioneers.bear_trophy: A spread bear skin, head raised. Lies on the floor. A rare drop from a bear.
description.pioneers.shark_trophy: A mounted shark on its board, jaws open. Hangs on a wall. A rare drop from a shark.
description.pioneers.gun_rack: Wall board with three rows: shows a musket, a revolver or a harpoon on each row. Right-click with the weapon to put it up, with an empty hand to take it back.
hunt.pioneers.musket.how: Hold right-click for 3 s then release to load (1 lead ball, 1 gunpowder); right-click to fire. Never underwater.
hunt.pioneers.musket.no_ammo: You need a lead ball and a gunpowder.
hunt.pioneers.revolver.how: Right-click: fire. Sneak and hold right-click: reload one cartridge at a time.
hunt.pioneers.wet: Wet powder: you cannot fire underwater.
hunt.pioneers.protected: This animal is protected by this territory’s clan.
hunt.pioneers.harpoon.out: Thrown: right-click to reel the rope in.
hunt.pioneers.harpoon.stats: Damage: %s (%s against sea creatures) · rope: %s blocks
hunt.pioneers.harpoon.how: Hold right-click then release to throw, even underwater. The harpooned animal is slowed and pulled toward you; right-click to reel the rope in.
hunt.pioneers.cmd.overworld: Herds only appear in the Overworld.
hunt.pioneers.cmd.none: No suitable place here (biome, season, sight, claims, villages).
pioneer.pioneers.desk.penalty3: You will lose a quarter of your experience in %s, %s and %s.
jei.pioneers.prod.wildlife.trophy_desc: 5% chance on an animal killed by a hunter (10% at Hunting level 10). Deer: only a stag carrying its antlers. Shark: not the whale shark.
jei.pioneers.info.gun_rack: Hangs on a wall. Right-click with a musket, a revolver or a harpoon: the weapon goes on the aimed row (three rows); empty hand: take it back. A comparator counts the weapons.
jei.pioneers.info.firearm_ammo: Ammunition: the musket loads with 1 lead ball and 1 gunpowder (hold right-click for 3 s); the revolver with cartridges, one at a time (sneak and hold right-click). Against a player, damage is halved (server setting).
item.pioneers.lamp_oil.desc: Bottled whale oil (whale blubber in the fruit press, then an empty bottle on the press): the fuel of oil sconces and lanterns; it also burns in a furnace.
clan.pioneers.ui.buy.fixed: Each bought claim costs %s Shining. Releasing a chunk refunds nothing: the bought claim stays in the budget.
clan.pioneers.ui.territory.slot_price_ti: Next slot: %s Shining, paid when placed (the n-th costs 50 + 108 × ln n, 500 at most).
clan.pioneers.chunkload.no_funds_price: The treasury does not cover the slot (%s Shining) and the first day (%s Shining).
reputation.pioneers.likes.tip: Gains capped at %s points a day per people (unless stated).
reputation.pioneers.act.own: %s if it is one of theirs.
reputation.pioneers.affinity.tip: Average affinity of its residents toward you.
reputation.pioneers.people.player.role: A people born of the Restorers; it lives the way the %s do.
reputation.pioneers.people.player.origin: “A faction signed one more page, then parted from the Restorers.”
reputation.pioneers.people.restorers.rol: They reread the manuals and raise up what can be raised. They are your people.
reputation.pioneers.people.restorers.ori: “In 281, Anaïs Veyrac recognized a page of an old manual in her grandfather’s gesture. She read it again.”
reputation.pioneers.people.restorers.tra: Pay more for paper and ink, sell the Manuals; refuse machines, components and scrap.
reputation.pioneers.people.bare_hands.ro: They live off the land and the herds, without machines; their craftsmanship is superb.
reputation.pioneers.people.bare_hands.or: “They were born of the first disorders. From then on, they no longer touch what answers back.”
reputation.pioneers.people.bare_hands.tr: Trade only what the land and the herds give; sell rare seeds and compost.
reputation.pioneers.people.peddlers.role: Merchants of the Ways: they trade almost anything and keep the books.
reputation.pioneers.people.peddlers.orig: “They were already walking when the Ways fell silent. They never stopped counting.”
reputation.pioneers.people.peddlers.trad: Buy scrap, sell ruin maps; refuse machines and components.
contract.pioneers.letter.to.tip: Recipient: pick a player already met from the list, or type their name.
contract.pioneers.letter.subject: Subject
contract.pioneers.letter.body_hint: Write your letter: what you offer, how, on what terms…
contract.pioneers.letter.count.tip: Lines: %s / %s. A letter holds at most 1,200 characters and 24 lines. Enter: new line; Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V: copy / paste.
contract.pioneers.letter.empty: No letter attached: the terms are on the right.
contract.pioneers.error.body_long: Letter too long (1,200 characters at most).
contract.pioneers.error.body_lines: Letter too long (24 lines at most).
economy.pioneers.ledger.to.tip: Online recipient: pick them from the list, or type their name.
description.pioneers.letter_bin: Stores and sorts letters and invoices (54). Shift + right-click with an empty hand: empties your mailbox into it.
description.pioneers.archive_bin: Stores Codex writings by chapter (192 slots: the whole Codex fits) and shows your collection.
paperwork.pioneers.msg.owned_by: This box belongs to %s (and their clan).
paperwork.pioneers.msg.nothing: Nothing to take from your mailbox.
paperwork.pioneers.help.letter_bin: Letters and invoices stored / room. Click: read · right-click: take · Shift + click in your inventory: store.
paperwork.pioneers.help.archive_bin: Different writings stored / Codex writings. Missing ones are only counted.
paperwork.pioneers.sort.title: Title
paperwork.pioneers.mailbox.tip: Letters and invoices from your mailbox: into the tray.
paperwork.pioneers.row.tip_lore: Click: read (filed in the Codex) · right-click: take
mail.pioneers.letter.answer: Answer: notebook, Documents tab. Nothing is taken without your consent.
block.pioneers.warehouse_inlet.desc: Warehouse input interface: everything put in leaves as parcels for the crates.
block.pioneers.warehouse_outlet.desc: Warehouse output interface: receives orders and keeps N items ready for a machine.
warehouse.pioneers.io.place_hint: Interface: place a small pulley above it (up to %s blocks higher) and tie it to the line
gui.pioneers.warehouse.search.tip: Click to search (“@mod” for a mod) · right-click: clear
gui.pioneers.warehouse.grid.tip: Click: +1 stack · Shift: +1 · Ctrl: +1 parcel · right-click: −1 stack
gui.pioneers.warehouse.output.tip: Ordered parcels open here, unless the cart sends them to a warehouse outlet. A hopper below empties the output.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.cart.button.tip: Opens the cart: lines, amounts, delivery (click again or Esc: close)
gui.pioneers.warehouse.cart.title: Cart · %s
gui.pioneers.warehouse.jei.tip: In JEI, “+” on a recipe puts its ingredients in the cart (Shift: ×64 at most, Ctrl: order right away)
gui.pioneers.warehouse.order.keys: Enter: order · Ctrl + “+” in JEI: order a recipe
gui.pioneers.warehouse.deliver.label: Deliver to:
gui.pioneers.warehouse.deliver.tip: Click: next destination (the counter output or a warehouse outlet on the network)
gui.pioneers.warehouse.deliver.none: No warehouse outlet on the network: parcels arrive at the counter
gui.pioneers.warehouse.wait.link.tip: The station sees no crate: Info tab, what is missing
gui.pioneers.warehouse.wait.still.tip: The rope is not turning: nothing leaves
gui.pioneers.warehouse.wait.busy.tip: 24 parcels are already out: the rest leaves as soon as one comes back
gui.pioneers.warehouse.wait.full.tip: The output is full: empty it (hopper below, or take the items); the queue waits
gui.pioneers.warehouse.wait.column.tip: A block is in the drop column under the pulley: parcels wait
gui.pioneers.warehouse.wait.stock.tip: The warehouse is short of an item for a “keep” rule
gui.pioneers.warehouse.wait.room.tip: No crate has room: the items wait in the slots, nothing is lost
gui.pioneers.warehouse.recipe.partial: Recipe ×%s partly in the cart · %s missing (%s)
gui.pioneers.warehouse.recipe.none: Nothing of this recipe in the warehouse · missing: %s (%s)
gui.pioneers.warehouse.recipe.empty: This recipe asks for no items
gui.pioneers.warehouse.jei.no_items: No items to ask for in this recipe
gui.pioneers.warehouse.jei.none: Nothing of this recipe in the warehouse
gui.pioneers.warehouse.jei.title: Ask the warehouse counter
gui.pioneers.warehouse.jei.shift: Shift + click: ×%s (as many as possible, 64 at most)
gui.pioneers.warehouse.io.inlet.slots.ti: Everything put here leaves as parcels for a crate with room
gui.pioneers.warehouse.io.outlet.slots.t: Parcels open here; the chute pushes into the inventory it faces, a hopper below also takes
gui.pioneers.warehouse.io.inlet.explain: Hopper, pipe, conveyor or by hand: everything put in these slots leaves as parcels for the crate that already holds some, otherwise one with room. Crates full: the slots stay full and nothing more comes in, nothing is lost.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.io.inlet.help: A small pulley above, tied to the line, like the counter
gui.pioneers.warehouse.io.outlet.help: −/+: 1 stack (Shift: 1) · wheel on a rule · right-click: −1 stack
gui.pioneers.warehouse.io.outlet.explain: Keeps N items here; the chute pushes into the machine it faces. The counter can deliver here.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.io.info.help: A network station like the counter: a small pulley above, tied by the ropes. The diagnosis says what is missing.
gui.pioneers.warehouse.keep.title: Keep in stock (%s/%s)
gui.pioneers.warehouse.keep.add.tip: Click with an item held (or drag it from JEI): the outlet will keep one stack of it
gui.pioneers.warehouse.keep.row.tip: The outlet asks the warehouse for enough to keep %s of this item in its slots
paperwork.pioneers.help.places: Slots used in the box / slots of the box.
clan.pioneers.ui.nav_tip.home: Found a clan, hold land alone, invitations received.
clan.pioneers.ui.nav_tip.sheet: Identity, key figures, level and your rights.
clan.pioneers.ui.nav_tip.members: Who is here, roles and their rights, invite.
clan.pioneers.ui.nav_tip.government: Regime, open votes, propose a decision.
clan.pioneers.ui.nav_tip.diplomacy: Wars, sieges, treaties, standing with the peoples.
clan.pioneers.ui.nav_tip.faction: Your faction: sheet, member clans, federal votes.
clan.pioneers.ui.nav_tip.journal: Everything that happened to the clan, newest first.
clan.pioneers.ui.nav_tip.clans: Clan directory: public sheet, treaties, war.
clan.pioneers.ui.nav_tip.peoples: The peoples of the world and their doctrines.
clan.pioneers.ui.confirm_tip: Click again within 4 seconds to confirm: this cannot be undone.
clan.pioneers.ui.home.found_line: Sign the Clan Charter with other pioneers.
clan.pioneers.ui.home.solo_line: One claim makes you a Solitary.
clan.pioneers.ui.fact.rank_tip: Rank %s: you can only manage lower ranks.
clan.pioneers.ui.sheet.rights_tip: Hover an icon; the Roles view (Members) shows each role’s rights.
clan.pioneers.ui.members.ids_tip_on: Your role can see each character’s account.
clan.pioneers.ui.members.ids_tip_off: Accounts hidden: only the “See identities” permission shows them.
clan.pioneers.ui.members.need_rank: This member’s rank is equal to or above yours.
clan.pioneers.ui.members.need_rep: Only an Empire’s Representative names the heir.
clan.pioneers.ui.members.recruits_tip: Nearest first. Only the character name is shown: the account stays private.
clan.pioneers.ui.roles.title: Clan roles
clan.pioneers.ui.roles.edit_tip: Click a box to grant or remove this right.

document.pioneers.type_tip.quote: Proposed price, line by line. The recipient accepts or refuses it; nothing is paid.
document.pioneers.type_tip.receipt: Proves a payment already received. No money moves; it is “paid” as soon as it is sent.
document.pioneers.type_tip.iou: You acknowledge owing the recipient a sum and paying it on schedule (signed when sent, taken automatically).
document.pioneers.type_tip.purchase_orde: You order from the recipient; once the supplier accepts, you pay on schedule (taken automatically).
document.pioneers.type_tip.bill_of_sale: You sell to the recipient; signed by both, the buyer pays on schedule (taken automatically).
document.pioneers.type_tip.proxy: You give the recipient authority (free text). They accept it; you can revoke it.

item.pioneers.tube_die.desc: Casting machine: 2 tubes per ingot of molten metal; plastic pipes. In the Tool slot: unbreakable, never consumed.
item.pioneers.press_die.desc: Press: sheets; power hammer: rings, rivets and pins; casting machine: plastic parts and sheets; calender: gaskets. In the Tool slot: unbreakable, never consumed.
jei.pioneers.alloys.ingots_only: Ingots only: the industrial crucible does not mix ore (melt and cast it first)
jei.pioneers.alloys.to_ingot: For the ingot: click the alloy ingot (cast it, or the induction furnace)
jei.pioneers.alloys.how.crucible: Industrial crucible (MKI to MKIV, multiblock): %s as ingots, %s
jei.pioneers.alloys.how.crucible_gas: Industrial crucible (MKI to MKIV, multiblock): %s as ingots, under argon (shielding gas), %s
jei.pioneers.alloys.how.crucible_ingot: Industrial crucible: %s as ingots → alloy ingots, %s
jei.pioneers.alloys.how.vacuum: Industrial crucible, under argon (vacuum): %s as ingots → alloy ingots, %s
jei.pioneers.alloys.how.induction2: Induction furnace (steam T1, then MKI to MKIV): %s as ingots → %s alloy ingots, without melting or casting (%s)
jei.pioneers.alloys.how.induction_mk: Induction furnace MKI to MKIV: %s as ingots → alloy ingots, without melting or casting (%s)
jei.pioneers.alloys.how.mold: Ingot mold (%s mB per ingot): on the ground or on the casting table, or under the automatic foundry
jei.pioneers.alloys.how.table: Casting table: put the mold on it, then pour the molten metal (crucible and tongs)
jei.pioneers.alloys.how.casting_machine: Casting machine (MKI to MKIV): molten metal + ingot die (Tool slot, never consumed)
jei.pioneers.alloys.way.cast: Cast the molten metal (ingot mold or die)
jei.pioneers.alloys.way.induction: Alloy the ingots without melting them (induction furnace)
jei.pioneers.alloys.way.vacuum: Alloy the ingots under argon (industrial crucible)
jei.pioneers.alloys.ways_tip1: Cast: pour the molten alloy (“Molten alloy” page) into an ingot mold or die.
jei.pioneers.alloys.ways_tip2: Without melting: the pure ingots in the induction furnace (or the industrial crucible under argon), straight into alloy ingots.
jei.pioneers.metal_melting.title: Melting: %s · %s
jei.pioneers.metal_melting.liquid_tip: Melting makes molten metal; for an ingot, cast it (“Casting” and “Alloy ingot” pages).
